-- ============================================================
-- News_Engine.scpt
-- 统一新闻总结引擎（替代 Qianwen_News.scpt / Deepseek_News.scpt / Doubao_News.scpt）
--
-- 参数： {methodType, poeMode, shouldRepeat, providerChain}
--   methodType    : "" 表示按 provider 使用各自默认 Prompt
--   poeMode       : "normal" / "cheap"
--   shouldRepeat  : true = 连续处理；false = 每篇后询问
--   providerChain : "qianwen,deepseek,doubao" 或 "deepseek,qianwen,doubao"（可省略，默认第一个）
--
-- 交接规则（v2）：
--   链条里某个 AI 拒答/异常（Python exit 5）-> 用同一篇文章内容换下一个 AI；
--   且【永久推进】链条指针：后续所有文章都直接从新的 AI 开始，不再回退到已拒答的 AI。
--   链条最后一个（兜底）也失败 -> 写日志 + 弹窗终止。
-- ============================================================

property pythonPath : "/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/Current/bin/python3"
property scriptFolder : "/Users/yanzhang/Coding/python_code/"
property screenshotScript : "/Users/yanzhang/Coding/python_code/screenshot.py"
property notifyScript : "/Users/yanzhang/Coding/python_code/Modules/notification.py"
property cliclickPath : "/opt/homebrew/bin/cliclick"
property copyFailurePath : "/Users/yanzhang/Coding/News/copy_failure.html"

-- 默认链条（没传第 4 个参数时用）
property defaultChain : "qianwen,deepseek,doubao"

-- 【开关】是否开启英文总结功能（true = 双语；false = 英文位置写原文）
property enableEnglishSummary : false

-- 【开关】内容不合格(exit 1) / 超时(exit 2) 是否也换下一个 AI 重试（仅本篇）
property handoffOnFailure : false

-- 【开关】拒答(exit 5) 是否永久切换到下一个 AI（true = 后续所有文章都用新 AI）
property permanentSwitchOnRefusal : true

-- 【开关】exit 1 / exit 2 触发的交接是否也永久切换（默认 false：只对当前这篇换人）
property permanentSwitchOnFailure : false

-- 运行期状态
property consecutiveErrors : 0
property qwContinueChecked : false
-- 【核心】当前链条起点（跨文章持久），1 = 链条第一个 provider
property providerStartIndex : 1


on run argv
	set consecutiveErrors to 0
	set qwContinueChecked to false
	set providerStartIndex to 1
	
	set methodType to ""
	set poeMode to "normal"
	set shouldRepeat to false
	set chainText to defaultChain
	
	if (count of argv) ≥ 1 then set methodType to (item 1 of argv) as text
	if (count of argv) ≥ 2 then set poeMode to (item 2 of argv) as text
	if (count of argv) ≥ 3 then
		try
			set shouldRepeat to (item 3 of argv) as boolean
		on error
			set shouldRepeat to (((item 3 of argv) as text) is "true")
		end try
	end if
	if (count of argv) ≥ 4 then
		set t to (item 4 of argv) as text
		if t is not "" then set chainText to t
	end if
	
	set providerChain to my SplitText(chainText, ",")
	if (count of providerChain) is 0 then set providerChain to my SplitText(defaultChain, ",")
	
	-- 短文章用的翻译 Prompt
	set methodType2 to "----请将以上内容完整翻译成地道的中文，只是翻译，其它话都不要说"
	
	if shouldRepeat then
		repeat
			if my shouldStopByFile() then exit repeat
			set stopNow to my NewsOperation(methodType, poeMode, methodType2, providerChain)
			if stopNow then exit repeat
		end repeat
	else
		repeat
			if my shouldStopByFile() then exit repeat
			set stopNow to my NewsOperation(methodType, poeMode, methodType2, providerChain)
			if stopNow then exit repeat
			if my shouldStopByFile() then exit repeat
			
			set userResponse to display dialog "已成功处理一个页面。" & return & "是否继续处理下一个？" buttons {"终止", "继续"} default button "继续" cancel button "终止"
			if button returned of userResponse is "终止" then exit repeat
		end repeat
	end if
end run


-- ============================================================
-- 处理一篇文章；返回 true 表示要终止外层循环
-- ============================================================
on NewsOperation(methodType, poeMode, methodType2, providerChain)
	set targetWebsites to {"nytimes.com", "nikkei.com", "bloomberg.com", "technologyreview.com", "economist.com", "hbr.org", "ft.com", "wsj.com", "reuters.com", "washingtonpost.com", "asia.nikkei.com", "rfi.fr", "dw.com", "bbc.com"}
	
	set foundWebsiteName to ""
	set foundTabId to -1
	set containsTargetWebsite to false
	set currentTabURL to ""
	
	tell application "Google Chrome"
		activate
		delay 0.2
		set tabList to every tab of front window
		
		repeat with i from 1 to the count of tabList
			set tabURL to URL of item i of tabList
			repeat with website in targetWebsites
				if tabURL contains website then
					set tld to text -3 thru -1 of website
					set pos to offset of tld in tabURL
					if pos ≠ 0 then
						set domainLength to length of website
						set startOfPostDomain to pos + domainLength - 3
						if length of tabURL ≥ startOfPostDomain + 7 then
							set currentTabURL to tabURL
							set containsTargetWebsite to true
							set foundWebsiteName to website
							set active tab index of front window to i
							set foundTabId to id of item i of tabList
							exit repeat
						end if
					end if
				end if
			end repeat
			if containsTargetWebsite then exit repeat
		end repeat
	end tell
	
	if not containsTargetWebsite then
		my Notify("没有可供总结的新闻页面了", "green", 2000)
		return true
	end if
	
	my handlename(foundWebsiteName, currentTabURL)
	set the clipboard to currentTabURL
	
	if currentTabURL contains "www.wsj.com/video/" then
		tell application "Google Chrome"
			close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
		end tell
		delay 0.5
		return false
	end if
	
	-- ==========================================================
	-- 分支 1：英文站点（需要 AI 总结）
	-- ==========================================================
	if currentTabURL contains "ft.com" or currentTabURL contains "technologyreview.com" or currentTabURL contains "economist.com" or currentTabURL contains "www.wsj.com" or currentTabURL contains "reuters.com" or currentTabURL contains "washingtonpost.com" or currentTabURL contains "asia.nikkei.com" or currentTabURL contains "bloomberg.com" or currentTabURL contains "nytimes.com" then
		
		if currentTabURL contains "reuters.com/pictures/" then
			my Scroll(5)
			delay 1
		else if currentTabURL contains "wsj.com" then
			my Scroll(1)
		else
			my Scroll(2)
		end if
		delay 0.2
		
		if currentTabURL contains "ft.com" then
			my OperationForFT()
		else
			my Operation()
		end if
		delay 0.2
		
		-- 关键词屏蔽检查
		try
			my runPythonScript("Clipboard_keyword_check.py", {currentTabURL})
		on error
			my Notify("包含屏蔽关键词，已跳过此文章", "red", 3000)
			tell application "Google Chrome"
				close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
			end tell
			my MoveImagesToTrash()
			return false
		end try
		
		my runPythonScript("Article_Copier.py", {currentTabURL})
		my runPythonScript("Clipboard_count_news.py", {})
		
		set filePathsuperlong to "/tmp/superlongarticle.txt"
		set filePathlong to "/tmp/longarticle.txt"
		set filePathshort to "/tmp/shortarticle.txt"
		
		set finalMethodType to methodType
		set finalPoeMode to poeMode
		
		set hasShort to false
		set hasLong to false
		set hasSuperlong to false
		
		tell application "System Events"
			if exists file filePathshort then
				delete file filePathshort
				set hasShort to true
			else if exists file filePathlong then
				delete file filePathlong
				set hasLong to true
			else if exists file filePathsuperlong then
				delete file filePathsuperlong
				set hasSuperlong to true
			end if
		end tell
		
		if hasShort then
			set finalMethodType to methodType2
			set finalPoeMode to "cheap"
			set model to my API_Model(finalPoeMode)
		else if hasLong then
			set model to my API_Model(poeMode)
		else if hasSuperlong then
			set finalPoeMode to "cheap"
			set model to my API_Model(finalPoeMode)
		else
			my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, "文章太短")
			my Notify("文章太短，已跳过此文章", "orange", 2000)
			tell application "Google Chrome"
				close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
			end tell
			delay 0.5
			return false
		end if
		
		-- 原始文章内容（交接时复用，不用再复制页面）
		set rawArticleContent to the clipboard
		
		set autoWaitParam to "50"
		if currentTabURL contains "reuters.com/pictures" then set autoWaitParam to "10"
		
		set chainResult to my SummarizeWithChain(providerChain, finalMethodType, rawArticleContent, autoWaitParam, currentTabURL)
		if chainResult is not "ok" then return true
		
		-- ================= 英文部分 =================
		if enableEnglishSummary is true then
			set englishMethodType to "----Please summarize this article in English detailedly (retain key data)."
			set englishInput to "<document>" & rawArticleContent & "</document>" & englishMethodType
			
			set pythonResultEnglish to my runPythonScript("Modules/API_Poe_Close.py", {model, englishInput})
			
			if pythonResultEnglish contains "POE_RESPONSE_COMPLETE" then
				set consecutiveErrors to 0
				my runPythonScript("Append_English_News.py", {})
				tell application "Google Chrome"
					close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
				end tell
				delay 0.5
			else
				set consecutiveErrors to consecutiveErrors + 1
				log "中文成功，但英文 API 失败。累计错误: " & consecutiveErrors
				if consecutiveErrors is greater than or equal to 3 then
					display dialog "⚠️ 警告：API (英文阶段) 已连续报错 3 次。" & return & return & "程序将强制终止。" buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
					error number -128
				end if
			end if
		else
			set the clipboard to rawArticleContent
			delay 0.2
			my runPythonScript("Append_English_News.py", {})
			set consecutiveErrors to 0
			tell application "Google Chrome"
				close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
			end tell
			delay 0.5
		end if
		
		-- ==========================================================
		-- 分支 2：中文站点（不走 AI）
		-- ==========================================================
	else if currentTabURL contains "cn.wsj.com" or currentTabURL contains "rfi.fr" or currentTabURL contains "dw.com" or currentTabURL contains "bbc.com/zhongwen" then
		my Scroll(1)
		delay 0.5
		my Operation()
		
		try
			my runPythonScript("Clipboard_keyword_check.py", {currentTabURL})
		on error
			my Notify("包含屏蔽关键词，已跳过此文章", "red", 3000)
			tell application "Google Chrome"
				close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
			end tell
			my MoveImagesToTrash()
			return false
		end try
		
		set checkChineseScript to "
import sys, subprocess

text = subprocess.run(['pbpaste'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout

cn_count = sum(1 for c in text if 0x4e00 <= ord(c) <= 0x9fff or 
                                  0x3400 <= ord(c) <= 0x4dbf or 
                                  0xf900 <= ord(c) <= 0xfaff or 
                                  0x3000 <= ord(c) <= 0x303f or 
                                  0xff00 <= ord(c) <= 0xffef)

en_count = sum(1 for c in text if c.isascii() and c.isalpha())

total_valid = cn_count + en_count

if total_valid == 0:
    sys.exit(1)

if en_count / total_valid > 1/2:
    sys.exit(1)

sys.exit(0)
"
		try
			do shell script quoted form of pythonPath & " -c " & quoted form of checkChineseScript
		on error
			my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, "非中文内容过多")
			my Notify("非中文内容过多，已跳过此文章", "red", 3000)
			tell application "Google Chrome"
				close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
			end tell
			return false
		end try
		
		my runPythonScript("Article_Copier.py", {currentTabURL})
		my Notify("等待下载图片....", "blue", 5000)
		my runPythonScript("CN_copy_News.py", {currentTabURL})
		delay 0.5
		tell application "Google Chrome"
			close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
		end tell
	end if
	
	return false
end NewsOperation


-- ============================================================
-- 按 provider 链条依次尝试；返回 "ok" 或 "stop"
-- 【v2】起点使用跨文章持久的 providerStartIndex；
--       拒答后永久推进 providerStartIndex，后续文章不再回退。
-- ============================================================
on SummarizeWithChain(providerChain, finalMethodType, rawArticleContent, autoWaitParam, currentTabURL)
	set providerCount to count of providerChain
	
	-- 边界保护
	if providerStartIndex < 1 then set providerStartIndex to 1
	if providerStartIndex > providerCount then set providerStartIndex to providerCount
	
	repeat with idx from providerStartIndex to providerCount
		set providerName to item idx of providerChain
		
		-- 1) 组装 Prompt（methodType 为空则用该 provider 的默认 Prompt）
		set promptText to finalMethodType
		if promptText is "" then set promptText to my DefaultPrompt(providerName)
		set the clipboard to (quote & rawArticleContent & quote & promptText)
		delay 0.2
		
		-- 2) 打开/切换到对应 AI 页面并提交
		my PrepareProvider(providerName)
		
		-- 3) 等待回答 & 抓取
		set stepOK to true
		try
			my WaitSummaryReady(providerName)
			my runPythonScript("News_auto.py", {providerName, autoWaitParam})
		on error errMsg number errNum
			set stepOK to false
			
			set isRefusal to (errNum is 5)
			set needHandoff to isRefusal
			if handoffOnFailure is true and (errNum is 1 or errNum is 2) then set needHandoff to true
			
			if needHandoff then
				if idx < providerCount then
					set nextProvider to item (idx + 1) of providerChain
					
					-- 判定本次交接是否要「永久」推进链条指针
					set doPermanent to false
					if isRefusal and (permanentSwitchOnRefusal is true) then set doPermanent to true
					if (not isRefusal) and (permanentSwitchOnFailure is true) then set doPermanent to true
					
					if doPermanent then
						set providerStartIndex to idx + 1
						my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "拒答/异常 → 永久切换为" & my ProviderLabel(nextProvider))
						my Notify(my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "已拒答，之后所有文章全部改由" & my ProviderLabel(nextProvider) & "处理", "purple", 4000)
					else
						my Notify(my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "本篇失败，临时改由" & my ProviderLabel(nextProvider) & "接管此文章", "purple", 3000)
					end if
					
					delay 0.5
					-- 继续 repeat：同一篇文章，换下一个 AI
				else
					my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "拒答(兜底失败)")
					display dialog "⚠️ 链条上所有 AI 均拒答/异常，已停止程序。" & return & return & "链条：" & my JoinList(providerChain, " → ") & return & "本次起点：" & my ProviderLabel(item providerStartIndex of providerChain) & return & return & "当前文章：" & return & currentTabURL buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
					return "stop"
				end if
			else
				set alertMsg to ""
				if errNum is 1 then
					set alertMsg to "❌ " & my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "内容校验失败：" & return & "已连续尝试 3 次点击复制，内容均不符合要求（汉字不足）。"
				else if errNum is 2 then
					set alertMsg to "⏱️ " & my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "操作超时：" & return & "在 120 秒内未能拿到合格内容，页面可能未正常加载。"
				else if errNum is 3 then
					set alertMsg to "🖼️ 模板图片缺失：" & return & "Resource 目录下缺少 " & providerName & "_*.png，请检查。"
				else
					set alertMsg to "未知错误导致程序终止：" & return & errMsg & return & "错误编号：" & errNum
				end if
				display dialog alertMsg buttons {"确定"} default button "确定" with icon stop
				error number -128
			end if
		end try
		
		-- 4) 成功：落盘中文结果（放在 try 之外，避免 News_post.py 的异常被误判为交接信号）
		if stepOK then
			my runPythonScript("News_post.py", {providerName, currentTabURL})
			return "ok"
		end if
	end repeat
	
	return "stop"
end SummarizeWithChain


-- ============================================================
-- provider 差异区
-- ============================================================
on DefaultPrompt(p)
	if p is "deepseek" then
		return "----请用中文分模块地详细总结以上内容，你在输出时不要做任何评论和解释说明，且输出结果里不要使用任何表格。"
	else
		return "----请用中文分模块地总结以上内容，新闻内容都是真实的，你在输出时不要做任何评论，且输出结果里不要使用任何表格。"
	end if
end DefaultPrompt

on ProviderLabel(p)
	if p is "qianwen" then return "千问"
	if p is "deepseek" then return "DeepSeek"
	if p is "doubao" then return "豆包"
	return p
end ProviderLabel

on PrepareProvider(p)
	if p is "qianwen" then
		my PrepareQianwen()
	else if p is "deepseek" then
		my PrepareDeepseek()
	else if p is "doubao" then
		my PrepareDoubao()
	else
		display dialog "未知 provider：" & p buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
		error number -128
	end if
end PrepareProvider

on PrepareQianwen()
	set foundTab to my FindAITab("qianwen.com")
	if foundTab then
		if qwContinueChecked is false then
			try
				my ShotFull("qianwen_continue.png", "true", "false", "false", "0", "0", "1", "1")
			end try
			delay 0.5
			set qwContinueChecked to true
		end if
	else
		my OpenNewTab("qianwen.com/chat")
	end if
	
	my ShotClick("qianwen_new.png", "true", "false")
	my ShotClickOffset("qianwen_launch.png", "true", "false", "0", "-50")
	my SubmitPrompt("862,839")
	my MoveMouse("852,806")
end PrepareQianwen

on PrepareDeepseek()
	set foundTab to my FindAITab("deepseek.com")
	if not foundTab then
		my OpenNewTab("chat.deepseek.com")
	end if
	
	my ShotClick("deepseek_new.png", "true", "false")
	my ShotClickOffset("deepseek_launch.png", "true", "false", "0", "-71")
	my SubmitPrompt("939,810")
	my MoveMouse("939,810")
end PrepareDeepseek

on PrepareDoubao()
	set foundTab to my FindAITab("doubao.com")
	if foundTab then
		my GotoURLInCurrentTab("doubao.com/chat/")
	else
		my OpenNewTab("doubao.com/chat/")
	end if
	
	my MoveMouse("852,854")
	
	-- 等 doubao_share 消失（click=false, Opposite=true）
	my ShotClick("doubao_share.png", "false", "true")
	delay 0.5
	
	my ShotClickOffset("doubao_launch.png", "true", "false", "0", "-47")
	delay 0.5
	
	my SubmitPrompt("862,839")
	my MoveMouse("852,806")
end PrepareDoubao

-- 提交前的「摘要区域」定位截图（豆包不需要）
on WaitSummaryReady(p)
	if p is "qianwen" then
		try
			my ShotFull("qianwen_summary.png", "true", "false", "false", "0", "0", "1", "3")
		end try
	else if p is "deepseek" then
		try
			my ShotFull("deepseek_summary.png", "true", "false", "false", "0", "0", "1", "3")
		end try
	end if
end WaitSummaryReady


-- ============================================================
-- Chrome / 键鼠 / 截图 通用子程序
-- ============================================================
on FindAITab(domain)
	tell application "Google Chrome"
		set windowList to every window
		repeat with aWindow in windowList
			set tabList to every tab of aWindow
			set tabIndex to 0
			repeat with aTab in tabList
				set tabIndex to tabIndex + 1
				if (URL of aTab) contains domain then
					set index of aWindow to 1
					set active tab index of aWindow to tabIndex
					return true
				end if
			end repeat
		end repeat
	end tell
	return false
end FindAITab

on OpenNewTab(urlText)
	tell application "Google Chrome" to activate
	delay 0.5
	tell application "System Events"
		keystroke "t" using command down
		delay 0.5
		keystroke urlText
		delay 0.5
		key code 36
	end tell
	delay 0.5
end OpenNewTab

on GotoURLInCurrentTab(urlText)

on SplitText(theText, delim)

	set AppleScript's text item delimiters to oldDelims
	
	set outList to {}
	repeat with p in parts
		set t to my TrimText(p as text)
		if t is not "" then set end of outList to t
	end repeat
	return outList
end SplitText

on JoinList(theList, sep)
	set outText to ""
	repeat with i from 1 to count of theList
		if i > 1 then set outText to outText & sep
		set outText to outText & (item i of theList)
	end repeat
	return outText
end JoinList

on TrimText(t)
	set t to t as text
	repeat while t starts with " "
		if (length of t) is 1 then return ""
		set t to text 2 thru -1 of t
	end repeat
	repeat while t ends with " "
		if (length of t) is 1 then return ""
		set t to text 1 thru -2 of t
	end repeat
	return t
end TrimText

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
统一的「等待 AI 回答 → 点击复制 → 校验剪贴板」自动化脚本
替代 Qianwen_auto.py / Deepseek_auto.py / Doubao_auto.py

用法:
    News_auto.py <provider> [min_chinese]
        provider    : qianwen | deepseek | doubao
        min_chinese : 合格所需最少汉字数，默认 50

退出码:
    0  成功，剪贴板内容合格
    1  连续 3 次点击复制，内容均不合格
    2  超时（TIMEOUT_DURATION 秒内没拿到合格内容）
    3  模板图片缺失 / provider 名称错误
    5  需要交接（AI 拒答 或 回答异常）
"""

import os
import re
import sys
import time
from time import sleep

import cv2
import numpy as np
import pyautogui
import pyperclip
from PIL import ImageGrab

# ================= 全局配置 =================
USER_HOME = os.path.expanduser("~")
BASE_RESOURCE_DIR = os.path.join(USER_HOME, "Coding", "python_code", "Resource")

SCROLL_AMOUNT = -120        # 滚动幅度
MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3            # 最多点击复制次数
TIMEOUT_DURATION = 120      # 总超时（秒）

# ================= 退出码 =================
EXIT_OK = 0
EXIT_UNQUALIFIED = 1
EXIT_TIMEOUT = 2
EXIT_TEMPLATE_MISSING = 3
EXIT_HANDOFF = 5

# ================= provider 差异配置 =================
# templates: key -> (文件名, 匹配阈值, 是否必需)
PROVIDERS = {
    "qianwen": {
        "label": "千问",
        "templates": {
            "copy":       ("qianwen_copy.png",       0.90, True),
            "forbidden":  ("qianwen_forbidden.png",  0.90, True),
            "forbidden2": ("qianwen_forbidden2.png", 0.90, True),
            "retry":      ("qianwen_retry.png",      0.90, True),
            "timeout":    ("qianwen_timeout.png",    0.90, True),
        },
        "check_refusal_text": True,     # 剪贴板文本命中拒答话术 -> 交接
        "refresh_on_stall": True,       # 见到 retry / timeout 图 -> 等 15s 后 Cmd+R
        "related_gate": False,          # 复制按钮出现后是否等待 related 图再重定位
        "cursor_before_scroll": (709, 749),  # 内容不合格重试前把鼠标移到这里再滚动
        "copy_offset": (0, 0),
    },
    "deepseek": {
        "label": "DeepSeek",
        "templates": {
            "copy":       ("deepseek_copy.png",       0.90, True),
        },
        "check_refusal_text": True,
        "refresh_on_stall": True,
        "related_gate": False,
        "cursor_before_scroll": (709, 749),
        "copy_offset": (-35, 0),        # 靠左 35 像素点击
    },
    "doubao": {
        "label": "豆包",
        "templates": {
            "copy":    ("doubao_copy.png",    0.90, True),
            "related": ("doubao_related.png", 0.80, True),
            "wrong":   ("doubao_wrong.png",   0.88, False),   # 可选：回答异常标识
        },
        "check_refusal_text": True,
        "refresh_on_stall": False,
        "related_gate": True,
        "cursor_before_scroll": None,
        "copy_offset": (0, 0),
    },
}

# 拒答话术（三家共用）
REFUSAL_PHRASES = [
    "抱歉，我无法回答这个问题，我们聊聊别的吧",
    "抱歉，我无法回答这个问题",
    "我们聊聊别的吧",
    "无法回答这个问题",
    "不能回答这个问题",
    "无法协助处理该请求",
    "我无法协助完成该请求",
    "我不能协助完成该请求",
    "该内容无法处理",
    "很抱歉，我不能",
    "很抱歉，我无法",
]


# ================= 基础工具 =================
def get_scale_factor():
    """ImageGrab(物理像素) 与 pyautogui(逻辑坐标) 的比例。Retina 通常 2.0。"""
    try:
        with ImageGrab.grab() as sc:
            img_width = sc.size[0]
        screen_width, _ = pyautogui.size()
        return img_width / screen_width
    except Exception:
        return 1.0


SCALE_FACTOR = get_scale_factor()


def capture_screen():
    with ImageGrab.grab() as screenshot:
        img_np = np.array(screenshot)
        if img_np.ndim == 3 and img_np.shape[2] == 4:
            return cv2.cvtColor(img_np, cv2.COLOR_RGBA2BGR)
        return cv2.cvtColor(img_np, cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)


def match_template(template, threshold, screen=None):
    """返回 (max_loc, shape) 或 (None, None)"""
    if template is None:
        return None, None
    if screen is None:
        screen = capture_screen()
    if template.shape[0] > screen.shape[0] or template.shape[1] > screen.shape[1]:
        return None, None
    result = cv2.matchTemplate(screen, template, cv2.TM_CCOEFF_NORMED)
    _, max_val, _, max_loc = cv2.minMaxLoc(result)
    if max_val >= threshold:
        return max_loc, template.shape
    return None, None


def load_templates(cfg):
    """按配置加载模板，返回 {key: (img, threshold)}；缺必需模板则直接退出。"""
    loaded = {}
    for key, (filename, threshold, required) in cfg["templates"].items():
        path = os.path.join(BASE_RESOURCE_DIR, filename)
        img = None
        if os.path.exists(path):
            img = cv2.imread(path, cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
        if img is None:
            if required:
                print(f"错误：模板文件缺失或无法读取 -> {path}")
                sys.exit(EXIT_TEMPLATE_MISSING)
            print(f"警告：可选模板不可用 -> {path}，该检测自动关闭。")
            loaded[key] = (None, threshold)
            continue
        loaded[key] = (img, threshold)
    return loaded


def find(templates, key, screen=None):
    if key not in templates:
        return None, None
    img, threshold = templates[key]
    return match_template(img, threshold, screen=screen)


def is_refusal_response(text: str) -> bool:
    if not text:
        return False
    normalized = re.sub(r'\s+', '', text)
    return any(p in normalized for p in REFUSAL_PHRASES)


def is_content_qualified(text, min_chinese=50) -> bool:
    if not text:
        return False
    return len(re.findall(r'[\u4e00-\u9fff]', text)) > min_chinese


def perform_click(location, shape, offset=(0, 0)):
    phys_x = location[0] + shape[1] // 2
    phys_y = location[1] + shape[0] // 2
    lx = int(phys_x / SCALE_FACTOR)
    ly = int(phys_y / SCALE_FACTOR)
    
    if offset:
        lx += offset[0]
        ly += offset[1]
        
    pyautogui.click(lx, ly)
    return lx, ly


def refresh_page_mac():
    os.system("""osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to key code 15 using command down'""")


def scroll_down(cfg, move_cursor=False):
    pos = cfg.get("cursor_before_scroll")
    if move_cursor and pos:
        print(f"移动光标到 {pos} 并向下滚屏...")
        pyautogui.moveTo(pos[0], pos[1])
    pyautogui.scroll(SCROLL_AMOUNT)
    sleep(1)


# ================= 豆包专用：回答异常二次确认 =================
def check_wrong_confirmed(templates):
    """
    1) 命中 wrong 后等 1.5s
    2) 复查时优先看 copy（复制按钮出现则以 copy 为准）
    3) copy 仍无、wrong 仍在 -> 确认异常
    """
    if templates.get("wrong", (None, 0))[0] is None:
        return False

    loc, _ = find(templates, "wrong")
    if not loc:
        return False

    print("疑似检测到 wrong 标识，1.5 秒后二次确认...")
    sleep(1.5)

    copy_loc, _ = find(templates, "copy")
    if copy_loc:
        print("二次确认时发现 Copy 按钮已出现，忽略 wrong 标识。")
        return False

    loc2, _ = find(templates, "wrong")
    if loc2:
        print("二次确认成立：AI 回答异常。")
        return True

    print("二次确认不成立（wrong 已消失），继续正常流程。")
    return False


# ================= 主流程 =================
def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("用法: News_auto.py <qianwen|deepseek|doubao> [min_chinese]")
        sys.exit(EXIT_TEMPLATE_MISSING)

    provider = sys.argv[1].strip().lower()
    if provider not in PROVIDERS:
        print(f"错误：未知 provider '{provider}'，可选：{list(PROVIDERS.keys())}")
        sys.exit(EXIT_TEMPLATE_MISSING)

    cfg = PROVIDERS[provider]

    target_threshold = 50
    if len(sys.argv) > 2:
        try:
            target_threshold = int(sys.argv[2])
        except ValueError:
            print("汉字阈值参数格式错误，使用默认 50")

    templates = load_templates(cfg)

    print(f"[{cfg['label']}] 缩放因子={SCALE_FACTOR}，最多 {MAX_ATTEMPTS} 次，汉字阈值={target_threshold}")

    attempt = 1
    start_time = time.time()

    while attempt <= MAX_ATTEMPTS:
        if time.time() - start_time > TIMEOUT_DURATION:
            print("寻找超时：未能在规定时间内完成任务")
            sys.exit(EXIT_TIMEOUT)

        screen = capture_screen()

        # ---- 1. 拒答图标（forbidden / forbidden2）优先 ----
        forbidden_hit = None
        for key in ("forbidden", "forbidden2"):
            loc, _ = find(templates, key, screen=screen)
            if loc:
                forbidden_hit = key
                break
        if forbidden_hit:
            print(f"检测到 {forbidden_hit} 图片，判定为拒答 -> 请求交接。")
            sys.exit(EXIT_HANDOFF)

        # ---- 2. retry / timeout：等 15 秒后刷新页面 ----
        if cfg["refresh_on_stall"]:
            stall_hit = None
            for key in ("retry", "timeout"):
                loc, _ = find(templates, key, screen=screen)
                if loc:
                    stall_hit = key
                    break
            if stall_hit:
                print(f"检测到 {stall_hit} 图片，等待 15 秒后刷新页面...")
                sleep(15)
                refresh_page_mac()
                sleep(5)
                continue        # 刷新不消耗 attempt

        # ---- 3. Copy 按钮 ----
        location, shape = find(templates, "copy", screen=screen)

        if not location:
            # 连复制按钮都没有 -> 检查回答异常（豆包）
            if check_wrong_confirmed(templates):
                sys.exit(EXIT_HANDOFF)
            scroll_down(cfg)
            continue

        # ---- 3.1 豆包：等 related 标识后重新定位 copy（布局会被挤压）----
        if cfg["related_gate"]:
            print("初次定位到 Copy 按钮，开始检测 Related 标识...")
            gate_start = time.time()
            found_related = False
            while time.time() - gate_start < 4:
                rel_loc, _ = find(templates, "related")
                if rel_loc:
                    print("检测到 Related 标识（布局已变化），立即进行下一步。")
                    found_related = True
                    break
                sleep(0.5)
            if not found_related:
                print("4 秒内未检测到 Related 标识，准备重新定位 Copy。")

            location, shape = find(templates, "copy")
            if not location:
                print("等待后无法重新定位 Copy 按钮，检查是否回答异常...")
                if check_wrong_confirmed(templates):
                    sys.exit(EXIT_HANDOFF)
                scroll_down(cfg)
                continue        # 未实际点击，不消耗 attempt

        # ---- 4. 点击复制并校验 ----
        copy_offset = cfg.get("copy_offset", (0, 0))
        lx, ly = perform_click(location, shape, offset=copy_offset)
        print(f"第 {attempt} 次尝试 - 点击复制按钮: {lx}, {ly}")
        sleep(0.5)
        content = pyperclip.paste()

        if cfg["check_refusal_text"] and is_refusal_response(content):
            print("剪贴板命中拒答话术 -> 请求交接。")
            sys.exit(EXIT_HANDOFF)

        if is_content_qualified(content, min_chinese=target_threshold):
            print(f"第 {attempt} 次尝试成功：内容校验通过。")
            sys.exit(EXIT_OK)

        print(f"第 {attempt} 次尝试失败：内容不合格。")

        # 内容不合格时顺手检查回答异常（豆包）
        if check_wrong_confirmed(templates):
            sys.exit(EXIT_HANDOFF)

        attempt += 1
        if attempt <= MAX_ATTEMPTS:
            scroll_down(cfg, move_cursor=True)
        else:
            print("已达到最大尝试次数，内容均不合格。")
            sys.exit(EXIT_UNQUALIFIED)

    sys.exit(EXIT_UNQUALIFIED)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

本 API 兼容 OpenAI，但在参数、功能和行为上存在差异。

x-dashscope-session-cache
enum<string>默认值"disable"
控制多轮对话中的会话缓存（需配合 previous_response_id 使用）。启用后，服务器将自动缓存对话上下文，从而降低延迟和费用。

enable：启用会话缓存。缓存创建按标准输入价格的 125% 计费；缓存命中按 10% 计费。缓存有效期为 5 分钟（命中后重置）。创建缓存至少需要 1024 个 Token。
disable（默认值）：禁用会话缓存。如模型支持，则回退到隐式缓存。
支持的模型：qwen3.8-max、qwen3.8-flash、qwen3.7-max、qwen3.7-max-2026-06-08、qwen3.7-max-2026-05-20、qwen3-max、qwen3.7-plus、qwen3.7-plus-2026-05-26、qwen3.6-plus、qwen3.5-plus、qwen3.7-flash、qwen3.6-flash、qwen3.5-flash、qwen-plus、qwen-flash、qwen3-coder-plus、qwen3-coder-flash。

缓存命中规则：

Session 缓存按精确匹配命中，规则如下：

缓存键：system prompt 与 user prompt 共同构成缓存键，其中任意一项变更都会导致本轮请求不命中缓存。
前缀缓存：system prompt 作为前缀独立缓存。仅变更 previous_response_id 时，system prompt 前缀部分仍然命中缓存，只有变化的对话上下文部分会新建缓存条目；previous_response_id 不属于 system prompt 的缓存键。
精确匹配：system prompt 或 user prompt 的任意字符变更（包括空格和标点）都会使 cached_tokens 归零。
不支持前缀匹配：在原有 user prompt 之后追加内容不会命中缓存。
不支持语义匹配：只有内容完全相同才会命中缓存，语义相同但文字不同不会命中。
最小可缓存 Token 数：1024 Token。低于该阈值的输入不会触发缓存创建；多轮对话中累积上下文超过 1024 Token 后才会开始创建缓存。
您可以通过 usage.input_tokens_details.cached_tokens 查看命中缓存的 Token 数，通过 cache_creation_input_tokens 查看本次请求新创建缓存的 Token 数。

SDK 传参方式：Python 使用 default_headers，Node.js 使用 defaultHeaders。

将 DeepSeek 模型接入 Codex
请参考接入 Codex

通过 Responses API 调用 DeepSeek 模型
# Please install OpenAI SDK first: `pip3 install openai`
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(api_key="<your DeepSeek API Key>", base_url="https://api.deepseek.com")

response = client.responses.create(
    model="deepseek-v4-flash",
    instructions="You are a helpful assistant.",
    input="Hi, how are you?",
)

print(response.output_text)


流式输出
设置 stream: true，响应将以语义化的流式 SSE 事件序列返回。每个事件带有表示事件类型的 event 字段和递增的 sequence_number。流以 response.completed / response.incomplete / response.failed 事件结束，没有 data: [DONE] 消息。

stream = client.responses.create(
    model="deepseek-v4-flash",
    instructions="You are a helpful assistant.",
    input="Hi, how are you?",
    stream=True,
)

for event in stream:
    if event.type == "response.output_text.delta":
        print(event.delta, end="")

完整事件列表：

事件	说明
response.created	首个事件；响应已创建，状态为 in_progress
response.in_progress	响应正在生成中
response.output_item.added / response.output_item.done	一个输出 item（reasoning / message / function_call / custom_tool_call / web_search_call）开始 / 完成
response.content_part.added / response.content_part.done	输出 item 中的一个内容块开始 / 完成
response.reasoning_text.delta / response.reasoning_text.done	思维链文本增量 / 完整思维链文本
response.output_text.delta / response.output_text.done	输出文本增量 / 完整输出文本
response.function_call_arguments.delta / response.function_call_arguments.done	Function 调用参数增量 / 完整参数
response.custom_tool_call_input.delta / response.custom_tool_call_input.done	Custom 工具调用（apply_patch）输入增量 / 完整输入
response.web_search_call.in_progress / response.web_search_call.searching / response.web_search_call.completed	服务端联网搜索工具调用的状态更新
response.completed	响应正常完成时的最后一个事件，携带包含 usage 的完整 response 对象
response.incomplete	响应被截断（如达到 max_output_tokens）时的最后一个事件，携带完整 response 对象
response.failed	响应失败时的最后一个事件，携带含 error 详情的完整 response 对象
图片输入
Responses API 支持使用 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 模型传入图片，适用的图片限制与支持格式与对话补全一致。

图片通过 message item 中的 input_image 内容块提供，使用 image_url（http(s) URL 或 base64 data URL）或 file_id（通过 Files API 上传的图片）二者之一：

response = client.responses.create(
    model="deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp",
    input=[
        {
            "role": "user",
            "content": [
                {"type": "input_text", "text": "这张图片里有什么？"},
                {"type": "input_image", "image_url": "https://example.com/image.jpg", "detail": "low"},
            ],
        }
    ],
)
print(response.output_text)


input_image 内容块也可以出现在 function_call_output / custom_tool_call_output item 的 output 中，让模型接收你的工具生成的图片：

input=[
    {"role": "user", "content": "读取工具返回的截图。"},
    {"type": "function_call", "call_id": "fc1", "name": "take_screenshot", "arguments": "{}"},
    {"type": "function_call_output", "call_id": "fc1",
     "output": [{"type": "input_image", "image_url": "data:image/png;base64,<BASE64_DATA>"}]},
]


input_image 字段
image_url：图片的 http(s) URL（最多 8192 个字符）或 base64 编码的 data URL（data:image/jpeg;base64,...）。支持的格式：JPEG、PNG、GIF、WebP。
file_id：通过 Files API 上传的图片文件 ID，形如 file-api-...。
detail：low / high / original / auto。low 在推理前将图片缩小到 512x512；其余取值保留原图。设置 file_id 时被忽略。
image_url 与 file_id 互斥：两者都不传返回 400 错误（"input_image must have image_url or file_id"），两者都传返回 400 错误（"input_image cannot have both image_url and file_id"）。

使用限制
图片仅允许出现在 user / developer 消息 item 以及 function_call_output / custom_tool_call_output 的输出中；system / assistant 消息中的图片会返回 400 错误。
只有视觉模型（deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp）会真正处理 input_image 内容块，使用其他模型时会被替换为占位文本。
与对话补全相同的图片限制（内联单张 32 MiB、file_id 单张 64 MiB、不含 file_id 图片总计 64 MiB，含 file_id 图片最高 200 MiB、单请求 600 张等）同样适用，详见图像理解：限制。

text	部分支持。format 完整支持；verbosity 可传入但不生效
user	支持。参考限速与用户隔离
parallel_tool_calls	忽略（并行工具调用始终开启）
max_tool_calls	忽略
previous_response_id	不支持（无状态 API）
conversation	不支持（无状态 API）
store	不支持。响应中恒为 store: false
background	不支持
metadata	不支持
include	不支持
prompt	不支持
truncation	不支持。输入超出上下文窗口时返回 400 错误
service_tier	不支持
safety_identifier	不支持
prompt_cache_key / prompt_cache_retention	不支持。上下文缓存自动管理，见上下文硬盘缓存
context_management	不支持
stream_options	不支持
不支持的参数会被静默忽略、不会报错，因此现有的 Responses API 客户端无需修改即可接入。

输入 Items
类型	支持情况
message	支持。角色支持 user / assistant / system / developer（developer 视同 user）；content 支持字符串和 input_text / output_text / input_image 内容块。使用 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 模型时，input_image 内容块会作为真实图片处理（仅允许出现在 user / developer 消息中，system / assistant 消息中的图片会返回 400 错误）；使用其他模型时会被替换为占位文本。文件输入不支持
function_call	支持。归并到相邻 assistant 消息
function_call_output	支持。output 可以是字符串或内容块列表；使用 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 模型时，输出中的 input_image 内容块会作为真实图片处理
reasoning	支持。明文 content 归并到相邻 assistant 消息；summary、encrypted_content 不支持
web_search_call	支持。原样回传即可，服务端自动恢复搜索结果
custom_tool_call / custom_tool_call_output	支持（配合 apply_patch custom 工具使用，含 call_id 配对校验）。使用 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 模型时，output 中的 input_image 内容块会作为真实图片处理
其他类型	忽略
Tools
类型	支持情况
function	支持
web_search / web_search_2025_08_26	支持，服务端执行。search_context_size、user_location 忽略；服务端自动续推上限 10 轮
custom	仅支持 {"type": "custom", "name": "apply_patch"}（用于 Codex 兼容）；其他名称返回 400 错误
file_search / code_interpreter / computer_use / mcp 等其他内置工具	忽略
响应字段
响应对象与 OpenAI Responses API 的 response 结构兼容。依赖未支持能力的字段恒为固定值（如 store: false、previous_response_id: null、parallel_tool_calls: true）。

Token 用量在 usage 中返回：

input_tokens：输入 token 数，其中 input_tokens_details.cached_tokens 为命中上下文缓存的 token 数
output_tokens：输出 token 数，其中 output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens 为思维链 token 数"，我没有提到的细节或漏考虑的部分由你负责按照最佳时间来帮我设计和实现即可。总体思路就是chrome ui一版是免费的，尽量使用，但各家都有免费限额，千问最大方且不会封号，用超了最多就是不让用了，而豆包和deepseek不光抠门，还会封号，所以只有某些特殊文章才交由这俩来完成，本着能省则省，但又不能触发封号的原则，我才设计了以上规则。针对以上的需求，具体我该怎么做？ 复杂的请给我修改后的完整代码，简单的则详细告诉我该修改哪里，而且输出结果在一次对话给我全吐完，不要分两次。

-- ============================================================
-- News_Engine.scpt
-- 统一新闻总结引擎（替代 Qianwen_News.scpt / Deepseek_News.scpt / Doubao_News.scpt）
--
-- 参数： {methodType, poeMode, shouldRepeat, providerChain}
--   methodType    : "" 表示按 provider 使用各自默认 Prompt
--   poeMode       : "normal" / "cheap"
--   shouldRepeat  : true = 连续处理；false = 每篇后询问
--   providerChain : "qianwen,deepseek,doubao" 或 "deepseek,qianwen,doubao"（可省略，默认第一个）
--
-- 交接规则（v2）：
--   链条里某个 AI 拒答/异常（Python exit 5）-> 用同一篇文章内容换下一个 AI；
--   且【永久推进】链条指针：后续所有文章都直接从新的 AI 开始，不再回退到已拒答的 AI。
--   链条最后一个（兜底）也失败 -> 写日志 + 弹窗终止。
-- ============================================================

property pythonPath : "/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/Current/bin/python3"
property scriptFolder : "/Users/yanzhang/Coding/python_code/"
property screenshotScript : "/Users/yanzhang/Coding/python_code/screenshot.py"
property notifyScript : "/Users/yanzhang/Coding/python_code/Modules/notification.py"
property cliclickPath : "/opt/homebrew/bin/cliclick"
property copyFailurePath : "/Users/yanzhang/Coding/News/copy_failure.html"

-- 默认链条（没传第 4 个参数时用）
property defaultChain : "qianwen,deepseek,doubao"

-- 【开关】是否开启英文总结功能（true = 双语；false = 英文位置写原文）
property enableEnglishSummary : false

-- 【开关】内容不合格(exit 1) / 超时(exit 2) 是否也换下一个 AI 重试（仅本篇）
property handoffOnFailure : false

-- 【开关】拒答(exit 5) 是否永久切换到下一个 AI（true = 后续所有文章都用新 AI）
property permanentSwitchOnRefusal : true

-- 【开关】exit 1 / exit 2 触发的交接是否也永久切换（默认 false：只对当前这篇换人）
property permanentSwitchOnFailure : false

-- 运行期状态
property consecutiveErrors : 0
property qwContinueChecked : false
-- 【核心】当前链条起点（跨文章持久），1 = 链条第一个 provider
property providerStartIndex : 1


on run argv
	set consecutiveErrors to 0
	set qwContinueChecked to false
	set providerStartIndex to 1
	
	set methodType to ""
	set poeMode to "normal"
	set shouldRepeat to false
	set chainText to defaultChain
	
	if (count of argv) ≥ 1 then set methodType to (item 1 of argv) as text
	if (count of argv) ≥ 2 then set poeMode to (item 2 of argv) as text
	if (count of argv) ≥ 3 then
		try
			set shouldRepeat to (item 3 of argv) as boolean
		on error
			set shouldRepeat to (((item 3 of argv) as text) is "true")
		end try
	end if
	if (count of argv) ≥ 4 then
		set t to (item 4 of argv) as text
		if t is not "" then set chainText to t
	end if
	
	set providerChain to my SplitText(chainText, ",")
	if (count of providerChain) is 0 then set providerChain to my SplitText(defaultChain, ",")
	
	-- 短文章用的翻译 Prompt
	set methodType2 to "----请将以上内容完整翻译成地道的中文，只是翻译，其它话都不要说"
	
	if shouldRepeat then
		repeat
			if my shouldStopByFile() then exit repeat
			set stopNow to my NewsOperation(methodType, poeMode, methodType2, providerChain)
			if stopNow then exit repeat
		end repeat
	else
		repeat
			if my shouldStopByFile() then exit repeat
			set stopNow to my NewsOperation(methodType, poeMode, methodType2, providerChain)
			if stopNow then exit repeat
			if my shouldStopByFile() then exit repeat
			
			set userResponse to display dialog "已成功处理一个页面。" & return & "是否继续处理下一个？" buttons {"终止", "继续"} default button "继续" cancel button "终止"
			if button returned of userResponse is "终止" then exit repeat
		end repeat
	end if
end run


-- ============================================================
-- 处理一篇文章；返回 true 表示要终止外层循环
-- ============================================================
on NewsOperation(methodType, poeMode, methodType2, providerChain)
	set targetWebsites to {"nytimes.com", "nikkei.com", "bloomberg.com", "technologyreview.com", "economist.com", "hbr.org", "ft.com", "wsj.com", "reuters.com", "washingtonpost.com", "asia.nikkei.com", "rfi.fr", "dw.com", "bbc.com"}
	
	set foundWebsiteName to ""
	set foundTabId to -1
	set containsTargetWebsite to false
	set currentTabURL to ""
	
	tell application "Google Chrome"
		activate
		delay 0.2
		set tabList to every tab of front window
		
		repeat with i from 1 to the count of tabList
			set tabURL to URL of item i of tabList
			repeat with website in targetWebsites
				if tabURL contains website then
					set tld to text -3 thru -1 of website
					set pos to offset of tld in tabURL
					if pos ≠ 0 then
						set domainLength to length of website
						set startOfPostDomain to pos + domainLength - 3
						if length of tabURL ≥ startOfPostDomain + 7 then
							set currentTabURL to tabURL
							set containsTargetWebsite to true
							set foundWebsiteName to website
							set active tab index of front window to i
							set foundTabId to id of item i of tabList
							exit repeat
						end if
					end if
				end if
			end repeat
			if containsTargetWebsite then exit repeat
		end repeat
	end tell
	
	if not containsTargetWebsite then
		my Notify("没有可供总结的新闻页面了", "green", 2000)
		return true
	end if
	
	my handlename(foundWebsiteName, currentTabURL)
	set the clipboard to currentTabURL
	
	if currentTabURL contains "www.wsj.com/video/" then
		tell application "Google Chrome"
			close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
		end tell
		delay 0.5
		return false
	end if
	
	-- ==========================================================
	-- 分支 1：英文站点（需要 AI 总结）
	-- ==========================================================
	if currentTabURL contains "ft.com" or currentTabURL contains "technologyreview.com" or currentTabURL contains "economist.com" or currentTabURL contains "www.wsj.com" or currentTabURL contains "reuters.com" or currentTabURL contains "washingtonpost.com" or currentTabURL contains "asia.nikkei.com" or currentTabURL contains "bloomberg.com" or currentTabURL contains "nytimes.com" then
		
		if currentTabURL contains "reuters.com/pictures/" then
			my Scroll(5)
			delay 1
		else if currentTabURL contains "wsj.com" then
			my Scroll(1)
		else
			my Scroll(2)
		end if
		delay 0.2
		
		if currentTabURL contains "ft.com" then
			my OperationForFT()
		else
			my Operation()
		end if
		delay 0.2
		
		-- 关键词屏蔽检查
		try
			my runPythonScript("Clipboard_keyword_check.py", {currentTabURL})
		on error
			my Notify("包含屏蔽关键词，已跳过此文章", "red", 3000)
			tell application "Google Chrome"
				close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
			end tell
			my MoveImagesToTrash()
			return false
		end try
		
		my runPythonScript("Article_Copier.py", {currentTabURL})
		my runPythonScript("Clipboard_count_news.py", {})
		
		set filePathsuperlong to "/tmp/superlongarticle.txt"
		set filePathlong to "/tmp/longarticle.txt"
		set filePathshort to "/tmp/shortarticle.txt"
		
		set finalMethodType to methodType
		set finalPoeMode to poeMode
		
		set hasShort to false
		set hasLong to false
		set hasSuperlong to false
		
		tell application "System Events"
			if exists file filePathshort then
				delete file filePathshort
				set hasShort to true
			else if exists file filePathlong then
				delete file filePathlong
				set hasLong to true
			else if exists file filePathsuperlong then
				delete file filePathsuperlong
				set hasSuperlong to true
			end if
		end tell
		
		if hasShort then
			set finalMethodType to methodType2
			set finalPoeMode to "cheap"
			set model to my API_Model(finalPoeMode)
		else if hasLong then
			set model to my API_Model(poeMode)
		else if hasSuperlong then
			set finalPoeMode to "cheap"
			set model to my API_Model(finalPoeMode)
		else
			my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, "文章太短")
			my Notify("文章太短，已跳过此文章", "orange", 2000)
			tell application "Google Chrome"
				close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
			end tell
			delay 0.5
			return false
		end if
		
		-- 原始文章内容（交接时复用，不用再复制页面）
		set rawArticleContent to the clipboard
		
		set autoWaitParam to "50"
		if currentTabURL contains "reuters.com/pictures" then set autoWaitParam to "10"
		
		set chainResult to my SummarizeWithChain(providerChain, finalMethodType, rawArticleContent, autoWaitParam, currentTabURL)
		if chainResult is not "ok" then return true
		
		-- ================= 英文部分 =================
		if enableEnglishSummary is true then
			set englishMethodType to "----Please summarize this article in English detailedly (retain key data)."
			set englishInput to "<document>" & rawArticleContent & "</document>" & englishMethodType
			
			set pythonResultEnglish to my runPythonScript("Modules/API_Poe_Close.py", {model, englishInput})
			
			if pythonResultEnglish contains "POE_RESPONSE_COMPLETE" then
				set consecutiveErrors to 0
				my runPythonScript("Append_English_News.py", {})
				tell application "Google Chrome"
					close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
				end tell
				delay 0.5
			else
				set consecutiveErrors to consecutiveErrors + 1
				log "中文成功，但英文 API 失败。累计错误: " & consecutiveErrors
				if consecutiveErrors is greater than or equal to 3 then
					display dialog "⚠️ 警告：API (英文阶段) 已连续报错 3 次。" & return & return & "程序将强制终止。" buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
					error number -128
				end if
			end if
		else
			set the clipboard to rawArticleContent
			delay 0.2
			my runPythonScript("Append_English_News.py", {})
			set consecutiveErrors to 0
			tell application "Google Chrome"
				close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
			end tell
			delay 0.5
		end if
		
		-- ==========================================================
		-- 分支 2：中文站点（不走 AI）
		-- ==========================================================
	else if currentTabURL contains "cn.wsj.com" or currentTabURL contains "rfi.fr" or currentTabURL contains "dw.com" or currentTabURL contains "bbc.com/zhongwen" then
		my Scroll(1)
		delay 0.5
		my Operation()
		
		try
			my runPythonScript("Clipboard_keyword_check.py", {currentTabURL})
		on error
			my Notify("包含屏蔽关键词，已跳过此文章", "red", 3000)
			tell application "Google Chrome"
				close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
			end tell
			my MoveImagesToTrash()
			return false
		end try
		
		set checkChineseScript to "
import sys, subprocess

text = subprocess.run(['pbpaste'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout

cn_count = sum(1 for c in text if 0x4e00 <= ord(c) <= 0x9fff or 
                                  0x3400 <= ord(c) <= 0x4dbf or 
                                  0xf900 <= ord(c) <= 0xfaff or 
                                  0x3000 <= ord(c) <= 0x303f or 
                                  0xff00 <= ord(c) <= 0xffef)

en_count = sum(1 for c in text if c.isascii() and c.isalpha())

total_valid = cn_count + en_count

if total_valid == 0:
    sys.exit(1)

if en_count / total_valid > 1/2:
    sys.exit(1)

sys.exit(0)
"
		try
			do shell script quoted form of pythonPath & " -c " & quoted form of checkChineseScript
		on error
			my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, "非中文内容过多")
			my Notify("非中文内容过多，已跳过此文章", "red", 3000)
			tell application "Google Chrome"
				close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
			end tell
			return false
		end try
		
		my runPythonScript("Article_Copier.py", {currentTabURL})
		my Notify("等待下载图片....", "blue", 5000)
		my runPythonScript("CN_copy_News.py", {currentTabURL})
		delay 0.5
		tell application "Google Chrome"
			close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
		end tell
	end if
	
	return false
end NewsOperation


-- ============================================================
-- 按 provider 链条依次尝试；返回 "ok" 或 "stop"
-- 【v2】起点使用跨文章持久的 providerStartIndex；
--       拒答后永久推进 providerStartIndex，后续文章不再回退。
-- ============================================================
on SummarizeWithChain(providerChain, finalMethodType, rawArticleContent, autoWaitParam, currentTabURL)
	set providerCount to count of providerChain
	
	-- 边界保护
	if providerStartIndex < 1 then set providerStartIndex to 1
	if providerStartIndex > providerCount then set providerStartIndex to providerCount
	
	repeat with idx from providerStartIndex to providerCount
		set providerName to item idx of providerChain
		
		-- 1) 组装 Prompt（methodType 为空则用该 provider 的默认 Prompt）
		set promptText to finalMethodType
		if promptText is "" then set promptText to my DefaultPrompt(providerName)
		set the clipboard to (quote & rawArticleContent & quote & promptText)
		delay 0.2
		
		-- 2) 打开/切换到对应 AI 页面并提交
		my PrepareProvider(providerName)
		
		-- 3) 等待回答 & 抓取
		set stepOK to true
		try
			my WaitSummaryReady(providerName)
			my runPythonScript("News_auto.py", {providerName, autoWaitParam})
		on error errMsg number errNum
			set stepOK to false
			
			set isRefusal to (errNum is 5)
			set needHandoff to isRefusal
			if handoffOnFailure is true and (errNum is 1 or errNum is 2) then set needHandoff to true
			
			if needHandoff then
				if idx < providerCount then
					set nextProvider to item (idx + 1) of providerChain
					
					-- 判定本次交接是否要「永久」推进链条指针
					set doPermanent to false
					if isRefusal and (permanentSwitchOnRefusal is true) then set doPermanent to true
					if (not isRefusal) and (permanentSwitchOnFailure is true) then set doPermanent to true
					
					if doPermanent then
						set providerStartIndex to idx + 1
						my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "拒答/异常 → 永久切换为" & my ProviderLabel(nextProvider))
						my Notify(my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "已拒答，之后所有文章全部改由" & my ProviderLabel(nextProvider) & "处理", "purple", 4000)
					else
						my Notify(my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "本篇失败，临时改由" & my ProviderLabel(nextProvider) & "接管此文章", "purple", 3000)
					end if
					
					delay 0.5
					-- 继续 repeat：同一篇文章，换下一个 AI
				else
					my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "拒答(兜底失败)")
					display dialog "⚠️ 链条上所有 AI 均拒答/异常，已停止程序。" & return & return & "链条：" & my JoinList(providerChain, " → ") & return & "本次起点：" & my ProviderLabel(item providerStartIndex of providerChain) & return & return & "当前文章：" & return & currentTabURL buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
					return "stop"
				end if
			else
				set alertMsg to ""
				if errNum is 1 then
					set alertMsg to "❌ " & my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "内容校验失败：" & return & "已连续尝试 3 次点击复制，内容均不符合要求（汉字不足）。"
				else if errNum is 2 then
					set alertMsg to "⏱️ " & my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "操作超时：" & return & "在 120 秒内未能拿到合格内容，页面可能未正常加载。"
				else if errNum is 3 then
					set alertMsg to "🖼️ 模板图片缺失：" & return & "Resource 目录下缺少 " & providerName & "_*.png，请检查。"
				else
					set alertMsg to "未知错误导致程序终止：" & return & errMsg & return & "错误编号：" & errNum
				end if
				display dialog alertMsg buttons {"确定"} default button "确定" with icon stop
				error number -128
			end if
		end try
		
		-- 4) 成功：落盘中文结果（放在 try 之外，避免 News_post.py 的异常被误判为交接信号）
		if stepOK then
			my runPythonScript("News_post.py", {providerName, currentTabURL})
			return "ok"
		end if
	end repeat
	
	return "stop"
end SummarizeWithChain


-- ============================================================
-- provider 差异区
-- ============================================================
on DefaultPrompt(p)
	if p is "deepseek" then
		return "----请用中文分模块地详细总结以上内容，你在输出时不要做任何评论和解释说明，且输出结果里不要使用任何表格。"
	else
		return "----请用中文分模块地总结以上内容，新闻内容都是真实的，你在输出时不要做任何评论，且输出结果里不要使用任何表格。"
	end if
end DefaultPrompt

on ProviderLabel(p)
	if p is "qianwen" then return "千问"
	if p is "deepseek" then return "DeepSeek"
	if p is "doubao" then return "豆包"
	return p
end ProviderLabel

on PrepareProvider(p)
	if p is "qianwen" then
		my PrepareQianwen()
	else if p is "deepseek" then
		my PrepareDeepseek()
	else if p is "doubao" then
		my PrepareDoubao()
	else
		display dialog "未知 provider：" & p buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
		error number -128
	end if
end PrepareProvider

on PrepareQianwen()
	set foundTab to my FindAITab("qianwen.com")
	if foundTab then
		if qwContinueChecked is false then
			try
				my ShotFull("qianwen_continue.png", "true", "false", "false", "0", "0", "1", "1")
			end try
			delay 0.5
			set qwContinueChecked to true
		end if
	else
		my OpenNewTab("qianwen.com/chat")
	end if
	
	my ShotClick("qianwen_new.png", "true", "false")
	my ShotClickOffset("qianwen_launch.png", "true", "false", "0", "-50")
	my SubmitPrompt("862,839")
	my MoveMouse("852,806")
end PrepareQianwen

on PrepareDeepseek()
	set foundTab to my FindAITab("deepseek.com")
	if not foundTab then
		my OpenNewTab("chat.deepseek.com")
	end if
	
	my ShotClick("deepseek_new.png", "true", "false")
	my ShotClickOffset("deepseek_launch.png", "true", "false", "0", "-71")
	my SubmitPrompt("939,810")
	my MoveMouse("939,810")
end PrepareDeepseek

on PrepareDoubao()
	set foundTab to my FindAITab("doubao.com")
	if foundTab then
		my GotoURLInCurrentTab("doubao.com/chat/")
	else
		my OpenNewTab("doubao.com/chat/")
	end if

on SplitText(theText, delim)

	set AppleScript's text item delimiters to oldDelims
	
	set outList to {}

		if t is not "" then set end of outList to t
	end repeat
	return outList
end SplitText

on JoinList(theList, sep)
	set outText to ""
	repeat with i from 1 to count of theList
		if i > 1 then set outText to outText & sep
		set outText to outText & (item i of theList)
	end repeat
	return outText
end JoinList

on TrimText(t)
	set t to t as text
	repeat while t starts with " "
		if (length of t) is 1 then return ""
		set t to text 2 thru -1 of t
	end repeat
	repeat while t ends with " "
		if (length of t) is 1 then return ""
		set t to text 1 thru -2 of t
	end repeat
	return t
end TrimText

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
统一的「等待 AI 回答 → 点击复制 → 校验剪贴板」自动化脚本
替代 Qianwen_auto.py / Deepseek_auto.py / Doubao_auto.py

用法:
    News_auto.py <provider> [min_chinese]
        provider    : qianwen | deepseek | doubao
        min_chinese : 合格所需最少汉字数，默认 50

退出码:
    0  成功，剪贴板内容合格
    1  连续 3 次点击复制，内容均不合格
    2  超时（TIMEOUT_DURATION 秒内没拿到合格内容）
    3  模板图片缺失 / provider 名称错误
    5  需要交接（AI 拒答 或 回答异常）
"""

import os
import re
import sys
import time
from time import sleep

import cv2
import numpy as np
import pyautogui
import pyperclip
from PIL import ImageGrab

# ================= 全局配置 =================
USER_HOME = os.path.expanduser("~")
BASE_RESOURCE_DIR = os.path.join(USER_HOME, "Coding", "python_code", "Resource")

SCROLL_AMOUNT = -120        # 滚动幅度
MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3            # 最多点击复制次数
TIMEOUT_DURATION = 120      # 总超时（秒）

# ================= 退出码 =================
EXIT_OK = 0
EXIT_UNQUALIFIED = 1
EXIT_TIMEOUT = 2
EXIT_TEMPLATE_MISSING = 3
EXIT_HANDOFF = 5

# ================= provider 差异配置 =================
# templates: key -> (文件名, 匹配阈值, 是否必需)
PROVIDERS = {
    "qianwen": {
        "label": "千问",
        "templates": {
            "copy":       ("qianwen_copy.png",       0.90, True),
            "forbidden":  ("qianwen_forbidden.png",  0.90, True),
            "forbidden2": ("qianwen_forbidden2.png", 0.90, True),
            "retry":      ("qianwen_retry.png",      0.90, True),
            "timeout":    ("qianwen_timeout.png",    0.90, True),
        },
        "check_refusal_text": True,     # 剪贴板文本命中拒答话术 -> 交接
        "refresh_on_stall": True,       # 见到 retry / timeout 图 -> 等 15s 后 Cmd+R
        "related_gate": False,          # 复制按钮出现后是否等待 related 图再重定位
        "cursor_before_scroll": (709, 749),  # 内容不合格重试前把鼠标移到这里再滚动
        "copy_offset": (0, 0),
    },
    "deepseek": {
        "label": "DeepSeek",
        "templates": {
            "copy":       ("deepseek_copy.png",       0.90, True),
        },
        "check_refusal_text": True,
        "refresh_on_stall": True,
        "related_gate": False,
        "cursor_before_scroll": (709, 749),
        "copy_offset": (-35, 0),        # 靠左 35 像素点击
    },
    "doubao": {
        "label": "豆包",
        "templates": {
            "copy":    ("doubao_copy.png",    0.90, True),
            "related": ("doubao_related.png", 0.80, True),
            "wrong":   ("doubao_wrong.png",   0.88, False),   # 可选：回答异常标识
        },
        "check_refusal_text": True,
        "refresh_on_stall": False,
        "related_gate": True,
        "cursor_before_scroll": None,
        "copy_offset": (0, 0),
    },
}

# 拒答话术（三家共用）
REFUSAL_PHRASES = [
    "抱歉，我无法回答这个问题，我们聊聊别的吧",
    "抱歉，我无法回答这个问题",
    "我们聊聊别的吧",
    "无法回答这个问题",
    "不能回答这个问题",
    "无法协助处理该请求",
    "我无法协助完成该请求",
    "我不能协助完成该请求",
    "该内容无法处理",
    "很抱歉，我不能",
    "很抱歉，我无法",
]


# ================= 基础工具 =================
def get_scale_factor():
    """ImageGrab(物理像素) 与 pyautogui(逻辑坐标) 的比例。Retina 通常 2.0。"""
    try:
        with ImageGrab.grab() as sc:
            img_width = sc.size[0]
        screen_width, _ = pyautogui.size()
        return img_width / screen_width
    except Exception:
        return 1.0


SCALE_FACTOR = get_scale_factor()


def capture_screen():
    with ImageGrab.grab() as screenshot:
        img_np = np.array(screenshot)
        if img_np.ndim == 3 and img_np.shape[2] == 4:
            return cv2.cvtColor(img_np, cv2.COLOR_RGBA2BGR)
        return cv2.cvtColor(img_np, cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)


def match_template(template, threshold, screen=None):
    """返回 (max_loc, shape) 或 (None, None)"""
    if template is None:
        return None, None
    if screen is None:
        screen = capture_screen()
    if template.shape[0] > screen.shape[0] or template.shape[1] > screen.shape[1]:
        return None, None
    result = cv2.matchTemplate(screen, template, cv2.TM_CCOEFF_NORMED)
    _, max_val, _, max_loc = cv2.minMaxLoc(result)
    if max_val >= threshold:
        return max_loc, template.shape
    return None, None


def load_templates(cfg):
    """按配置加载模板，返回 {key: (img, threshold)}；缺必需模板则直接退出。"""
    loaded = {}
    for key, (filename, threshold, required) in cfg["templates"].items():
        path = os.path.join(BASE_RESOURCE_DIR, filename)
        img = None
        if os.path.exists(path):
            img = cv2.imread(path, cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
        if img is None:
            if required:
                print(f"错误：模板文件缺失或无法读取 -> {path}")
                sys.exit(EXIT_TEMPLATE_MISSING)
            print(f"警告：可选模板不可用 -> {path}，该检测自动关闭。")
            loaded[key] = (None, threshold)
            continue
        loaded[key] = (img, threshold)
    return loaded


def find(templates, key, screen=None):
    if key not in templates:
        return None, None
    img, threshold = templates[key]
    return match_template(img, threshold, screen=screen)


def is_refusal_response(text: str) -> bool:
    if not text:
        return False
    normalized = re.sub(r'\s+', '', text)
    return any(p in normalized for p in REFUSAL_PHRASES)


def is_content_qualified(text, min_chinese=50) -> bool:
    if not text:
        return False
    return len(re.findall(r'[\u4e00-\u9fff]', text)) > min_chinese


def perform_click(location, shape, offset=(0, 0)):
    phys_x = location[0] + shape[1] // 2
    phys_y = location[1] + shape[0] // 2
    lx = int(phys_x / SCALE_FACTOR)
    ly = int(phys_y / SCALE_FACTOR)
    
    if offset:
        lx += offset[0]
        ly += offset[1]
        
    pyautogui.click(lx, ly)
    return lx, ly


def refresh_page_mac():
    os.system("""osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to key code 15 using command down'""")


def scroll_down(cfg, move_cursor=False):
    pos = cfg.get("cursor_before_scroll")
    if move_cursor and pos:
        print(f"移动光标到 {pos} 并向下滚屏...")
        pyautogui.moveTo(pos[0], pos[1])
    pyautogui.scroll(SCROLL_AMOUNT)
    sleep(1)


# ================= 豆包专用：回答异常二次确认 =================
def check_wrong_confirmed(templates):
    """
    1) 命中 wrong 后等 1.5s
    2) 复查时优先看 copy（复制按钮出现则以 copy 为准）
    3) copy 仍无、wrong 仍在 -> 确认异常
    """
    if templates.get("wrong", (None, 0))[0] is None:
        return False

    loc, _ = find(templates, "wrong")
    if not loc:
        return False

    print("疑似检测到 wrong 标识，1.5 秒后二次确认...")
    sleep(1.5)

    copy_loc, _ = find(templates, "copy")
    if copy_loc:
        print("二次确认时发现 Copy 按钮已出现，忽略 wrong 标识。")
        return False

    loc2, _ = find(templates, "wrong")
    if loc2:
        print("二次确认成立：AI 回答异常。")
        return True

    print("二次确认不成立（wrong 已消失），继续正常流程。")
    return False


# ================= 主流程 =================
def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("用法: News_auto.py <qianwen|deepseek|doubao> [min_chinese]")
        sys.exit(EXIT_TEMPLATE_MISSING)

    provider = sys.argv[1].strip().lower()
    if provider not in PROVIDERS:
        print(f"错误：未知 provider '{provider}'，可选：{list(PROVIDERS.keys())}")
        sys.exit(EXIT_TEMPLATE_MISSING)

    cfg = PROVIDERS[provider]

    target_threshold = 50
    if len(sys.argv) > 2:
        try:
            target_threshold = int(sys.argv[2])
        except ValueError:
            print("汉字阈值参数格式错误，使用默认 50")

    templates = load_templates(cfg)

    print(f"[{cfg['label']}] 缩放因子={SCALE_FACTOR}，最多 {MAX_ATTEMPTS} 次，汉字阈值={target_threshold}")

    attempt = 1
    start_time = time.time()

    while attempt <= MAX_ATTEMPTS:
        if time.time() - start_time > TIMEOUT_DURATION:
            print("寻找超时：未能在规定时间内完成任务")
            sys.exit(EXIT_TIMEOUT)

        screen = capture_screen()

        # ---- 1. 拒答图标（forbidden / forbidden2）优先 ----
        forbidden_hit = None
        for key in ("forbidden", "forbidden2"):
            loc, _ = find(templates, key, screen=screen)
            if loc:
                forbidden_hit = key
                break
        if forbidden_hit:
            print(f"检测到 {forbidden_hit} 图片，判定为拒答 -> 请求交接。")
            sys.exit(EXIT_HANDOFF)

        # ---- 2. retry / timeout：等 15 秒后刷新页面 ----
        if cfg["refresh_on_stall"]:
            stall_hit = None
            for key in ("retry", "timeout"):
                loc, _ = find(templates, key, screen=screen)
                if loc:
                    stall_hit = key
                    break
            if stall_hit:
                print(f"检测到 {stall_hit} 图片，等待 15 秒后刷新页面...")
                sleep(15)
                refresh_page_mac()
                sleep(5)
                continue        # 刷新不消耗 attempt

        # ---- 3. Copy 按钮 ----
        location, shape = find(templates, "copy", screen=screen)

        if not location:
            # 连复制按钮都没有 -> 检查回答异常（豆包）
            if check_wrong_confirmed(templates):
                sys.exit(EXIT_HANDOFF)
            scroll_down(cfg)
            continue

        # ---- 3.1 豆包：等 related 标识后重新定位 copy（布局会被挤压）----
        if cfg["related_gate"]:
            print("初次定位到 Copy 按钮，开始检测 Related 标识...")
            gate_start = time.time()
            found_related = False
            while time.time() - gate_start < 4:
                rel_loc, _ = find(templates, "related")
                if rel_loc:
                    print("检测到 Related 标识（布局已变化），立即进行下一步。")
                    found_related = True
                    break
                sleep(0.5)
            if not found_related:
                print("4 秒内未检测到 Related 标识，准备重新定位 Copy。")

            location, shape = find(templates, "copy")
            if not location:
                print("等待后无法重新定位 Copy 按钮，检查是否回答异常...")
                if check_wrong_confirmed(templates):
                    sys.exit(EXIT_HANDOFF)
                scroll_down(cfg)
                continue        # 未实际点击，不消耗 attempt

        # ---- 4. 点击复制并校验 ----
        copy_offset = cfg.get("copy_offset", (0, 0))
        lx, ly = perform_click(location, shape, offset=copy_offset)
        print(f"第 {attempt} 次尝试 - 点击复制按钮: {lx}, {ly}")
        sleep(0.5)
        content = pyperclip.paste()

        if cfg["check_refusal_text"] and is_refusal_response(content):
            print("剪贴板命中拒答话术 -> 请求交接。")
            sys.exit(EXIT_HANDOFF)

        if is_content_qualified(content, min_chinese=target_threshold):
            print(f"第 {attempt} 次尝试成功：内容校验通过。")
            sys.exit(EXIT_OK)

        print(f"第 {attempt} 次尝试失败：内容不合格。")

        # 内容不合格时顺手检查回答异常（豆包）
        if check_wrong_confirmed(templates):
            sys.exit(EXIT_HANDOFF)

        attempt += 1
        if attempt <= MAX_ATTEMPTS:
            scroll_down(cfg, move_cursor=True)
        else:
            print("已达到最大尝试次数，内容均不合格。")
            sys.exit(EXIT_UNQUALIFIED)

    sys.exit(EXIT_UNQUALIFIED)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

		set poeMode to item 2 of argv as text
		set shouldRepeat to item 3 of argv as boolean
	else
		-- 处理参数不足的情况
		error "参数不足，需要至少三个参数。"
	end if
	
	if shouldRepeat then
		repeat

		end repeat

		-- ==================================================
		-- 新增修改 3: 在调用 NewsOperation 时传入 methodType2
		-- ==================================================
		-- 当第三个参数为 false 时，执行新的交互式循环模式
		repeat
			-- 执行一次新闻处理操作
			set stopNow to my NewsOperation(methodType, poeMode, methodType2)

			set userResponse to display dialog "已成功处理一个页面。" & return & "是否继续处理下一个？" buttons {"终止", "继续"} default button "继续" cancel button "终止"
			
			-- 如果用户选择“终止”或关闭了对话框，则退出循环
			if button returned of userResponse is "终止" then
				exit repeat
			end if
			
			-- 如果用户选择“继续”，循环会自然进入下一次迭代
		end repeat
	end if
end run

	-- 定义一个变量来保存找到的网站名称
	set foundWebsiteName to ""
	set foundTabId to -1 -- 用于精准记录目标标签页的 ID
	set containsTargetWebsite to false
	set currentTabURL to ""
	
	tell application "Google Chrome"
		activate
		delay 0.2
		set tabList to every tab of front window
		
		-- 遍历所有标签页
		repeat with i from 1 to the count of tabList
			set tabURL to URL of item i of tabList
			-- 检查URL是否包含目标网站之一
			repeat with website in targetWebsites
				if tabURL contains website then
					-- 提取网站顶级域名的最后三个字符
					set tld to text -3 thru -1 of website
					set pos to offset of tld in tabURL
					if pos ≠ 0 then
						set domainLength to length of website
						set startOfPostDomain to pos + domainLength - 3
						if length of tabURL ≥ startOfPostDomain + 7 then -- 检查.com后面至少还有两个字符
							set currentTabURL to tabURL
							set containsTargetWebsite to true
							set foundWebsiteName to website
							set active tab index of front window to i
							
							-- 【核心修改：记录 ID】
							set foundTabId to id of item i of tabList
							
							exit repeat

			set CopyFailurePath to "/Users/yanzhang/Coding/News/copy_failure.txt"
			
			set finalMethodType to methodType

			tell application "System Events"
				if exists file filePathshort then
					delete file filePathshort
					
					-- 因为是短文章，所以我们将最终提示语改为翻译
					set finalMethodType to methodType2
					-- ==================================================

enum<string>默认值"disable"
控制多轮对话中的会话缓存（需配合 previous_response_id 使用）。启用后，服务器将自动缓存对话上下文，从而降低延迟和费用。

enable：启用会话缓存。缓存创建按标准输入价格的 125% 计费；缓存命中按 10% 计费。缓存有效期为 5 分钟（命中后重置）。创建缓存至少需要 1024 个 Token。

缓存命中规则：

Session 缓存按精确匹配命中，规则如下：

缓存键：system prompt 与 user prompt 共同构成缓存键，其中任意一项变更都会导致本轮请求不命中缓存。
前缀缓存：system prompt 作为前缀独立缓存。仅变更 previous_response_id 时，system prompt 前缀部分仍然命中缓存，只有变化的对话上下文部分会新建缓存条目；previous_response_id 不属于 system prompt 的缓存键。
精确匹配：system prompt 或 user prompt 的任意字符变更（包括空格和标点）都会使 cached_tokens 归零。
不支持前缀匹配：在原有 user prompt 之后追加内容不会命中缓存。
不支持语义匹配：只有内容完全相同才会命中缓存，语义相同但文字不同不会命中。
最小可缓存 Token 数：1024 Token。低于该阈值的输入不会触发缓存创建；多轮对话中累积上下文超过 1024 Token 后才会开始创建缓存。
您可以通过 usage.input_tokens_details.cached_tokens 查看命中缓存的 Token 数，通过 cache_creation_input_tokens 查看本次请求新创建缓存的 Token 数。

流式输出
设置 stream: true，响应将以语义化的流式 SSE 事件序列返回。每个事件带有表示事件类型的 event 字段和递增的 sequence_number。流以 response.completed / response.incomplete / response.failed 事件结束，没有 data: [DONE] 消息。

stream = client.responses.create(
    model="deepseek-v4-flash",
    instructions="You are a helpful assistant.",
    input="Hi, how are you?",
    stream=True,
)

for event in stream:
    if event.type == "response.output_text.delta":
        print(event.delta, end="")

完整事件列表：

事件	说明
response.created	首个事件；响应已创建，状态为 in_progress
response.in_progress	响应正在生成中
response.output_item.added / response.output_item.done	一个输出 item（reasoning / message / function_call / custom_tool_call / web_search_call）开始 / 完成
response.content_part.added / response.content_part.done	输出 item 中的一个内容块开始 / 完成
response.reasoning_text.delta / response.reasoning_text.done	思维链文本增量 / 完整思维链文本
response.output_text.delta / response.output_text.done	输出文本增量 / 完整输出文本
response.function_call_arguments.delta / response.function_call_arguments.done	Function 调用参数增量 / 完整参数
response.custom_tool_call_input.delta / response.custom_tool_call_input.done	Custom 工具调用（apply_patch）输入增量 / 完整输入
response.web_search_call.in_progress / response.web_search_call.searching / response.web_search_call.completed	服务端联网搜索工具调用的状态更新
response.completed	响应正常完成时的最后一个事件，携带包含 usage 的完整 response 对象
response.incomplete	响应被截断（如达到 max_output_tokens）时的最后一个事件，携带完整 response 对象
response.failed	响应失败时的最后一个事件，携带含 error 详情的完整 response 对象
图片输入
Responses API 支持使用 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 模型传入图片，适用的图片限制与支持格式与对话补全一致。

图片通过 message item 中的 input_image 内容块提供，使用 image_url（http(s) URL 或 base64 data URL）或 file_id（通过 Files API 上传的图片）二者之一：

response = client.responses.create(
    model="deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp",
    input=[
        {
            "role": "user",
            "content": [
                {"type": "input_text", "text": "这张图片里有什么？"},
                {"type": "input_image", "image_url": "https://example.com/image.jpg", "detail": "low"},
            ],
        }
    ],
)
print(response.output_text)


input_image 内容块也可以出现在 function_call_output / custom_tool_call_output item 的 output 中，让模型接收你的工具生成的图片：

input=[
    {"role": "user", "content": "读取工具返回的截图。"},
    {"type": "function_call", "call_id": "fc1", "name": "take_screenshot", "arguments": "{}"},
    {"type": "function_call_output", "call_id": "fc1",
     "output": [{"type": "input_image", "image_url": "data:image/png;base64,<BASE64_DATA>"}]},
]


input_image 字段
image_url：图片的 http(s) URL（最多 8192 个字符）或 base64 编码的 data URL（data:image/jpeg;base64,...）。支持的格式：JPEG、PNG、GIF、WebP。
file_id：通过 Files API 上传的图片文件 ID，形如 file-api-...。
detail：low / high / original / auto。low 在推理前将图片缩小到 512x512；其余取值保留原图。设置 file_id 时被忽略。
image_url 与 file_id 互斥：两者都不传返回 400 错误（"input_image must have image_url or file_id"），两者都传返回 400 错误（"input_image cannot have both image_url and file_id"）。

使用限制
图片仅允许出现在 user / developer 消息 item 以及 function_call_output / custom_tool_call_output 的输出中；system / assistant 消息中的图片会返回 400 错误。
只有视觉模型（deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp）会真正处理 input_image 内容块，使用其他模型时会被替换为占位文本。
与对话补全相同的图片限制（内联单张 32 MiB、file_id 单张 64 MiB、不含 file_id 图片总计 64 MiB，含 file_id 图片最高 200 MiB、单请求 600 张等）同样适用，详见图像理解：限制。

-- 统一新闻总结引擎：同时支持「Chrome 网页 AI」与「OpenAI 兼容 API」
--
-- 参数： {methodType, poeMode, shouldRepeat, providerChain}
--   methodType    : "" 表示按 provider 使用各自默认 Prompt
--   poeMode       : "normal" / "cheap"（只影响 API 的模型档位）
--   shouldRepeat  : true = 连续处理；false = 每篇后询问

--   xxx_api -> OpenAI 兼容 API（走 Modules/API_Client.py，付费）

--

--   0 成功 / 1 内容不合格 / 2 超时 / 3 依赖或参数错误 / 4 API 错误 / 5 拒答需交接 / 6 用户中止

-- 链条调度：返回 "ok" 或 "stop"

on SummarizeWithChain(finalMethodType, rawArticleContent, autoWaitParam, currentTabURL, poeMode)
	set providerCount to count of chainNames
	if providerCount is 0 then
		display dialog "provider 链条为空，请检查参数。" buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
		error number -128
	end if
	
	if providerStartIndex < 1 then set providerStartIndex to 1
	if providerStartIndex > providerCount then set providerStartIndex to providerCount
	
	set startIdx to providerStartIndex
	set lastFailIdx to 0
	set lastFailWasRefusal to false
	
	repeat with idx from startIdx to providerCount
		set providerName to item idx of chainNames
		set stepOK to true
		set errNumKept to 0
		set errMsgKept to ""
		
		try
			my ExecuteProvider(providerName, finalMethodType, rawArticleContent, autoWaitParam, poeMode)
		on error errMsg number errNum
			set stepOK to false
			set errNumKept to errNum
			set errMsgKept to errMsg
		end try
		
		-- ---------- 成功 ----------
		if stepOK then
			if (idx > 1) and (lastFailIdx is (idx - 1)) and (lastFailWasRefusal is true) then
				my CommitRefusalEvidence(idx - 1, currentTabURL)
			end if
			set consecutiveErrors to 0
			if my IsApiProvider(providerName) then set consecutiveAPIErrors to 0
			
			try
				my runPythonScript("News_post.py", {providerName, currentTabURL})
			on error postMsg
				display dialog "❌ News_post.py 落盘失败，已停止以便排查：" & return & return & postMsg buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
				error number -128
			end try
			return "ok"
		end if
		
		-- ---------- 失败 ----------
		if errNumKept is -128 then error number -128
		if errNumKept is 6 then
			my Notify("用户中止了 API 窗口，已停止流程", "orange", 3000)
			error number -128
		end if
		
		set isRefusal to (errNumKept is 5)
		set isApiError to (errNumKept is 4)
		
		if isApiError then
			set consecutiveAPIErrors to consecutiveAPIErrors + 1
			my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, my ProviderLabel(providerName) & " API 调用失败：" & errMsgKept)
			if consecutiveAPIErrors ≥ maxConsecutiveAPIErrors then
				display dialog "⚠️ API 已连续失败 " & (consecutiveAPIErrors as text) & " 次。" & return & return & "最后一次错误：" & return & errMsgKept & return & return & "程序将强制终止。" buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
				error number -128
			end if
		end if
		
		set needHandoff to false
		if isRefusal then set needHandoff to true
		if isApiError and (handoffOnAPIError is true) then set needHandoff to true
		if (handoffOnFailure is true) and (errNumKept is 1 or errNumKept is 2) then set needHandoff to true
		
		if needHandoff then
			set lastFailIdx to idx
			set lastFailWasRefusal to isRefusal
			
			if idx < providerCount then
				set nextProvider to item (idx + 1) of chainNames
				if isRefusal then
					my Notify(my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "拒答，本篇改由" & my ProviderLabel(nextProvider) & "接管", "purple", 3000)
				else
					my Notify(my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "失败，本篇改由" & my ProviderLabel(nextProvider) & "接管", "purple", 3000)
				end if
				delay 0.5
				-- 继续 repeat：同一篇文章，换下一个
			else
				my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "拒答/失败（兜底也失败）：" & errMsgKept)
				display dialog "⚠️ 链条上所有 AI 均拒答/异常，已停止程序。" & return & return & "链条：" & my ChainDescription() & return & "本次起点：" & my ProviderLabel(item startIdx of chainNames) & return & return & "当前文章：" & return & currentTabURL buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
				return "stop"
			end if
		else
			set alertMsg to ""
			if errNumKept is 1 then
				set alertMsg to "❌ " & my ProviderLabel(providerName) & " 内容校验失败：" & return & "结果汉字数不足 / 内容不合格。"
			else if errNumKept is 2 then
				set alertMsg to "⏱️ " & my ProviderLabel(providerName) & " 操作超时。"
			else if errNumKept is 3 then
				set alertMsg to "🖼️ 依赖缺失（模板图片 / Python 库 / 参数错误）：" & return & errMsgKept
			else if errNumKept is 4 then
				set alertMsg to "🌐 " & my ProviderLabel(providerName) & " API 调用失败：" & return & errMsgKept
			else
				set alertMsg to "未知错误导致程序终止：" & return & errMsgKept & return & "错误编号：" & (errNumKept as text)
			end if
			display dialog alertMsg buttons {"确定"} default button "确定" with icon stop
			error number -128
		end if
	end repeat
	
	return "stop"
end SummarizeWithChain


-- 记录「有效拒答」并在达到阈值时永久推进起点
on CommitRefusalEvidence(i, currentTabURL)
	if i < 1 or i > (count of chainThresholds) then return
	set thresholdVal to item i of chainThresholds
	set newCount to my IncrementEvidence(i)
	if thresholdVal ≤ 0 then return
	if newCount < thresholdVal then return
	if (i + 1) > (count of chainNames) then return
	if providerStartIndex > i then return
	
	set providerStartIndex to i + 1
	set fromLabel to my ProviderLabel(item i of chainNames)
	set toLabel to my ProviderLabel(item (i + 1) of chainNames)
	my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, fromLabel & " 有效拒答已达 " & (thresholdVal as text) & " 次 → 永久切换起点为 " & toLabel)
	my Notify(fromLabel & "额度/权限判定失效，之后所有文章改从" & toLabel & "开始", "purple", 4500)
end CommitRefusalEvidence


on IncrementEvidence(i)
	set newList to {}
	set outVal to 0
	repeat with k from 1 to (count of refusalEvidence)
		if k is i then
			set outVal to ((item k of refusalEvidence) + 1)
			set end of newList to outVal
		else
			set end of newList to (item k of refusalEvidence)
		end if
	end repeat
	set refusalEvidence to newList
	return outVal
end IncrementEvidence

on ParseChain(chainText)
	set rawItems to my SplitText(chainText, ",")
	set nameList to {}
	set thrList to {}
	repeat with itm in rawItems
		set t to (itm as text)
		set nm to t
		set thresholdVal to 0
		if t contains "@" then
			set parts to my SplitText(t, "@")
			if (count of parts) ≥ 1 then set nm to (item 1 of parts)
			if (count of parts) ≥ 2 then
				try
					set thresholdVal to ((item 2 of parts) as integer)
				on error
					set thresholdVal to 0
				end try
			end if
		end if
		set nm to my NormalizeProvider(nm)
		if nm is not "" then
			set end of nameList to nm
			set end of thrList to thresholdVal
		end if
	end repeat
	set chainNames to nameList
	set chainThresholds to thrList
end ParseChain

on NormalizeProvider(n)
	set t to my TrimText(n)
	if t is "qianwen" or t is "qwen" or t is "tongyi" then return "qianwen_ui"

	if t is "doubao" then return "doubao_ui"
	if t is "qwen_api" or t is "tongyi_api" then return "qianwen_api"
	return t
end NormalizeProvider

on JoinList(theList, sep)
	set outText to ""
	repeat with i from 1 to count of theList
		if i > 1 then set outText to outText & sep
		set outText to outText & (item i of theList)
	end repeat
	return outText
end JoinList

on TrimText(t)
	set t to t as text
	repeat while t starts with " "
		if (length of t) is 1 then return ""
		set t to text 2 thru -1 of t
	end repeat
	repeat while t ends with " "
		if (length of t) is 1 then return ""
		set t to text 1 thru -2 of t
	end repeat
	return t
