-- ============================================================
-- News_Engine.scpt  v4
-- 统一新闻总结引擎：同时支持「Chrome 网页 AI」与「OpenAI 兼容 API」
--
-- 参数： {methodType, poeMode, shouldRepeat, providerChain}
--   methodType    : "" 表示按 provider 使用各自默认 Prompt
--   poeMode       : "normal" / "cheap"（只影响 API 的模型档位）
--   shouldRepeat  : true = 连续处理；false = 每篇后询问
--   providerChain : 例 "qianwen_ui@1,qianwen_api,deepseek_ui,doubao_ui"
--
-- provider 命名：
--   xxx_ui  -> Chrome 网页版（走 News_auto.py，免费）
--   xxx_api -> OpenAI 兼容 API（走 Modules/API_Client.py，付费）
--   裸名 qianwen/deepseek/doubao 自动等价于 _ui（向后兼容）
--
-- 链条语法 name@N：
--   该 provider 累计「有效拒答」达到 N 次后，永久把起点推进到它的下一个。
--   缺省 N=0 = 永不推进（只对当前文章临时交接）。
--
-- 「有效拒答」判定：
--   A 拒答 → 由紧邻的 B 接手，且 B 成功 ⇒ 说明不是文章问题（额度问题），计 1 次；
--   B 也拒答（最终由 C/D 兜底）⇒ 说明文章本身违规，不计数、不推进起点。
--
-- 【v4 新增】网页「上传/发送失败」处理（exit 7）：
--   网页版 provider 提交后如果检测到 xxx_upload_fail.png：
--     · 本篇临时改用「同品牌 API」兜底（qianwen_ui → qianwen_api）；
--     · 不计入「有效拒答」证据，不推进 providerStartIndex ⇒ 下一篇仍回网页版；
--     · 自动 reload 该 AI 的标签页，并复位千问「继续」弹窗检测标记；
--     · 连续 maxConsecutiveUploadFails 篇都上传失败则弹窗终止（防止烧光 API 额度）。
--
-- 退出码协议（News_auto.py 与 API_Client.py 共用）：
--   0 成功 / 1 内容不合格 / 2 超时 / 3 依赖或参数错误 / 4 API 错误
--   5 拒答需交接 / 6 用户中止 / 7 网页上传失败（本篇 API 兜底）
-- ============================================================

property pythonPath : "/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/Current/bin/python3"
property scriptFolder : "/Users/yanzhang/Coding/python_code/"
property screenshotScript : "/Users/yanzhang/Coding/python_code/screenshot.py"
property notifyScript : "/Users/yanzhang/Coding/python_code/Modules/notification.py"
property apiClientScript : "/Users/yanzhang/Coding/python_code/Modules/API_Client.py"
property cliclickPath : "/opt/homebrew/bin/cliclick"
property copyFailurePath : "/Users/yanzhang/Coding/News/copy_failure.html"

-- 默认链条（没传第 4 个参数时用）
property defaultChain : "qianwen_ui@1,qianwen_api,deepseek_ui,doubao_ui"

-- 【开关】是否开启英文总结（true = 双语；false = 英文位置写原文）
property enableEnglishSummary : false
-- 英文总结用哪个 API provider
property englishApiProvider : "deepseek_api"

-- 【开关】内容不合格(exit 1) / 超时(exit 2) 是否也换下一个 AI（仅本篇）
property handoffOnFailure : false
-- 【开关】API 调用失败(exit 4) 是否换下一个 AI（仅本篇，不计入永久推进）
property handoffOnAPIError : true
-- API 连续失败多少次后强制终止（防止网络异常时把豆包额度烧光）
property maxConsecutiveAPIErrors : 3
-- API 调用的 AppleScript 超时保护（秒）
property apiTimeoutSeconds : 900

-- 【上传失败(exit 7) 相关开关】
-- true  = 本篇用 API 兜底；false = 退化为普通交接（顺延链条下一个）
property uploadFailUseApi : true
-- "auto" = 自动选同品牌 _api（找不到就找链条里任意 _api）
-- 也可以写死一个名字，例如 "qianwen_api"；若不在链条里会自动追加到链尾
property uploadFailFallback : "auto"
-- 连续 N 篇上传失败后强制终止（防止网页彻底挂掉后持续消耗 API 额度）
property maxConsecutiveUploadFails : 5
-- 连续 N 次上传失败后「永久」把起点推进到下一个 provider；0 = 永不（默认，符合"下一篇回网页版"）
property uploadFailAutoAdvance : 0

-- 运行期状态
property consecutiveErrors : 0
property consecutiveAPIErrors : 0
property consecutiveUploadFails : 0
property qwContinueChecked : false
property providerStartIndex : 1
property chainNames : {}
property chainThresholds : {}
property refusalEvidence : {}


on run argv
	set consecutiveErrors to 0
	set consecutiveAPIErrors to 0
	set consecutiveUploadFails to 0
	set qwContinueChecked to false
	set providerStartIndex to 1
	
	set methodType to ""
	set poeMode to "normal"
	set shouldRepeat to false
	set chainText to defaultChain
	
	if (count of argv) ≥ 1 then set methodType to (item 1 of argv) as text
	if (count of argv) ≥ 2 then set poeMode to (item 2 of argv) as text
	if (count of argv) ≥ 3 then
		try
			set shouldRepeat to (item 3 of argv) as boolean
		on error
			set shouldRepeat to (((item 3 of argv) as text) is "true")
		end try
	end if
	if (count of argv) ≥ 4 then
		set t to (item 4 of argv) as text
		if t is not "" then set chainText to t
	end if
	
	my ParseChain(chainText)
	if (count of chainNames) is 0 then my ParseChain(defaultChain)
	
	-- 初始化拒答证据计数
	set refusalEvidence to {}
	repeat with k from 1 to (count of chainNames)
		set end of refusalEvidence to 0
	end repeat
	
	my Notify("链条：" & my ChainDescription(), "blue", 2500)
	
	-- 短文章用的翻译 Prompt
	set methodType2 to "----请将以上内容完整翻译成地道的中文，只是翻译，其它话都不要说"
	
	if shouldRepeat then
		repeat
			if my shouldStopByFile() then exit repeat
			set stopNow to my NewsOperation(methodType, poeMode, methodType2)
			if stopNow then exit repeat
		end repeat
	else
		repeat
			if my shouldStopByFile() then exit repeat
			set stopNow to my NewsOperation(methodType, poeMode, methodType2)
			if stopNow then exit repeat
			if my shouldStopByFile() then exit repeat
			
			set userResponse to display dialog "已成功处理一个页面。" & return & "是否继续处理下一个？" buttons {"终止", "继续"} default button "继续" cancel button "终止"
			if button returned of userResponse is "终止" then exit repeat
		end repeat
	end if
end run


-- ============================================================
-- 处理一篇文章；返回 true 表示要终止外层循环
-- ============================================================
on NewsOperation(methodType, poeMode, methodType2)
	set targetWebsites to {"nytimes.com", "nikkei.com", "bloomberg.com", "technologyreview.com", "economist.com", "hbr.org", "ft.com", "wsj.com", "reuters.com", "washingtonpost.com", "asia.nikkei.com", "rfi.fr", "dw.com", "bbc.com"}
	
	set foundWebsiteName to ""
	set foundTabId to -1
	set containsTargetWebsite to false
	set currentTabURL to ""
	
	tell application "Google Chrome"
		activate
		delay 0.2
		set tabList to every tab of front window
		
		repeat with i from 1 to the count of tabList
			set tabURL to URL of item i of tabList
			repeat with website in targetWebsites
				if tabURL contains website then
					set tld to text -3 thru -1 of website
					set pos to offset of tld in tabURL
					if pos ≠ 0 then
						set domainLength to length of website
						set startOfPostDomain to pos + domainLength - 3
						if length of tabURL ≥ startOfPostDomain + 7 then
							set currentTabURL to tabURL
							set containsTargetWebsite to true
							set foundWebsiteName to website
							set active tab index of front window to i
							set foundTabId to id of item i of tabList
							exit repeat
						end if
					end if
				end if
			end repeat
			if containsTargetWebsite then exit repeat
		end repeat
	end tell
	
	if not containsTargetWebsite then
		my Notify("没有可供总结的新闻页面了", "green", 2000)
		return true
	end if
	
	my handlename(foundWebsiteName, currentTabURL)
	set the clipboard to currentTabURL
	
	if currentTabURL contains "www.wsj.com/video/" then
		tell application "Google Chrome"
			close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
		end tell
		delay 0.5
		return false
	end if
	
	-- ==========================================================
	-- 分支 1：英文站点（需要 AI 总结）
	-- ==========================================================
	if currentTabURL contains "ft.com" or currentTabURL contains "technologyreview.com" or currentTabURL contains "economist.com" or currentTabURL contains "www.wsj.com" or currentTabURL contains "reuters.com" or currentTabURL contains "washingtonpost.com" or currentTabURL contains "asia.nikkei.com" or currentTabURL contains "bloomberg.com" or currentTabURL contains "nytimes.com" then
		
		if currentTabURL contains "reuters.com/pictures/" then
			my Scroll(5)
			delay 1
		else if currentTabURL contains "wsj.com" then
			my Scroll(1)
		else
			my Scroll(2)
		end if
		delay 0.2
		
		if currentTabURL contains "ft.com" then
			my OperationForFT()
		else
			my Operation()
		end if
		delay 0.2
		
		-- 关键词屏蔽检查
		try
			my runPythonScript("Clipboard_keyword_check.py", {currentTabURL})
		on error
			my Notify("包含屏蔽关键词，已跳过此文章", "red", 3000)
			tell application "Google Chrome"
				close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
			end tell
			my MoveImagesToTrash()
			return false
		end try
		
		my runPythonScript("Article_Copier.py", {currentTabURL})
		my runPythonScript("Clipboard_count_news.py", {})
		
		set filePathsuperlong to "/tmp/superlongarticle.txt"
		set filePathlong to "/tmp/longarticle.txt"
		set filePathshort to "/tmp/shortarticle.txt"
		
		set finalMethodType to methodType
		set finalPoeMode to poeMode
		
		set hasShort to false
		set hasLong to false
		set hasSuperlong to false
		
		tell application "System Events"
			if exists file filePathshort then
				delete file filePathshort
				set hasShort to true
			else if exists file filePathlong then
				delete file filePathlong
				set hasLong to true
			else if exists file filePathsuperlong then
				delete file filePathsuperlong
				set hasSuperlong to true
			end if
		end tell
		
		if hasShort then
			set finalMethodType to methodType2
			set finalPoeMode to "cheap"
		else if hasLong then
			set finalPoeMode to poeMode
		else if hasSuperlong then
			set finalPoeMode to "cheap"
		else
			my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, "文章太短")
			my Notify("文章太短，已跳过此文章", "orange", 2000)
			tell application "Google Chrome"
				close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
			end tell
			delay 0.5
			return false
		end if
		
		-- 原始文章内容（交接时复用，不用再复制页面）
		set rawArticleContent to the clipboard
		
		set autoWaitParam to "50"
		if currentTabURL contains "reuters.com/pictures" then set autoWaitParam to "10"
		
		set chainResult to my SummarizeWithChain(finalMethodType, rawArticleContent, autoWaitParam, currentTabURL, finalPoeMode)
		if chainResult is not "ok" then return true
		
		-- ================= 英文部分 =================
		if enableEnglishSummary is true then
			set englishOK to true
			try
				my RunEnglishSummary(rawArticleContent, finalPoeMode)
			on error errMsg number errNum
				if errNum is -128 or errNum is 6 then error number -128
				set englishOK to false
			end try
			
			if englishOK then
				set consecutiveErrors to 0
				my runPythonScript("Append_English_News.py", {})
				tell application "Google Chrome"
					close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
				end tell
				delay 0.5
			else
				set consecutiveErrors to consecutiveErrors + 1
				log "中文成功，但英文 API 失败。累计错误: " & consecutiveErrors
				if consecutiveErrors ≥ 3 then
					display dialog "⚠️ 警告：英文阶段已连续报错 3 次。" & return & return & "程序将强制终止。" buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
					error number -128
				end if
			end if
		else
			set the clipboard to rawArticleContent
			delay 0.2
			my runPythonScript("Append_English_News.py", {})
			set consecutiveErrors to 0
			tell application "Google Chrome"
				close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
			end tell
			delay 0.5
		end if
		
		-- ==========================================================
		-- 分支 2：中文站点（不走 AI）
		-- ==========================================================
	else if currentTabURL contains "cn.wsj.com" or currentTabURL contains "rfi.fr" or currentTabURL contains "dw.com" or currentTabURL contains "bbc.com/zhongwen" then
		my Scroll(1)
		delay 0.5
		my Operation()
		
		try
			my runPythonScript("Clipboard_keyword_check.py", {currentTabURL})
		on error
			my Notify("包含屏蔽关键词，已跳过此文章", "red", 3000)
			tell application "Google Chrome"
				close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
			end tell
			my MoveImagesToTrash()
			return false
		end try
		
		set checkChineseScript to "
import sys, subprocess

text = subprocess.run(['pbpaste'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout

cn_count = sum(1 for c in text if 0x4e00 <= ord(c) <= 0x9fff or 
                                  0x3400 <= ord(c) <= 0x4dbf or 
                                  0xf900 <= ord(c) <= 0xfaff or 
                                  0x3000 <= ord(c) <= 0x303f or 
                                  0xff00 <= ord(c) <= 0xffef)

en_count = sum(1 for c in text if c.isascii() and c.isalpha())

total_valid = cn_count + en_count

if total_valid == 0:
    sys.exit(1)

if en_count / total_valid > 1/2:
    sys.exit(1)

sys.exit(0)
"
		try
			do shell script quoted form of pythonPath & " -c " & quoted form of checkChineseScript
		on error
			my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, "非中文内容过多")
			my Notify("非中文内容过多，已跳过此文章", "red", 3000)
			tell application "Google Chrome"
				close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
			end tell
			return false
		end try
		
		my runPythonScript("Article_Copier.py", {currentTabURL})
		my Notify("等待下载图片....", "blue", 5000)
		my runPythonScript("CN_copy_News.py", {currentTabURL})
		delay 0.5
		tell application "Google Chrome"
			close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
		end tell
	end if
	
	return false
end NewsOperation


-- ============================================================
-- 链条调度：返回 "ok" 或 "stop"
-- v4：改为手动游标 idx（支持非顺延跳转，如 upload_fail → 同品牌 API）
-- ============================================================
on SummarizeWithChain(finalMethodType, rawArticleContent, autoWaitParam, currentTabURL, poeMode)
	set providerCount to count of chainNames
	if providerCount is 0 then
		display dialog "provider 链条为空，请检查参数。" buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
		error number -128
	end if
	
	if providerStartIndex < 1 then set providerStartIndex to 1
	if providerStartIndex > providerCount then set providerStartIndex to providerCount
	
	set startIdx to providerStartIndex
	set idx to startIdx
	set lastFailIdx to 0
	set lastFailWasRefusal to false
	set refusalCountThisArticle to 0
	set triedList to {}
	set stepCount to 0
	set maxSteps to (providerCount * 2) + 4
	
	repeat
		set providerCount to count of chainNames
		if idx < 1 or idx > providerCount then exit repeat
		
		set stepCount to stepCount + 1
		if stepCount > maxSteps then
			my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, "链条调度步数超限，已停止（疑似配置环路）")
			display dialog "⚠️ 链条调度异常（步数超限），已停止程序。" & return & return & "链条：" & my ChainDescription() buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
			return "stop"
		end if
		
		if my ListHasInteger(triedList, idx) then
			-- 该 provider 本篇已试过，顺延
			set idx to idx + 1
		else
			set end of triedList to idx
			set providerName to item idx of chainNames
			set stepOK to true
			set errNumKept to 0
			set errMsgKept to ""
			
			try
				my ExecuteProvider(providerName, finalMethodType, rawArticleContent, autoWaitParam, poeMode)
			on error errMsg number errNum
				set stepOK to false
				set errNumKept to errNum
				set errMsgKept to errMsg
			end try
			
			-- ---------- 成功 ----------
			if stepOK then
				if (lastFailIdx > 0) and (lastFailWasRefusal is true) and (idx is (lastFailIdx + 1)) and (refusalCountThisArticle is 1) then
					my CommitRefusalEvidence(lastFailIdx, currentTabURL)
				end if
				set consecutiveErrors to 0
				if my IsApiProvider(providerName) then
					set consecutiveAPIErrors to 0
				else
					-- 网页版恢复正常，清零上传失败连击
					set consecutiveUploadFails to 0
				end if
				
				try
					my runPythonScript("News_post.py", {providerName, currentTabURL})
				on error postMsg
					display dialog "❌ News_post.py 落盘失败，已停止以便排查：" & return & return & postMsg buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
					error number -128
				end try
				return "ok"
			end if
			
			-- ---------- 失败 ----------
			if errNumKept is -128 then error number -128
			if errNumKept is 6 then
				my Notify("用户中止了 API 窗口，已停止流程", "orange", 3000)
				error number -128
			end if
			
			set isRefusal to (errNumKept is 5)
			set isApiError to (errNumKept is 4)
			set isUploadFail to (errNumKept is 7)
			
			-- ========== 分支：网页上传失败（exit 7） ==========
			if isUploadFail then
				set consecutiveUploadFails to consecutiveUploadFails + 1
				my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, my ProviderLabel(providerName) & " 网页上传失败(exit 7)，连续第 " & (consecutiveUploadFails as text) & " 次")
				
				-- 让网页恢复到干净状态，保证下一篇还能继续用网页版
				if my BaseName(providerName) is "qianwen" then set qwContinueChecked to false
				my RecoverUIProvider(providerName)
				
				if consecutiveUploadFails ≥ maxConsecutiveUploadFails then
					display dialog "⚠️ " & my ProviderLabel(providerName) & " 已连续 " & (consecutiveUploadFails as text) & " 篇上传失败。" & return & return & "为避免持续消耗付费 API 额度，程序将终止，请手动检查网页状态后再运行。" buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
					error number -128
				end if
				
				-- 可选：连续多次上传失败后永久推进起点（默认 0 = 关闭）
				if (uploadFailAutoAdvance > 0) and (consecutiveUploadFails ≥ uploadFailAutoAdvance) then
					if (idx + 1) ≤ (count of chainNames) and (providerStartIndex ≤ idx) then
						set providerStartIndex to idx + 1
						my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, my ProviderLabel(providerName) & " 连续上传失败达 " & (uploadFailAutoAdvance as text) & " 次 → 永久切换起点为 " & my ProviderLabel(item (idx + 1) of chainNames))
						my Notify(my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "网页疑似不可用，之后所有文章改从" & my ProviderLabel(item (idx + 1) of chainNames) & "开始", "purple", 4500)
					end if
				end if
				
				-- 关键：上传失败不是"拒答"，绝不计入永久推进证据
				set lastFailIdx to idx
				set lastFailWasRefusal to false
				
				set fbIdx to 0
				if uploadFailUseApi is true then set fbIdx to my FindApiFallbackIndex(providerName, idx, triedList)
				
				if fbIdx > 0 then
					my Notify(my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "上传失败，本篇临时改用" & my ProviderLabel(item fbIdx of chainNames) & "；下一篇仍从" & my ProviderLabel(item providerStartIndex of chainNames) & "开始", "purple", 4000)
					delay 0.5
					set idx to fbIdx
				else
					if idx < (count of chainNames) then
						my Notify(my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "上传失败，无可用 API 兜底，本篇改由" & my ProviderLabel(item (idx + 1) of chainNames) & "接管", "purple", 3500)
						delay 0.5
						set idx to idx + 1
					else
						my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, my ProviderLabel(providerName) & " 上传失败且链条无后续可用 provider")
						display dialog "⚠️ 网页上传失败，且链条上没有可用的兜底 provider。" & return & return & "链条：" & my ChainDescription() & return & return & "当前文章：" & return & currentTabURL buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
						return "stop"
					end if
				end if
				
			else
				-- ========== 其它失败：沿用原有逻辑 ==========
				if isApiError then
					set consecutiveAPIErrors to consecutiveAPIErrors + 1
					my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, my ProviderLabel(providerName) & " API 调用失败：" & errMsgKept)
					if consecutiveAPIErrors ≥ maxConsecutiveAPIErrors then
						display dialog "⚠️ API 已连续失败 " & (consecutiveAPIErrors as text) & " 次。" & return & return & "最后一次错误：" & return & errMsgKept & return & return & "程序将强制终止。" buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
						error number -128
					end if
				end if
				
				set needHandoff to false
				if isRefusal then set needHandoff to true
				if isApiError and (handoffOnAPIError is true) then set needHandoff to true
				if (handoffOnFailure is true) and (errNumKept is 1 or errNumKept is 2) then set needHandoff to true
				
				if needHandoff then
					set lastFailIdx to idx
					set lastFailWasRefusal to isRefusal
					if isRefusal then set refusalCountThisArticle to refusalCountThisArticle + 1
					
					if idx < (count of chainNames) then
						set nextProvider to item (idx + 1) of chainNames
						if isRefusal then
							my Notify(my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "拒答，本篇改由" & my ProviderLabel(nextProvider) & "接管", "purple", 3000)
						else
							my Notify(my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "失败，本篇改由" & my ProviderLabel(nextProvider) & "接管", "purple", 3000)
						end if
						delay 0.5
						set idx to idx + 1
					else
						my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "拒答/失败（兜底也失败）：" & errMsgKept)
						display dialog "⚠️ 链条上所有 AI 均拒答/异常，已停止程序。" & return & return & "链条：" & my ChainDescription() & return & "本次起点：" & my ProviderLabel(item startIdx of chainNames) & return & return & "当前文章：" & return & currentTabURL buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
						return "stop"
					end if
				else
					set alertMsg to ""
					if errNumKept is 1 then
						set alertMsg to "❌ " & my ProviderLabel(providerName) & " 内容校验失败：" & return & "结果汉字数不足 / 内容不合格。"
					else if errNumKept is 2 then
						set alertMsg to "⏱️ " & my ProviderLabel(providerName) & " 操作超时。"
					else if errNumKept is 3 then
						set alertMsg to "🖼️ 依赖缺失（模板图片 / Python 库 / 参数错误）：" & return & errMsgKept
					else if errNumKept is 4 then
						set alertMsg to "🌐 " & my ProviderLabel(providerName) & " API 调用失败：" & return & errMsgKept
					else if errNumKept is 7 then
						set alertMsg to "📎 " & my ProviderLabel(providerName) & " 网页上传失败，但当前配置未启用任何兜底方案。"
					else
						set alertMsg to "未知错误导致程序终止：" & return & errMsgKept & return & "错误编号：" & (errNumKept as text)
					end if
					display dialog alertMsg buttons {"确定"} default button "确定" with icon stop
					error number -128
				end if
			end if
		end if
	end repeat
	
	return "stop"
end SummarizeWithChain


-- 为「上传失败」挑选 API 兜底下标：0 表示没有
on FindApiFallbackIndex(providerName, currentIdx, triedList)
	-- 0) 显式指定
	if uploadFailFallback is not "auto" and uploadFailFallback is not "" then
		set forcedIdx to my EnsureProviderInChain(uploadFailFallback)
		if forcedIdx > 0 and not my ListHasInteger(triedList, forcedIdx) then return forcedIdx
	end if
	
	set b to my BaseName(providerName)
	
	-- 1) 同品牌 API（qianwen_ui → qianwen_api）
	repeat with k from 1 to (count of chainNames)
		set nm to item k of chainNames
		if my IsApiProvider(nm) and (my BaseName(nm) is b) and not my ListHasInteger(triedList, k) then return k
	end repeat
	
	-- 2) 链条上当前位置之后的任意 API
	repeat with k from (currentIdx + 1) to (count of chainNames)
		set nm to item k of chainNames
		if my IsApiProvider(nm) and not my ListHasInteger(triedList, k) then return k
	end repeat
	
	-- 3) 链条上任意未试过的 API
	repeat with k from 1 to (count of chainNames)
		set nm to item k of chainNames
		if my IsApiProvider(nm) and not my ListHasInteger(triedList, k) then return k
	end repeat
	
	return 0
end FindApiFallbackIndex


-- 确保某 provider 在链条中（不在则追加到链尾，阈值 0 = 不参与永久推进）
on EnsureProviderInChain(nm)
	set target to my NormalizeProvider(nm)
	if target is "" then return 0
	repeat with k from 1 to (count of chainNames)
		if (item k of chainNames) is target then return k
	end repeat
	set end of chainNames to target
	set end of chainThresholds to 0
	set end of refusalEvidence to 0
	return (count of chainNames)
end EnsureProviderInChain


-- 上传失败后刷新对应 AI 的网页，清掉脏状态
on RecoverUIProvider(p)
	set b to my BaseName(p)
	set domA to ""
	set domB to ""
	if b is "qianwen" then
		set domA to "qianwen.com"
		set domB to "tongyi"
	else if b is "deepseek" then
		set domA to "deepseek.com"
	else if b is "doubao" then
		set domA to "doubao.com"
	end if
	if domA is "" then return
	
	try
		tell application "Google Chrome"
			repeat with w in every window
				repeat with t in every tab of w
					set u to (URL of t) as text
					if (u contains domA) or ((domB is not "") and (u contains domB)) then
						reload t
					end if
				end repeat
			end repeat
		end tell
	end try
	delay 2
end RecoverUIProvider


-- 记录「有效拒答」并在达到阈值时永久推进起点
on CommitRefusalEvidence(i, currentTabURL)
	if i < 1 or i > (count of chainThresholds) then return
	set thresholdVal to item i of chainThresholds
	set newCount to my IncrementEvidence(i)
	if thresholdVal ≤ 0 then return
	if newCount < thresholdVal then return
	if (i + 1) > (count of chainNames) then return
	if providerStartIndex > i then return
	
	set providerStartIndex to i + 1
	set fromLabel to my ProviderLabel(item i of chainNames)
	set toLabel to my ProviderLabel(item (i + 1) of chainNames)
	my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, fromLabel & " 有效拒答已达 " & (thresholdVal as text) & " 次 → 永久切换起点为 " & toLabel)
	my Notify(fromLabel & "额度/权限判定失效，之后所有文章改从" & toLabel & "开始", "purple", 4500)
end CommitRefusalEvidence


on IncrementEvidence(i)
	set newList to {}
	set outVal to 0
	repeat with k from 1 to (count of refusalEvidence)
		if k is i then
			set outVal to ((item k of refusalEvidence) + 1)
			set end of newList to outVal
		else
			set end of newList to (item k of refusalEvidence)
		end if
	end repeat
	set refusalEvidence to newList
	return outVal
end IncrementEvidence

-- ============================================================
-- provider 名称工具
-- ============================================================
on ParseChain(chainText)
	set rawItems to my SplitText(chainText, ",")
	set nameList to {}
	set thrList to {}
	repeat with itm in rawItems
		set t to (itm as text)
		set nm to t
		set thresholdVal to 0
		if t contains "@" then
			set parts to my SplitText(t, "@")
			if (count of parts) ≥ 1 then set nm to (item 1 of parts)
			if (count of parts) ≥ 2 then
				try
					set thresholdVal to ((item 2 of parts) as integer)
				on error
					set thresholdVal to 0
				end try
			end if
		end if
		set nm to my NormalizeProvider(nm)
		if nm is not "" then
			set end of nameList to nm
			set end of thrList to thresholdVal
		end if
	end repeat
	set chainNames to nameList
	set chainThresholds to thrList
end ParseChain

on NormalizeProvider(n)
	set t to my TrimText(n)
	if t is "qianwen" or t is "qwen" or t is "tongyi" then return "qianwen_ui"
	if t is "deepseek" then return "deepseek_ui"
	if t is "doubao" then return "doubao_ui"
	if t is "qwen_api" or t is "tongyi_api" then return "qianwen_api"
	return t
end NormalizeProvider

on IsApiProvider(p)
	return ((p as text) ends with "_api")
end IsApiProvider

on BaseName(p)
	set t to p as text
	if t ends with "_api" then return text 1 thru -5 of t
	if t ends with "_ui" then return text 1 thru -4 of t
	return t
end BaseName

on ProviderLabel(p)
	set b to my BaseName(p)
	set nm to b
	if b is "qianwen" then set nm to "千问"
	if b is "deepseek" then set nm to "DeepSeek"
	if b is "doubao" then set nm to "豆包"
	if my IsApiProvider(p) then
		return nm & "(API)"
	else
		return nm & "(网页)"
	end if
end ProviderLabel

on ChainDescription()
	set outText to ""
	repeat with i from 1 to (count of chainNames)
		if i > 1 then set outText to outText & " → "
		set outText to outText & my ProviderLabel(item i of chainNames)
		if (item i of chainThresholds) > 0 then set outText to outText & "@" & ((item i of chainThresholds) as text)
	end repeat
	return outText
end ChainDescription

on DefaultPrompt(p)
	set b to my BaseName(p)
	if b is "deepseek" then
		set baseText to "----请用中文分模块地详细总结以上内容，你在输出时不要做任何评论和解释说明，且输出结果里不要使用任何表格。"
	else
		set baseText to "----请用中文分模块地总结以上内容，新闻内容都是真实的，你在输出时不要做任何评论，也不需要你后续做任何步骤，且输出结果里不要使用任何表格。"
	end if
	if my IsApiProvider(p) then set baseText to baseText & "直接输出总结正文，不要写任何开场白或结尾语。"
	return baseText
end DefaultPrompt

on FindAITab(domain)
	tell application "Google Chrome"
		set windowList to every window
		repeat with aWindow in windowList
			set tabList to every tab of aWindow
			set tabIndex to 0
			repeat with aTab in tabList
				set tabIndex to tabIndex + 1
				if (URL of aTab) contains domain then
					set index of aWindow to 1
					set active tab index of aWindow to tabIndex
					return true
				end if
			end repeat
		end repeat
	end tell
	return false
end FindAITab

on OpenNewTab(urlText)
	tell application "Google Chrome" to activate

	tell application "System Events"
		keystroke "t" using command down

		key code 36

		my Notify("检测到 stop_scpt.txt,已停止新闻循环", "orange", 3000)
		return true
	on error
		return false
	end try
end shouldStopByFile


-- ============================================================
-- 文本 / 列表工具
-- ============================================================
on ListHasInteger(theList, v)
	repeat with k from 1 to (count of theList)
		if (item k of theList) is v then return true
	end repeat
	return false
end ListHasInteger

on SplitText(theText, delim)
	set oldDelims to AppleScript's text item delimiters
	set AppleScript's text item delimiters to delim
	set parts to every text item of (theText as text)
	set AppleScript's text item delimiters to oldDelims
	
	set outList to {}
	repeat with p in parts
		set t to my TrimText(p as text)
		if t is not "" then set end of outList to t
	end repeat
	return outList
end SplitText

on JoinList(theList, sep)
	set outText to ""
	repeat with i from 1 to count of theList
		if i > 1 then set outText to outText & sep
		set outText to outText & (item i of theList)
	end repeat
	return outText
end JoinList

on TrimText(t)
	set t to t as text
	repeat while t starts with " "
		if (length of t) is 1 then return ""
		set t to text 2 thru -1 of t
	end repeat
	repeat while t ends with " "
		if (length of t) is 1 then return ""
		set t to text 1 thru -2 of t
	end repeat
	return t
end TrimText

"""
统一的「等待 AI 回答 → 点击复制 → 校验剪贴板」自动化脚本
替代 Qianwen_auto.py / Deepseek_auto.py / Doubao_auto.py

用法:
    News_auto.py <provider> [min_chinese]
        provider    : qianwen | deepseek | doubao
        min_chinese : 合格所需最少汉字数，默认 50

退出码:
    0  成功，剪贴板内容合格
    1  连续 3 次点击复制，内容均不合格
    2  超时（TIMEOUT_DURATION 秒内没拿到合格内容）
    3  模板图片缺失 / provider 名称错误
    5  需要交接（AI 拒答 或 回答异常）
    7  网页端「上传/发送失败」（本篇建议交由同品牌 API 兜底，下一篇仍回网页版）

# ================= provider 名称归一化 =================
# News_Engine 现在传的是 qianwen_ui / deepseek_ui / doubao_ui，
# 这里统一剥掉通道后缀，_api 结尾的直接报错（应该走 Modules/API_Client.py）
PROVIDER_ALIASES = {
    "qianwen": "qianwen", "qianwen_ui": "qianwen", "qianwen-ui": "qianwen",
    "qwen": "qianwen", "qwen_ui": "qianwen", "tongyi": "qianwen", "tongyi_ui": "qianwen",
    "deepseek": "deepseek", "deepseek_ui": "deepseek", "deepseek-ui": "deepseek",
    "ds": "deepseek", "ds_ui": "deepseek",
    "doubao": "doubao", "doubao_ui": "doubao", "doubao-ui": "doubao",
}


def normalize_provider(raw: str) -> str:
    p = (raw or "").strip().lower()
    if p.endswith("_api") or p.endswith("-api"):
        print(f"错误：'{raw}' 是 API provider，请调用 Modules/API_Client.py，而不是 News_auto.py")
        sys.exit(EXIT_TEMPLATE_MISSING)

# 拒答话术（三家共用）

# ================= 基础工具 =================
def get_scale_factor():
    """ImageGrab(物理像素) 与 pyautogui(逻辑坐标) 的比例。Retina 通常 2.0。"""
    try:
        with ImageGrab.grab() as sc:
            img_width = sc.size[0]
        screen_width, _ = pyautogui.size()
        return img_width / screen_width
    except Exception:
        return 1.0


SCALE_FACTOR = get_scale_factor()


def capture_screen():
    with ImageGrab.grab() as screenshot:
        img_np = np.array(screenshot)
        if img_np.ndim == 3 and img_np.shape[2] == 4:
            return cv2.cvtColor(img_np, cv2.COLOR_RGBA2BGR)
        return cv2.cvtColor(img_np, cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)


def save_debug_shot(tag: str):
    if not SAVE_DEBUG_SHOT:
        return
    try:
        ts = time.strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
        path = os.path.join(DEBUG_SHOT_DIR, f"news_auto_{tag}_{ts}.png")
        cv2.imwrite(path, capture_screen())
        print(f"已保存调试截图: {path}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"保存调试截图失败: {e}")


def match_template(template, threshold, screen=None):
    """返回 (max_loc, shape) 或 (None, None)"""
    if template is None:
        return None, None
    if screen is None:
        screen = capture_screen()
    if template.shape[0] > screen.shape[0] or template.shape[1] > screen.shape[1]:
        return None, None
    result = cv2.matchTemplate(screen, template, cv2.TM_CCOEFF_NORMED)
    _, max_val, _, max_loc = cv2.minMaxLoc(result)
    if max_val >= threshold:
        return max_loc, template.shape
    return None, None


def load_templates(cfg):
    """按配置加载模板，返回 {key: (img, threshold)}；缺必需模板则直接退出。"""
    loaded = {}
    for key, (filename, threshold, required) in cfg["templates"].items():
        path = os.path.join(BASE_RESOURCE_DIR, filename)
        img = None
        if os.path.exists(path):
            img = cv2.imread(path, cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
        if img is None:
            if required:
                print(f"错误：模板文件缺失或无法读取 -> {path}")
                sys.exit(EXIT_TEMPLATE_MISSING)
            print(f"警告：可选模板不可用 -> {path}，该检测自动关闭。")
            loaded[key] = (None, threshold)
            continue
        loaded[key] = (img, threshold)
    return loaded


def find(templates, key, screen=None):
    if key not in templates:
        return None, None
    img, threshold = templates[key]
    return match_template(img, threshold, screen=screen)


def is_refusal_response(text: str) -> bool:
    if not text:
        return False
    normalized = re.sub(r'\s+', '', text)
    return any(p in normalized for p in REFUSAL_PHRASES)


def is_content_qualified(text, min_chinese=50) -> bool:
    if not text:
        return False
    return len(re.findall(r'[\u4e00-\u9fff]', text)) > min_chinese


def perform_click(location, shape, offset=(0, 0)):
    phys_x = location[0] + shape[1] // 2
    phys_y = location[1] + shape[0] // 2
    lx = int(phys_x / SCALE_FACTOR)
    ly = int(phys_y / SCALE_FACTOR)

    if offset:
        lx += offset[0]
        ly += offset[1]

    pyautogui.click(lx, ly)
    return lx, ly


def refresh_page_mac():
    os.system("""osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to key code 15 using command down'""")


def scroll_down(cfg, move_cursor=False):
    pos = cfg.get("cursor_before_scroll")
    if move_cursor and pos:
        print(f"移动光标到 {pos} 并向下滚屏...")
        pyautogui.moveTo(pos[0], pos[1])
    pyautogui.scroll(SCROLL_AMOUNT)
    sleep(1)


# ================= 上传/发送失败检测 =================
def check_upload_fail_confirmed(cfg, templates, screen=None):
    """
    返回 (confirmed, delayed)
        confirmed : True 表示确认为「上传失败」
        delayed   : True 表示本函数消耗了等待时间（当前 screen 已过期，调用方应重新取帧）

    判定策略（对抗 toast 转瞬即逝 + 模板误报）：
        1) 当前帧命中 upload_fail
        2) 等 confirm_delay 后复查：若 Copy 已出现 -> 说明其实已经出答案，忽略
        3) upload_fail 仍在 -> 确认失败
        4) upload_fail 消失但 Copy 仍未出现 -> 再采一次；仍是这个状态时按 toast 处理，
           若 upload_fail_transient_ok 为 True 则判定失败
    """
    if templates.get(UPLOAD_FAIL_KEY, (None, 0))[0] is None:
        return False, False

    loc, _ = find(templates, UPLOAD_FAIL_KEY, screen=screen)
    if not loc:
        return False, False

    delay = float(cfg.get("upload_fail_confirm_delay", 0.8))
    if delay <= 0:
        print("命中 upload_fail 标识（未开启二次确认），判定为上传失败。")
        return True, False

    print(f"疑似检测到上传失败标识，{delay} 秒后二次确认...")
    sleep(delay)

    copy_loc, _ = find(templates, "copy")
    if copy_loc:
        print("二次确认时发现 Copy 按钮已出现，忽略 upload_fail 标识。")
        return False, True

    loc2, _ = find(templates, UPLOAD_FAIL_KEY)
    if loc2:
        print("二次确认成立：网页端上传/发送失败。")
        return True, True

    sleep(0.6)
    copy_loc2, _ = find(templates, "copy")
    if copy_loc2:
        print("提示已消失且 Copy 已出现，忽略 upload_fail 标识。")
        return False, True

    loc3, _ = find(templates, UPLOAD_FAIL_KEY)
    if loc3:
        print("第三次采样命中：网页端上传/发送失败。")
        return True, True

    if cfg.get("upload_fail_transient_ok", True):
        print("上传失败提示为瞬时 toast（已消失且始终无 Copy 按钮），判定为上传失败。")
        return True, True

    print("上传失败提示已消失，且未开启瞬时判定，继续正常流程。")
    return False, True


# ================= 豆包专用：回答异常二次确认 =================
def check_wrong_confirmed(templates):
    """
    1) 命中 wrong 后等 1.5s
    2) 复查时优先看 copy（复制按钮出现则以 copy 为准）
    3) copy 仍无、wrong 仍在 -> 确认异常
    """
    if templates.get("wrong", (None, 0))[0] is None:
        return False

    loc, _ = find(templates, "wrong")
    if not loc:
        return False

    print("疑似检测到 wrong 标识，1.5 秒后二次确认...")
    sleep(1.5)

    copy_loc, _ = find(templates, "copy")
    if copy_loc:
        print("二次确认时发现 Copy 按钮已出现，忽略 wrong 标识。")
        return False

    loc2, _ = find(templates, "wrong")
    if loc2:
        print("二次确认成立：AI 回答异常。")
        return True

    print("二次确认不成立（wrong 已消失），继续正常流程。")
    return False


# ================= 主流程 =================
def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("用法: News_auto.py <qianwen|deepseek|doubao> [min_chinese]")
        sys.exit(EXIT_TEMPLATE_MISSING)

    provider = normalize_provider(sys.argv[1])
    if provider not in PROVIDERS:
        print(f"错误：未知 provider '{provider}'，可选：{list(PROVIDERS.keys())}")
        sys.exit(EXIT_TEMPLATE_MISSING)

    cfg = PROVIDERS[provider]

    target_threshold = 50
    if len(sys.argv) > 2:
        try:
            target_threshold = int(sys.argv[2])
        except ValueError:
            print("汉字阈值参数格式错误，使用默认 50")

    templates = load_templates(cfg)

    print(f"[{cfg['label']}] 缩放因子={SCALE_FACTOR}，最多 {MAX_ATTEMPTS} 次，汉字阈值={target_threshold}")

    attempt = 1
    start_time = time.time()

    while attempt <= MAX_ATTEMPTS:
        if time.time() - start_time > TIMEOUT_DURATION:
            print("寻找超时：未能在规定时间内完成任务")
            sys.exit(EXIT_TIMEOUT)

        screen = capture_screen()

        # ---- 0. 同帧先看 Copy：已出答案时压制所有异常检测 ----
        copy_loc, copy_shape = find(templates, "copy", screen=screen)

        # ---- 1. 上传/发送失败（优先级最高，避免被 retry/timeout 拖进 15s+刷新）----
        if not copy_loc:
            up_confirmed, up_delayed = check_upload_fail_confirmed(cfg, templates, screen=screen)
            if up_confirmed:
                save_debug_shot("upload_fail")
                print("检测到网页上传失败 -> 请求 API 兜底（退出码 7）。")
                sys.exit(EXIT_UPLOAD_FAIL)
            if up_delayed:
                # 确认过程消耗了时间，当前帧已过期，重新取帧（不消耗 attempt）
                sleep(0.3)
                continue

        # ---- 2. 拒答图标（forbidden / forbidden2）----
        forbidden_hit = None
        for key in ("forbidden", "forbidden2"):
            loc, _ = find(templates, key, screen=screen)
            if loc:
                forbidden_hit = key
                break
        if forbidden_hit:
            print(f"检测到 {forbidden_hit} 图片，判定为拒答 -> 请求交接。")
            sys.exit(EXIT_HANDOFF)

        # ---- 3. retry / timeout：等 15 秒后刷新页面 ----
        if cfg["refresh_on_stall"] and not copy_loc:
            stall_hit = None
            for key in ("retry", "timeout"):
                loc, _ = find(templates, key, screen=screen)
                if loc:
                    stall_hit = key
                    break
            if stall_hit:
                print(f"检测到 {stall_hit} 图片，等待 15 秒后刷新页面...")
                sleep(15)
                refresh_page_mac()
                sleep(5)
                continue        # 刷新不消耗 attempt

        # ---- 4. Copy 按钮 ----
        location, shape = copy_loc, copy_shape

        if not location:
            # 连复制按钮都没有 -> 检查回答异常（豆包）
            if check_wrong_confirmed(templates):
                sys.exit(EXIT_HANDOFF)
            scroll_down(cfg)
            continue

        # ---- 4.1 豆包：等 related 标识后重新定位 copy（布局会被挤压）----
        if cfg["related_gate"]:
            print("初次定位到 Copy 按钮，开始检测 Related 标识...")
            gate_start = time.time()
            found_related = False
            while time.time() - gate_start < 4:
                rel_loc, _ = find(templates, "related")
                if rel_loc:
                    print("检测到 Related 标识（布局已变化），立即进行下一步。")
                    found_related = True
                    break
                sleep(0.5)
            if not found_related:
                print("4 秒内未检测到 Related 标识，准备重新定位 Copy。")

            location, shape = find(templates, "copy")
            if not location:
                print("等待后无法重新定位 Copy 按钮，检查是否回答异常...")
                if check_wrong_confirmed(templates):
                    sys.exit(EXIT_HANDOFF)
                scroll_down(cfg)
                continue        # 未实际点击，不消耗 attempt

        # ---- 5. 点击复制并校验 ----
        copy_offset = cfg.get("copy_offset", (0, 0))
        lx, ly = perform_click(location, shape, offset=copy_offset)
        print(f"第 {attempt} 次尝试 - 点击复制按钮: {lx}, {ly}")
        sleep(0.5)
        content = pyperclip.paste()

        if cfg["check_refusal_text"] and is_refusal_response(content):
            print("剪贴板命中拒答话术 -> 请求交接。")
            sys.exit(EXIT_HANDOFF)

        if is_content_qualified(content, min_chinese=target_threshold):
            print(f"第 {attempt} 次尝试成功：内容校验通过。")
            sys.exit(EXIT_OK)

        print(f"第 {attempt} 次尝试失败：内容不合格。")

        # 内容不合格时顺手检查回答异常（豆包）
        if check_wrong_confirmed(templates):
            sys.exit(EXIT_HANDOFF)

        attempt += 1
        if attempt <= MAX_ATTEMPTS:
            scroll_down(cfg, move_cursor=True)
        else:
            print("已达到最大尝试次数，内容均不合格。")
            sys.exit(EXIT_UNQUALIFIED)

    sys.exit(EXIT_UNQUALIFIED)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

-- ============================================================
-- News_Engine.scpt  v4
-- 统一新闻总结引擎：同时支持「Chrome 网页 AI」与「OpenAI 兼容 API」
--
-- 参数： {methodType, poeMode, shouldRepeat, providerChain}
--   methodType    : "" 表示按 provider 使用各自默认 Prompt
--   poeMode       : "normal" / "cheap"（只影响 API 的模型档位）
--   shouldRepeat  : true = 连续处理；false = 每篇后询问
--   providerChain : 例 "qianwen_ui@1,qianwen_api,deepseek_ui,doubao_ui"
--
-- provider 命名：
--   xxx_ui  -> Chrome 网页版（走 News_auto.py，免费）
--   xxx_api -> OpenAI 兼容 API（走 Modules/API_Client.py，付费）
--   裸名 qianwen/deepseek/doubao 自动等价于 _ui（向后兼容）
--
-- 链条语法 name@N：
--   该 provider 累计「有效拒答」达到 N 次后，永久把起点推进到它的下一个。
--   缺省 N=0 = 永不推进（只对当前文章临时交接）。
--
-- 「有效拒答」判定：
--   A 拒答 → 由紧邻的 B 接手，且 B 成功 ⇒ 说明不是文章问题（额度问题），计 1 次；
--   B 也拒答（最终由 C/D 兜底）⇒ 说明文章本身违规，不计数、不推进起点。
--
-- 【v4 新增】网页「上传/发送失败」处理（exit 7）：
--   网页版 provider 提交后如果检测到 xxx_upload_fail.png：
--     · 本篇临时改用「同品牌 API」兜底（qianwen_ui → qianwen_api）；
--     · 不计入「有效拒答」证据，不推进 providerStartIndex ⇒ 下一篇仍回网页版；
--     · 自动 reload 该 AI 的标签页，并复位千问「继续」弹窗检测标记；
--     · 连续 maxConsecutiveUploadFails 篇都上传失败则弹窗终止（防止烧光 API 额度）。
--
-- 退出码协议（News_auto.py 与 API_Client.py 共用）：
--   0 成功 / 1 内容不合格 / 2 超时 / 3 依赖或参数错误 / 4 API 错误
--   5 拒答需交接 / 6 用户中止 / 7 网页上传失败（本篇 API 兜底）
--   8 网页模型额度用完且已切换备用模型（同一 provider 重跑本篇，不计拒答）
-- ============================================================

property pythonPath : "/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/Current/bin/python3"
property scriptFolder : "/Users/yanzhang/Coding/python_code/"
property screenshotScript : "/Users/yanzhang/Coding/python_code/screenshot.py"
property notifyScript : "/Users/yanzhang/Coding/python_code/Modules/notification.py"
property apiClientScript : "/Users/yanzhang/Coding/python_code/Modules/API_Client.py"
property cliclickPath : "/opt/homebrew/bin/cliclick"
property copyFailurePath : "/Users/yanzhang/Coding/News/copy_failure.html"

-- 默认链条（没传第 4 个参数时用）
property defaultChain : "qianwen_ui@1,qianwen_api,deepseek_ui,doubao_ui"

-- 【开关】是否开启英文总结（true = 双语；false = 英文位置写原文）
property enableEnglishSummary : false
-- 英文总结用哪个 API provider
property englishApiProvider : "deepseek_api"

-- 【开关】内容不合格(exit 1) / 超时(exit 2) 是否也换下一个 AI（仅本篇）
property handoffOnFailure : false
-- 【开关】API 调用失败(exit 4) 是否换下一个 AI（仅本篇，不计入永久推进）
property handoffOnAPIError : true
-- API 连续失败多少次后强制终止（防止网络异常时把豆包额度烧光）
property maxConsecutiveAPIErrors : 3
-- API 调用的 AppleScript 超时保护（秒）
property apiTimeoutSeconds : 900

-- 【上传失败(exit 7) 相关开关】
-- true  = 本篇用 API 兜底；false = 退化为普通交接（顺延链条下一个）
property uploadFailUseApi : true
-- "auto" = 自动选同品牌 _api（找不到就找链条里任意 _api）
-- 也可以写死一个名字，例如 "qianwen_api"；若不在链条里会自动追加到链尾
property uploadFailFallback : "auto"
-- 连续 N 篇上传失败后强制终止（防止网页彻底挂掉后持续消耗 API 额度）
property maxConsecutiveUploadFails : 5
-- 连续 N 次上传失败后「永久」把起点推进到下一个 provider；0 = 永不（默认，符合"下一篇回网页版"）
property uploadFailAutoAdvance : 0
-- 【额度用完切换模型(exit 8)】每篇文章最多允许切换几次后重跑；超过则按拒答处理（交给链条下一个）
property maxModelSwitchesPerArticle : 1

-- 运行期状态
property consecutiveErrors : 0
property consecutiveAPIErrors : 0
property consecutiveUploadFails : 0
property qwContinueChecked : false
property providerStartIndex : 1
property chainNames : {}
property chainThresholds : {}
property refusalEvidence : {}


on run argv
	set consecutiveErrors to 0
	set consecutiveAPIErrors to 0
	set consecutiveUploadFails to 0
	set qwContinueChecked to false
	set providerStartIndex to 1
	
	set methodType to ""
	set poeMode to "normal"
	set shouldRepeat to false
	set chainText to defaultChain
	
	if (count of argv) ≥ 1 then set methodType to (item 1 of argv) as text
	if (count of argv) ≥ 2 then set poeMode to (item 2 of argv) as text
	if (count of argv) ≥ 3 then
		try
			set shouldRepeat to (item 3 of argv) as boolean
		on error
			set shouldRepeat to (((item 3 of argv) as text) is "true")
		end try
	end if
	if (count of argv) ≥ 4 then
		set t to (item 4 of argv) as text
		if t is not "" then set chainText to t
	end if
	
	my ParseChain(chainText)
	if (count of chainNames) is 0 then my ParseChain(defaultChain)
	
	-- 初始化拒答证据计数
	set refusalEvidence to {}
	repeat with k from 1 to (count of chainNames)
		set end of refusalEvidence to 0
	end repeat
	
	my Notify("链条：" & my ChainDescription(), "blue", 2500)
	
	-- 短文章用的翻译 Prompt
	set methodType2 to "----请将以上内容完整翻译成地道的中文，只是翻译，其它话都不要说"
	
	if shouldRepeat then
		repeat
			if my shouldStopByFile() then exit repeat
			set stopNow to my NewsOperation(methodType, poeMode, methodType2)
			if stopNow then exit repeat
		end repeat
	else
		repeat
			if my shouldStopByFile() then exit repeat
			set stopNow to my NewsOperation(methodType, poeMode, methodType2)
			if stopNow then exit repeat
			if my shouldStopByFile() then exit repeat
			
			set userResponse to display dialog "已成功处理一个页面。" & return & "是否继续处理下一个？" buttons {"终止", "继续"} default button "继续" cancel button "终止"
			if button returned of userResponse is "终止" then exit repeat
		end repeat
	end if
end run


-- ============================================================
-- 处理一篇文章；返回 true 表示要终止外层循环
-- ============================================================
on NewsOperation(methodType, poeMode, methodType2)
	set targetWebsites to {"nytimes.com", "nikkei.com", "bloomberg.com", "technologyreview.com", "economist.com", "hbr.org", "ft.com", "wsj.com", "reuters.com", "washingtonpost.com", "asia.nikkei.com", "rfi.fr", "dw.com", "bbc.com"}
	
	set foundWebsiteName to ""
	set foundTabId to -1
	set containsTargetWebsite to false
	set currentTabURL to ""
	
	tell application "Google Chrome"
		activate
		delay 0.2
		set tabList to every tab of front window
		
		repeat with i from 1 to the count of tabList
			set tabURL to URL of item i of tabList
			repeat with website in targetWebsites
				if tabURL contains website then
					set tld to text -3 thru -1 of website
					set pos to offset of tld in tabURL
					if pos ≠ 0 then
						set domainLength to length of website
						set startOfPostDomain to pos + domainLength - 3
						if length of tabURL ≥ startOfPostDomain + 7 then
							set currentTabURL to tabURL
							set containsTargetWebsite to true
							set foundWebsiteName to website
							set active tab index of front window to i
							set foundTabId to id of item i of tabList
							exit repeat
						end if
					end if
				end if
			end repeat
			if containsTargetWebsite then exit repeat
		end repeat
	end tell
	
	if not containsTargetWebsite then
		my Notify("没有可供总结的新闻页面了", "green", 2000)
		return true
	end if
	
	my handlename(foundWebsiteName, currentTabURL)
	set the clipboard to currentTabURL
	
	if currentTabURL contains "www.wsj.com/video/" then
		tell application "Google Chrome"
			close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
		end tell
		delay 0.5
		return false
	end if
	
	-- ==========================================================
	-- 分支 1：英文站点（需要 AI 总结）
	-- ==========================================================
	if currentTabURL contains "ft.com" or currentTabURL contains "technologyreview.com" or currentTabURL contains "economist.com" or currentTabURL contains "www.wsj.com" or currentTabURL contains "reuters.com" or currentTabURL contains "washingtonpost.com" or currentTabURL contains "asia.nikkei.com" or currentTabURL contains "bloomberg.com" or currentTabURL contains "nytimes.com" then
		
		if currentTabURL contains "reuters.com/pictures/" then
			my Scroll(5)
			delay 1
		else if currentTabURL contains "wsj.com" then
			my Scroll(1)
		else
			my Scroll(2)
		end if
		delay 0.2
		
		if currentTabURL contains "ft.com" then
			my OperationForFT()
		else
			my Operation()
		end if
		delay 0.2
		
		-- 关键词屏蔽检查
		try
			my runPythonScript("Clipboard_keyword_check.py", {currentTabURL})
		on error
			my Notify("包含屏蔽关键词，已跳过此文章", "red", 3000)
			tell application "Google Chrome"
				close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
			end tell
			my MoveImagesToTrash()
			return false
		end try
		
		my runPythonScript("Article_Copier.py", {currentTabURL})
		my runPythonScript("Clipboard_count_news.py", {})
		
		set filePathsuperlong to "/tmp/superlongarticle.txt"
		set filePathlong to "/tmp/longarticle.txt"
		set filePathshort to "/tmp/shortarticle.txt"
		
		set finalMethodType to methodType
		set finalPoeMode to poeMode
		
		set hasShort to false
		set hasLong to false
		set hasSuperlong to false
		
		tell application "System Events"
			if exists file filePathshort then
				delete file filePathshort
				set hasShort to true
			else if exists file filePathlong then
				delete file filePathlong
				set hasLong to true
			else if exists file filePathsuperlong then
				delete file filePathsuperlong
				set hasSuperlong to true
			end if
		end tell
		
		if hasShort then
			set finalMethodType to methodType2
			set finalPoeMode to "cheap"
		else if hasLong then
			set finalPoeMode to poeMode
		else if hasSuperlong then
			set finalPoeMode to "cheap"
		else
			my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, "文章太短")
			my Notify("文章太短，已跳过此文章", "orange", 2000)
			tell application "Google Chrome"
				close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
			end tell
			delay 0.5
			return false
		end if
		
		-- 原始文章内容（交接时复用，不用再复制页面）
		set rawArticleContent to the clipboard
		
		set autoWaitParam to "50"
		if currentTabURL contains "reuters.com/pictures" then set autoWaitParam to "10"
		
		set chainResult to my SummarizeWithChain(finalMethodType, rawArticleContent, autoWaitParam, currentTabURL, finalPoeMode)
		if chainResult is not "ok" then return true
		
		-- ================= 英文部分 =================
		if enableEnglishSummary is true then
			set englishOK to true
			try
				my RunEnglishSummary(rawArticleContent, finalPoeMode)
			on error errMsg number errNum
				if errNum is -128 or errNum is 6 then error number -128
				set englishOK to false
			end try
			
			if englishOK then
				set consecutiveErrors to 0
				my runPythonScript("Append_English_News.py", {})
				tell application "Google Chrome"
					close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
				end tell
				delay 0.5
			else
				set consecutiveErrors to consecutiveErrors + 1
				log "中文成功，但英文 API 失败。累计错误: " & consecutiveErrors
				if consecutiveErrors ≥ 3 then
					display dialog "⚠️ 警告：英文阶段已连续报错 3 次。" & return & return & "程序将强制终止。" buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
					error number -128
				end if
			end if
		else
			set the clipboard to rawArticleContent
			delay 0.2
			my runPythonScript("Append_English_News.py", {})
			set consecutiveErrors to 0
			tell application "Google Chrome"
				close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
			end tell
			delay 0.5
		end if
		
		-- ==========================================================
		-- 分支 2：中文站点（不走 AI）
		-- ==========================================================
	else if currentTabURL contains "cn.wsj.com" or currentTabURL contains "rfi.fr" or currentTabURL contains "dw.com" or currentTabURL contains "bbc.com/zhongwen" then
		my Scroll(1)
		delay 0.5
		my Operation()
		
		try
			my runPythonScript("Clipboard_keyword_check.py", {currentTabURL})
		on error
			my Notify("包含屏蔽关键词，已跳过此文章", "red", 3000)
			tell application "Google Chrome"
				close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
			end tell
			my MoveImagesToTrash()
			return false
		end try
		
		set checkChineseScript to "
import sys, subprocess

text = subprocess.run(['pbpaste'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout

cn_count = sum(1 for c in text if 0x4e00 <= ord(c) <= 0x9fff or 
                                  0x3400 <= ord(c) <= 0x4dbf or 
                                  0xf900 <= ord(c) <= 0xfaff or 
                                  0x3000 <= ord(c) <= 0x303f or 
                                  0xff00 <= ord(c) <= 0xffef)

en_count = sum(1 for c in text if c.isascii() and c.isalpha())

total_valid = cn_count + en_count

if total_valid == 0:
    sys.exit(1)

if en_count / total_valid > 1/2:
    sys.exit(1)

sys.exit(0)
"
		try
			do shell script quoted form of pythonPath & " -c " & quoted form of checkChineseScript
		on error
			my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, "非中文内容过多")
			my Notify("非中文内容过多，已跳过此文章", "red", 3000)
			tell application "Google Chrome"
				close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
			end tell
			return false
		end try
		
		my runPythonScript("Article_Copier.py", {currentTabURL})
		my Notify("等待下载图片....", "blue", 5000)
		my runPythonScript("CN_copy_News.py", {currentTabURL})
		delay 0.5
		tell application "Google Chrome"
			close (every tab of every window whose id is foundTabId)
		end tell
	end if
	
	return false
end NewsOperation


-- ============================================================
-- 链条调度：返回 "ok" 或 "stop"
-- v5：新增 exit 8（额度用完已切换模型 → 同 provider 重跑本篇）
-- ============================================================
on SummarizeWithChain(finalMethodType, rawArticleContent, autoWaitParam, currentTabURL, poeMode)
	set providerCount to count of chainNames
	if providerCount is 0 then
		display dialog "provider 链条为空，请检查参数。" buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
		error number -128
	end if
	
	if providerStartIndex < 1 then set providerStartIndex to 1
	if providerStartIndex > providerCount then set providerStartIndex to providerCount
	
	set startIdx to providerStartIndex
	set idx to startIdx
	set lastFailIdx to 0
	set lastFailWasRefusal to false
	set refusalCountThisArticle to 0
	set modelSwitchesThisArticle to 0
	set triedList to {}
	set stepCount to 0
	set maxSteps to (providerCount * 2) + 4 + maxModelSwitchesPerArticle
	
	repeat
		set providerCount to count of chainNames
		if idx < 1 or idx > providerCount then exit repeat
		
		set stepCount to stepCount + 1
		if stepCount > maxSteps then
			my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, "链条调度步数超限，已停止（疑似配置环路）")
			display dialog "⚠️ 链条调度异常（步数超限），已停止程序。" & return & return & "链条：" & my ChainDescription() buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
			return "stop"
		end if
		
		if my ListHasInteger(triedList, idx) then
			set idx to idx + 1
		else
			set end of triedList to idx
			set providerName to item idx of chainNames
			set stepOK to true
			set errNumKept to 0
			set errMsgKept to ""
			
			try
				my ExecuteProvider(providerName, finalMethodType, rawArticleContent, autoWaitParam, poeMode)
			on error errMsg number errNum
				set stepOK to false
				set errNumKept to errNum
				set errMsgKept to errMsg
			end try
			
			-- ---------- 成功 ----------
			if stepOK then
				if (lastFailIdx > 0) and (lastFailWasRefusal is true) and (idx is (lastFailIdx + 1)) and (refusalCountThisArticle is 1) then
					my CommitRefusalEvidence(lastFailIdx, currentTabURL)
				end if
				set consecutiveErrors to 0
				if my IsApiProvider(providerName) then
					set consecutiveAPIErrors to 0
				else
					set consecutiveUploadFails to 0
				end if
				
				try
					my runPythonScript("News_post.py", {providerName, currentTabURL})
				on error postMsg
					display dialog "❌ News_post.py 落盘失败，已停止以便排查：" & return & return & postMsg buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
					error number -128
				end try
				return "ok"
			end if
			
			-- ---------- 失败 ----------
			if errNumKept is -128 then error number -128
			if errNumKept is 6 then
				my Notify("用户中止了 API 窗口，已停止流程", "orange", 3000)
				error number -128
			end if
			
			-- ========== 额度用完且已切换模型（exit 8）==========
			set retrySameProvider to false
			if errNumKept is 8 then
				if modelSwitchesThisArticle < maxModelSwitchesPerArticle then
					set modelSwitchesThisArticle to modelSwitchesThisArticle + 1
					set retrySameProvider to true
					my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, my ProviderLabel(providerName) & " 模型免费额度用完 → 已切换备用模型，同 provider 重跑本篇（第 " & (modelSwitchesThisArticle as text) & " 次）")
					my Notify(my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "当前模型额度用完，已切换模型，本篇重新执行", "blue", 3000)
					-- 允许同一个 idx 再执行一次；不改 lastFail*，不计拒答证据
					set triedList to my ListRemoveInteger(triedList, idx)
					delay 1
				else
					-- 本篇切换次数已用完（例如备用模型也没额度）→ 退化为拒答，走原有交接/永久推进逻辑
					my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, my ProviderLabel(providerName) & " 切换模型后仍额度用完 → 按拒答交接")
					set errNumKept to 5
				end if
			end if
			
			if retrySameProvider then
				-- idx 不变，直接进入下一轮循环重跑
			else
				set isRefusal to (errNumKept is 5)
				set isApiError to (errNumKept is 4)
				set isUploadFail to (errNumKept is 7)
				
				-- ========== 分支：网页上传失败（exit 7） ==========
				if isUploadFail then
					set consecutiveUploadFails to consecutiveUploadFails + 1
					my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, my ProviderLabel(providerName) & " 网页上传失败(exit 7)，连续第 " & (consecutiveUploadFails as text) & " 次")
					
					if my BaseName(providerName) is "qianwen" then set qwContinueChecked to false
					my RecoverUIProvider(providerName)
					
					if consecutiveUploadFails ≥ maxConsecutiveUploadFails then
						display dialog "⚠️ " & my ProviderLabel(providerName) & " 已连续 " & (consecutiveUploadFails as text) & " 篇上传失败。" & return & return & "为避免持续消耗付费 API 额度，程序将终止，请手动检查网页状态后再运行。" buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
						error number -128
					end if
					
					if (uploadFailAutoAdvance > 0) and (consecutiveUploadFails ≥ uploadFailAutoAdvance) then
						if (idx + 1) ≤ (count of chainNames) and (providerStartIndex ≤ idx) then
							set providerStartIndex to idx + 1
							my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, my ProviderLabel(providerName) & " 连续上传失败达 " & (uploadFailAutoAdvance as text) & " 次 → 永久切换起点为 " & my ProviderLabel(item (idx + 1) of chainNames))
							my Notify(my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "网页疑似不可用，之后所有文章改从" & my ProviderLabel(item (idx + 1) of chainNames) & "开始", "purple", 4500)
						end if
					end if
					
					set lastFailIdx to idx
					set lastFailWasRefusal to false
					
					set fbIdx to 0
					if uploadFailUseApi is true then set fbIdx to my FindApiFallbackIndex(providerName, idx, triedList)
					
					if fbIdx > 0 then
						my Notify(my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "上传失败，本篇临时改用" & my ProviderLabel(item fbIdx of chainNames) & "；下一篇仍从" & my ProviderLabel(item providerStartIndex of chainNames) & "开始", "purple", 4000)
						delay 0.5
						set idx to fbIdx
					else
						if idx < (count of chainNames) then
							my Notify(my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "上传失败，无可用 API 兜底，本篇改由" & my ProviderLabel(item (idx + 1) of chainNames) & "接管", "purple", 3500)
							delay 0.5
							set idx to idx + 1
						else
							my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, my ProviderLabel(providerName) & " 上传失败且链条无后续可用 provider")
							display dialog "⚠️ 网页上传失败，且链条上没有可用的兜底 provider。" & return & return & "链条：" & my ChainDescription() & return & return & "当前文章：" & return & currentTabURL buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
							return "stop"
						end if
					end if
					
				else
					-- ========== 其它失败 ==========
					if isApiError then
						set consecutiveAPIErrors to consecutiveAPIErrors + 1
						my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, my ProviderLabel(providerName) & " API 调用失败：" & errMsgKept)
						if consecutiveAPIErrors ≥ maxConsecutiveAPIErrors then
							display dialog "⚠️ API 已连续失败 " & (consecutiveAPIErrors as text) & " 次。" & return & return & "最后一次错误：" & return & errMsgKept & return & return & "程序将强制终止。" buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
							error number -128
						end if
					end if
					
					set needHandoff to false
					if isRefusal then set needHandoff to true
					if isApiError and (handoffOnAPIError is true) then set needHandoff to true
					if (handoffOnFailure is true) and (errNumKept is 1 or errNumKept is 2) then set needHandoff to true
					
					if needHandoff then
						set lastFailIdx to idx
						set lastFailWasRefusal to isRefusal
						if isRefusal then set refusalCountThisArticle to refusalCountThisArticle + 1
						
						if idx < (count of chainNames) then
							set nextProvider to item (idx + 1) of chainNames
							if isRefusal then
								my Notify(my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "拒答，本篇改由" & my ProviderLabel(nextProvider) & "接管", "purple", 3000)
							else
								my Notify(my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "失败，本篇改由" & my ProviderLabel(nextProvider) & "接管", "purple", 3000)
							end if
							delay 0.5
							set idx to idx + 1
						else
							my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, my ProviderLabel(providerName) & "拒答/失败（兜底也失败）：" & errMsgKept)
							display dialog "⚠️ 链条上所有 AI 均拒答/异常，已停止程序。" & return & return & "链条：" & my ChainDescription() & return & "本次起点：" & my ProviderLabel(item startIdx of chainNames) & return & return & "当前文章：" & return & currentTabURL buttons {"终止"} default button "终止" with icon stop
							return "stop"
						end if
					else
						set alertMsg to ""
						if errNumKept is 1 then
							set alertMsg to "❌ " & my ProviderLabel(providerName) & " 内容校验失败：" & return & "结果汉字数不足 / 内容不合格。"
						else if errNumKept is 2 then
							set alertMsg to "⏱️ " & my ProviderLabel(providerName) & " 操作超时。"
						else if errNumKept is 3 then
							set alertMsg to "🖼️ 依赖缺失（模板图片 / Python 库 / 参数错误）：" & return & errMsgKept
						else if errNumKept is 4 then
							set alertMsg to "🌐 " & my ProviderLabel(providerName) & " API 调用失败：" & return & errMsgKept
						else if errNumKept is 7 then
							set alertMsg to "📎 " & my ProviderLabel(providerName) & " 网页上传失败，但当前配置未启用任何兜底方案。"
						else
							set alertMsg to "未知错误导致程序终止：" & return & errMsgKept & return & "错误编号：" & (errNumKept as text)
						end if
						display dialog alertMsg buttons {"确定"} default button "确定" with icon stop
						error number -128
					end if
				end if
			end if
		end if
	end repeat
	
	return "stop"
end SummarizeWithChain


-- 为「上传失败」挑选 API 兜底下标：0 表示没有
on FindApiFallbackIndex(providerName, currentIdx, triedList)
	-- 0) 显式指定
	if uploadFailFallback is not "auto" and uploadFailFallback is not "" then
		set forcedIdx to my EnsureProviderInChain(uploadFailFallback)
		if forcedIdx > 0 and not my ListHasInteger(triedList, forcedIdx) then return forcedIdx
	end if
	
	set b to my BaseName(providerName)
	
	-- 1) 同品牌 API（qianwen_ui → qianwen_api）
	repeat with k from 1 to (count of chainNames)
		set nm to item k of chainNames
		if my IsApiProvider(nm) and (my BaseName(nm) is b) and not my ListHasInteger(triedList, k) then return k
	end repeat
	
	-- 2) 链条上当前位置之后的任意 API
	repeat with k from (currentIdx + 1) to (count of chainNames)
		set nm to item k of chainNames
		if my IsApiProvider(nm) and not my ListHasInteger(triedList, k) then return k
	end repeat
	
	-- 3) 链条上任意未试过的 API
	repeat with k from 1 to (count of chainNames)
		set nm to item k of chainNames
		if my IsApiProvider(nm) and not my ListHasInteger(triedList, k) then return k
	end repeat
	
	return 0
end FindApiFallbackIndex


-- 确保某 provider 在链条中（不在则追加到链尾，阈值 0 = 不参与永久推进）
on EnsureProviderInChain(nm)
	set target to my NormalizeProvider(nm)
	if target is "" then return 0
	repeat with k from 1 to (count of chainNames)
		if (item k of chainNames) is target then return k
	end repeat
	set end of chainNames to target
	set end of chainThresholds to 0
	set end of refusalEvidence to 0
	return (count of chainNames)
end EnsureProviderInChain


-- 上传失败后刷新对应 AI 的网页，清掉脏状态
on RecoverUIProvider(p)
	set b to my BaseName(p)
	set domA to ""
	set domB to ""
	if b is "qianwen" then
		set domA to "qianwen.com"
		set domB to "tongyi"
	else if b is "deepseek" then
		set domA to "deepseek.com"
	else if b is "doubao" then
		set domA to "doubao.com"
	end if
	if domA is "" then return
	
	try
		tell application "Google Chrome"
			repeat with w in every window
				repeat with t in every tab of w
					set u to (URL of t) as text
					if (u contains domA) or ((domB is not "") and (u contains domB)) then
						reload t
					end if
				end repeat
			end repeat
		end tell
	end try
	delay 2
end RecoverUIProvider


-- 记录「有效拒答」并在达到阈值时永久推进起点
on CommitRefusalEvidence(i, currentTabURL)
	if i < 1 or i > (count of chainThresholds) then return
	set thresholdVal to item i of chainThresholds
	set newCount to my IncrementEvidence(i)
	if thresholdVal ≤ 0 then return
	if newCount < thresholdVal then return
	if (i + 1) > (count of chainNames) then return
	if providerStartIndex > i then return
	
	set providerStartIndex to i + 1
	set fromLabel to my ProviderLabel(item i of chainNames)
	set toLabel to my ProviderLabel(item (i + 1) of chainNames)
	my WriteCopyFailureLog(currentTabURL, fromLabel & " 有效拒答已达 " & (thresholdVal as text) & " 次 → 永久切换起点为 " & toLabel)
	my Notify(fromLabel & "额度/权限判定失效，之后所有文章改从" & toLabel & "开始", "purple", 4500)
end CommitRefusalEvidence


on IncrementEvidence(i)
	set newList to {}
	set outVal to 0
	repeat with k from 1 to (count of refusalEvidence)
		if k is i then
			set outVal to ((item k of refusalEvidence) + 1)
			set end of newList to outVal
		else
			set end of newList to (item k of refusalEvidence)
		end if
	end repeat
	set refusalEvidence to newList
	return outVal
end IncrementEvidence

-- provider 名称工具
-- ============================================================
on ParseChain(chainText)
	set rawItems to my SplitText(chainText, ",")
	set nameList to {}
	set thrList to {}
	repeat with itm in rawItems
		set t to (itm as text)
		set nm to t
		set thresholdVal to 0
		if t contains "@" then
			set parts to my SplitText(t, "@")
			if (count of parts) ≥ 1 then set nm to (item 1 of parts)
			if (count of parts) ≥ 2 then
				try
					set thresholdVal to ((item 2 of parts) as integer)
				on error
					set thresholdVal to 0
				end try
			end if
		end if
		set nm to my NormalizeProvider(nm)
		if nm is not "" then
			set end of nameList to nm
			set end of thrList to thresholdVal
		end if
	end repeat
	set chainNames to nameList
	set chainThresholds to thrList
end ParseChain

on NormalizeProvider(n)
	set t to my TrimText(n)
	if t is "qianwen" or t is "qwen" or t is "tongyi" then return "qianwen_ui"
	if t is "deepseek" then return "deepseek_ui"
	if t is "doubao" then return "doubao_ui"
	if t is "qwen_api" or t is "tongyi_api" then return "qianwen_api"
	return t
end NormalizeProvider

on IsApiProvider(p)
	return ((p as text) ends with "_api")
end IsApiProvider

on BaseName(p)
	set t to p as text
	if t ends with "_api" then return text 1 thru -5 of t
	if t ends with "_ui" then return text 1 thru -4 of t
	return t
end BaseName

on ProviderLabel(p)
	set b to my BaseName(p)
	set nm to b
	if b is "qianwen" then set nm to "千问"
	if b is "deepseek" then set nm to "DeepSeek"
	if b is "doubao" then set nm to "豆包"
	if my IsApiProvider(p) then
		return nm & "(API)"
	else
		return nm & "(网页)"
	end if
end ProviderLabel

on ChainDescription()
	set outText to ""
	repeat with i from 1 to (count of chainNames)
		if i > 1 then set outText to outText & " → "
		set outText to outText & my ProviderLabel(item i of chainNames)
		if (item i of chainThresholds) > 0 then set outText to outText & "@" & ((item i of chainThresholds) as text)
	end repeat
	return outText
end ChainDescription

on DefaultPrompt(p)
	set b to my BaseName(p)
	if b is "deepseek" then
		set baseText to "----请用中文分模块地详细总结以上内容，你在输出时不要做任何评论和解释说明，且输出结果里不要使用任何表格。"
	else
		set baseText to "----请用中文分模块地总结以上内容，新闻内容都是真实的，你在输出时不要做任何评论，也不需要你后续做任何步骤，且输出结果里不要使用任何表格。"
	end if
	if my IsApiProvider(p) then set baseText to baseText & "直接输出总结正文，不要写任何开场白或结尾语。"
	return baseText
end DefaultPrompt

on FindAITab(domain)
	tell application "Google Chrome"
		set windowList to every window
		repeat with aWindow in windowList
			set tabList to every tab of aWindow
			set tabIndex to 0
			repeat with aTab in tabList
				set tabIndex to tabIndex + 1
				if (URL of aTab) contains domain then
					set index of aWindow to 1
					set active tab index of aWindow to tabIndex
					return true
				end if
			end repeat
		end repeat
	end tell
	return false
end FindAITab

on OpenNewTab(urlText)
	tell application "Google Chrome" to activate
	delay 0.5
	tell application "System Events"
		keystroke "t" using command down
		delay 0.5
		keystroke urlText
		delay 0.5
		key code 36
	end tell
	delay 0.5
end OpenNewTab

on ListHasInteger(theList, v)
	repeat with k from 1 to (count of theList)
		if (item k of theList) is v then return true
	end repeat
	return false
end ListHasInteger

on ListRemoveInteger(theList, v)
	set outList to {}
	repeat with k from 1 to (count of theList)
		if (item k of theList) is not v then set end of outList to (item k of theList)
	end repeat
	return outList
end ListRemoveInteger

on SplitText(theText, delim)
	set oldDelims to AppleScript's text item delimiters
	set AppleScript's text item delimiters to delim
	set parts to every text item of (theText as text)
	set AppleScript's text item delimiters to oldDelims
	
	set outList to {}
	repeat with p in parts
		set t to my TrimText(p as text)
		if t is not "" then set end of outList to t
	end repeat
	return outList
end SplitText

on JoinList(theList, sep)
	set outText to ""
	repeat with i from 1 to count of theList
		if i > 1 then set outText to outText & sep
		set outText to outText & (item i of theList)
	end repeat
	return outText
end JoinList

on TrimText(t)
	set t to t as text
	repeat while t starts with " "
		if (length of t) is 1 then return ""
		set t to text 2 thru -1 of t
	end repeat
	repeat while t ends with " "
		if (length of t) is 1 then return ""
		set t to text 1 thru -2 of t
	end repeat
	return t
end TrimText

import os
import cv2
import sys
import time
import pyautogui
import numpy as np
from time import sleep
from PIL import ImageGrab
from typing import List, Tuple, Optional, Union

# ================= 配置区域 =================

# 1. 动态获取当前用户的主目录
USER_HOME = os.path.expanduser("~")

# 2. 定义资源目录
# 假设资源文件夹结构是: ~/Coding/python_code/Resource
# 如果在 Windows 上路径不同，请在这里修改
BASE_RESOURCE_DIR = os.path.join(USER_HOME, "Coding", "python_code", "Resource")

# ===========================================

class ScreenDetector:
    def __init__(self, template_names: Union[str, List[str]],
                 clickValue: Optional[str] = None,
                 Opposite: bool = False,
                 scroll_on_not_found_run1: bool = False,
                 x_offset: Optional[int] = None,
                 y_offset: Optional[int] = None,
                 nth_match: int = 1,
                 timeout_seconds: int = 590):
        self.templates = []
        self.clickValue = clickValue
        self.Opposite = Opposite
        self.scroll_on_not_found_run1 = scroll_on_not_found_run1
        self.x_offset = x_offset
        self.y_offset = y_offset
        self.nth_match = max(1, nth_match)
        self.timeout_seconds = timeout_seconds

        if isinstance(template_names, str):
            self.template_name_list = [name.strip() for name in template_names.split(',')]
        else:
            self.template_name_list = template_names
        
        # <--- 新增：计算屏幕缩放因子 (用于处理 Mac Retina 2x 问题)
        self.scale_factor = self._get_scale_factor()
        print(f"检测到屏幕缩放因子: {self.scale_factor}")

        self._load_templates(self.template_name_list)

    def _get_scale_factor(self) -> float:
        """
        计算 ImageGrab (物理像素) 和 pyautogui (逻辑坐标) 之间的缩放比例。
        在 Mac Retina 屏上通常是 2.0，在普通 Windows 屏上通常是 1.0。
        """
        try:
            # 获取屏幕截图的宽度
            with ImageGrab.grab() as sc:
                img_width = sc.size[0]
            
            # 获取 pyautogui 认为的屏幕宽度
            screen_width, _ = pyautogui.size()
            
            return img_width / screen_width
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"警告: 无法计算屏幕缩放因子，默认为 1.0。错误: {e}")
            return 1.0

    def _load_templates(self, template_names_list: List[str]) -> None:
        """优化的模板加载方法"""
        for template_name in template_names_list:
            # <--- 修改：使用动态路径
            template_path = os.path.join(BASE_RESOURCE_DIR, template_name)
            try:
                # <--- 新增：检查文件是否存在，避免 cv2.imread 静默失败
                if not os.path.exists(template_path):
                    print(f"错误: 模板文件不存在: {template_path}")
                    continue

                template_img = cv2.imread(template_path, cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
                if template_img is None:
                    print(f"警告: 模板图片未能正确读取于路径 {template_path}")
                    continue
                self.templates.append((template_name, template_img))
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"An unexpected error occurred while loading template {template_name}: {e}")
                continue

    def capture_screen(self) -> np.ndarray:
        """优化的屏幕捕获方法"""
        with ImageGrab.grab() as screenshot:
            # 转换为 numpy 数组 (BGR 格式用于 OpenCV)
            img_np = np.array(screenshot)
            # 处理部分系统截图带 Alpha 通道的情况 (RGBA -> BGR)
            if img_np.shape[2] == 4:
                return cv2.cvtColor(img_np, cv2.COLOR_RGBA2BGR)
            return cv2.cvtColor(img_np, cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)

    def find_images_on_screen(self, threshold: float = 0.95) -> Tuple[Optional[str], Optional[Tuple[int, int]], Optional[Tuple[int, int, int]]]:
        """
        在屏幕上查找所有模板，并返回匹配得分最高的那个。
        """
        screen = self.capture_screen()
        
        best_match_info = {
            "score": -1.0,
            "name": None,
            "location": None,
            "shape": None
        }

        for template_name, template in self.templates:
            if template is None:
                continue
            
            # 确保模板尺寸不大于屏幕尺寸，否则 cv2.matchTemplate 会报错
            if template.shape[0] > screen.shape[0] or template.shape[1] > screen.shape[1]:
                print(f"警告: 模板 {template_name} 尺寸 {template.shape} 大于屏幕截图 {screen.shape}，跳过。")
                continue

            result = cv2.matchTemplate(screen, template, cv2.TM_CCOEFF_NORMED)
            min_val, max_val, min_loc, max_loc = cv2.minMaxLoc(result)

            if max_val > best_match_info["score"]:
                best_match_info.update({
                    "score": max_val,
                    "name": template_name,
                    "location": max_loc,
                    "shape": template.shape
                })

        if best_match_info["score"] >= threshold:
            print(f"找到最佳匹配: {best_match_info['name']}，分数为: {best_match_info['score']:.4f}")
            return best_match_info["name"], best_match_info["location"], best_match_info["shape"]
        
        return None, None, None

    def _perform_click(self, location: Tuple[int, int], shape: Tuple[int, int, int]) -> None:
        """
        优化的点击操作，自动处理 Retina 缩放。
        location: (x, y) - 这是基于 ImageGrab 截图（物理像素）的坐标
        shape: (h, w, c) - 模板的物理像素尺寸
        """
        # 1. 计算物理像素坐标系的中心点
        phys_center_x = location[0] + shape[1] // 2
        phys_center_y = location[1] + shape[0] // 2
        
        # 2. <--- 关键修改：转换为逻辑坐标 (pyautogui 使用的坐标)
        # 比如 Retina 屏 scale_factor=2，物理坐标 200 对应逻辑坐标 100
        logic_center_x = int(phys_center_x / self.scale_factor)
        logic_center_y = int(phys_center_y / self.scale_factor)

        # 3. 应用偏移量 (偏移量通常由用户指定，假设用户想的是逻辑偏移量)
        if self.x_offset is not None:
            logic_center_x += self.x_offset
        if self.y_offset is not None:
            logic_center_y += self.y_offset

        # 4. 执行点击
        try:
            if self.clickValue == "left":
                pyautogui.click(logic_center_x, logic_center_y, button='left')
                print(f"执行左键点击于: ({logic_center_x}, {logic_center_y}) [物理: ({phys_center_x}, {phys_center_y})]")
            elif self.clickValue == "right":
                pyautogui.click(logic_center_x, logic_center_y, button='right')
                print(f"执行右键点击于: ({logic_center_x}, {logic_center_y}) [物理: ({phys_center_x}, {phys_center_y})]")
        except pyautogui.FailSafeException:
            print("错误: 触发了 PyAutoGUI 的故障安全机制 (鼠标移到了角落)。")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"点击操作失败: {e}")

    def run1(self) -> str:
        timeout = time.time() + self.timeout_seconds
        
        while time.time() < timeout:
            template_name, location, shape = self.find_images_on_screen(threshold=0.9)
            
            if location and template_name and shape:
                if self.clickValue:
                    self._perform_click(location, shape)
                print(f"找到图片 {template_name} 位置: {location}")
                if len(self.template_name_list) > 1:
                    print(f"FOUND_IMAGE:{template_name}")
                return template_name      
            else:
                if self.scroll_on_not_found_run1:
                    print("在 run1 中未找到图片，执行滚动操作 pyautogui.scroll(-120)")
                    pyautogui.scroll(-120)
                    sleep(0.5)
            sleep(1)
        
        print(f"在 {self.timeout_seconds} 秒内未找到图片，退出程序。")
        return "TIMEOUT"

    def run2(self) -> None:
        """优化的运行方法2 - 持续查找，直到找不到图片（等待图片消失）"""
        timeout = time.time() + self.timeout_seconds
        
        while time.time() < timeout:
            # 将阈值降低到 0.9，防止因为微小的渲染差异导致误判图片已消失
            template_name, location, shape = self.find_images_on_screen(threshold=0.9)
            
            if not location:
                print("未找到图片，认为图片已消失，退出run2。")
                break
            
            print(f"图片 {template_name} 仍在屏幕上位置: {location}，等待其消失...")
            # 移除了 pyautogui.scroll(-120)，防止滚动导致图片位置变化或模糊从而误判
            sleep(1)

def parse_args() -> Tuple[Union[str, List[str]], Optional[str], bool, bool, Optional[int], Optional[int], int, int]:
    """参数解析函数"""
    if len(sys.argv) < 4:
        print("用法: python a.py <image_name1[,image_name2...]> <click_type> <Opposite> [scroll] [x] [y] [nth] [timeout]")
        sys.exit(1)

    image_names_str = sys.argv[1]
    
    click_arg = sys.argv[2].lower()
    clickValue: Optional[str] = None
    if click_arg == 'true':
        clickValue = 'left'
    elif click_arg == 'right':
        clickValue = 'right'
    elif click_arg == 'false':
        clickValue = None
    else:
        print(f"错误: 无效的 click_type '{sys.argv[2]}'.")
        sys.exit(1)

    Opposite = sys.argv[3].lower() == 'true'
    
    scroll_in_run1: bool = False
    current_arg_index = 4
    if len(sys.argv) > current_arg_index:
        potential_scroll_arg = sys.argv[current_arg_index].lower()
        if potential_scroll_arg in ['true', 'false']:
            scroll_in_run1 = potential_scroll_arg == 'true'
            current_arg_index += 1
    
    x_offset: Optional[int] = None
    y_offset: Optional[int] = None
    nth_match: int = 1
    timeout_seconds: int = 590
    
    final_optional_args = sys.argv[current_arg_index:]
    try:
        # 这里使用更灵活的解析方式，依次填充非空参数
        if len(final_optional_args) >= 1: x_offset = int(final_optional_args[0])
        if len(final_optional_args) >= 2: y_offset = int(final_optional_args[1])
        if len(final_optional_args) >= 3: nth_match = int(final_optional_args[2])
        if len(final_optional_args) >= 4: timeout_seconds = int(final_optional_args[3])
    except (ValueError, IndexError):
        pass

    return image_names_str, clickValue, Opposite, scroll_in_run1, x_offset, y_offset, nth_match, timeout_seconds

if __name__ == '__main__':
    args_tuple = parse_args()
    
    detector = ScreenDetector(
        template_names=args_tuple[0],
        clickValue=args_tuple[1],
        Opposite=args_tuple[2],
        scroll_on_not_found_run1=args_tuple[3],
        x_offset=args_tuple[4],
        y_offset=args_tuple[5],
        nth_match=args_tuple[6],
        timeout_seconds=args_tuple[7]
    )
    
    try:
        if args_tuple[2]:  # Opposite is True, run run2
            detector.run2()
        else: # Opposite is False, run run1
            result = detector.run1()
            print(result) 
    finally:
        print("程序执行完毕。")
