-- ==========================================
-- 全局变量（handler 内需要访问的都必须声明为 global）
-- ==========================================
global pythonBin, pythonScriptPath, logFilePath, enableStepNotify, notifyTitle, roundNo
global m3u8SettleDelay, m3u8OffsetX, m3u8OffsetY, m3u8TolX, m3u8TolY, m3u8IndexTimeout, m3u8ClickTimeout
global pysJsPath, pysMaxAttempts, pysExtractTimeout, pysFallbackGrace, pysPollInterval

-- 定义 Python 解释器路径，方便复用
set pythonBin to "/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/Current/bin/python3"
-- 截图脚本路径
set pythonScriptPath to "/Users/yanzhang/Coding/python_code/screenshot.py"
-- 定义停止触发文件的路径（桌面上的 stop_scpt.txt）
set stopFilePath to POSIX path of (path to desktop) & "stop_scpt.txt"

-- ==========================================
-- 通知 / 日志配置
--   enableStepNotify = true：每个环节弹 macOS 通知
--   无论开关与否，所有步骤都会写入 logFilePath，可用 tail -f 实时查看
-- ==========================================
set enableStepNotify to true
set notifyTitle to "Downie 自动化"
set logFilePath to "/tmp/downie_auto.log"
set roundNo to 0

-- ==========================================
-- 两阶段配置
-- ==========================================
set readPyPath to "/Users/yanzhang/Coding/python_code/OVideo/read.py"
set writePyPath to "/Users/yanzhang/Coding/python_code/OVideo/write.py"
set blacklistPyPath to "/Users/yanzhang/Coding/python_code/OVideo/404_move.py"
set syncShPath to "/Users/yanzhang/Coding/sh/sync_to_server.sh"
set syncFlagPath to "/tmp/downie_sync_done.flag"

-- 当本机 IP 为该地址时，跳过同步脚本（视为已成功）
set skipSyncIP to "192.168.50.165"

-- ==========================================
-- 【新增】pys 专用流程配置（Chrome 打开页面 + JS 提取播放地址）
--   pysUseChromeFlow = true  : pys 链接走 Chrome 新流程
--   pysUseChromeFlow = false : pys 链接回到原 Downie 流程（封禁解除后改这里即可）
-- ==========================================
set pysUseChromeFlow to true
set pysKeyword to "www.pys"
set pysJsPath to "/Users/yanzhang/Coding/python_code/OVideo/pys_extract.js"
set pysMaxAttempts to 2 -- 每条 URL 最多打开几次页面
set pysExtractTimeout to 30 -- 每次打开后最多轮询多少秒
set pysFallbackGrace to 8 -- 仅拿到页面变量(FALLBACK)时，至少等待多少秒再采用
set pysPollInterval to 1 -- 轮询间隔（秒）
set pysMaxFailStreak to 3 -- 连续失败多少条即停止自动化（防止网站改版导致批量误拉黑）
set pysRoundDelay to 1 -- 每条 pys 链接处理完后的间隔（秒），避免请求过快
set pysFailStreak to 0

-- ==========================================
-- 状态扫描配置
-- ==========================================
set statusScanTimeout to 3500

-- ==========================================
-- close 点击次数阈值配置
-- ==========================================
set maxCloseClicks to 5
set minCloseClicks to 2
set maxCloseAttempts to 400

-- ==========================================
-- m3u8 流程配置
--   偏移为 pyautogui 逻辑坐标（与日志"执行左键点击于"一致）
--   例：index(873,417) -> addm3u8(1111,441) => 偏移 (238, 24)
-- ==========================================
set m3u8SettleDelay to 5
set m3u8OffsetX to 238
set m3u8OffsetY to 24
set m3u8TolX to 60
set m3u8TolY to 20
set m3u8IndexTimeout to 3
set m3u8ClickTimeout to 10

-- ==========================================
-- 404 后的 verify / addm3u8 流程配置
-- ==========================================
set verifyWaitTimeout to 15 -- 检测到 404 后，同时寻找 verify / addm3u8 的最长秒数
set m3u8AfterVerifyTimeout to 15 -- 点击 verify 后，继续寻找 addm3u8 的最长秒数
set maxVerifyClicks to 1 -- 最多点击 verify 的次数（达到后只找 addm3u8）

-- 阶段 1：Movie 2 个完整渠道；短剧 1；长剧 1
set phase1Args to "--movie-channels 2 --series-short-channels 1 --series-long-channels 1"
-- 阶段 2：Movie 3 个完整渠道；短剧 2；长剧 1
set phase2Args to "--movie-channels 3 --series-short-channels 2 --series-long-channels 1"

set currentPhase to 1
set readArgs to phase1Args
set allDone to false

-- 统一的停止原因（每个退出点都会设置，循环结束后统一强制通知）
set stopReason to ""
set stopTitle to "自动化已停止"

my writeLog("==================== 自动化启动 ====================")
if pysUseChromeFlow then
	my writeLog("pys 链接处理方式：Chrome 提取新流程（关键字: " & pysKeyword & "）")
else
	my writeLog("pys 链接处理方式：原 Downie 流程")
end if
my notify("自动化启动，日志文件: " & logFilePath)

repeat
	try
		-- ==========================================
		-- 0. 检查是否存在手动停止的触发文件
		-- ==========================================
		set stopFileExists to false
		try
			do shell script "test -e " & quoted form of stopFilePath
			set stopFileExists to true
		end try
		if stopFileExists then
			try
				do shell script "rm -f " & quoted form of stopFilePath
			end try
			set stopReason to "检测到桌面的 stop_scpt.txt，脚本已安全停止。"
			set stopTitle to "自动化已手动停止"
			exit repeat
		end if
		delay 0.5
		
		set roundNo to roundNo + 1
		
		-- ==========================================
		-- 1. 执行 read.py（带阶段参数）
		-- ==========================================
		repeat
			set readCmd to pythonBin & " " & quoted form of readPyPath & " " & readArgs
			my notify("执行 read.py（阶段 " & currentPhase & "）…")
			set readResult to do shell script readCmd
			
			if readResult contains "所有视频链接都已处理完毕" then
				if currentPhase = 1 then
					my notify("阶段 1 完成。")
					
					if my hasLocalIP(skipSyncIP) then
						my forceNotify("本机 IP 为 " & skipSyncIP & "，跳过同步脚本。", notifyTitle)
						set syncOK to true
					else
						my forceNotify("第一阶段处理完毕，开始同步到服务器…", notifyTitle)
						set syncOK to my runSyncScript(syncShPath, syncFlagPath)
					end if
					
					if not syncOK then
						set stopReason to "同步脚本执行失败或超时，自动化已停止。"
						set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
						set allDone to true
						exit repeat
					end if
					
					my forceNotify("同步成功，进入第二阶段（更多渠道）。", notifyTitle)
					set currentPhase to 2
					set readArgs to phase2Args
					delay 1
				else
					set stopReason to "所有链接已处理完毕，自动化结束。"
					set stopTitle to "自动化完成"
					set allDone to true
					exit repeat
				end if
			else
				exit repeat
			end if
		end repeat
		
		if allDone then exit repeat
		delay 0.5
		
		-- ==========================================
		-- 【修复】优先从 read.py 输出的 CURRENT_URL: 行获取当前 URL，剪贴板仅作兜底
		-- ==========================================
		set currentURL to ""
		repeat with p in (paragraphs of readResult)
			set pText to (p as text)
			if (pText starts with "CURRENT_URL:") and ((length of pText) > 12) then
				set currentURL to text 13 thru -1 of pText
			end if
		end repeat
		if currentURL is "" then
			try
				set currentURL to (the clipboard as text)
			on error
				set currentURL to ""
			end try
		end if
		if currentURL is "" then
			set stopReason to "read.py 未返回当前 URL（输出异常），自动化已停止。"
			set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
			exit repeat
		end if
		my notify("当前 URL: " & currentURL)
		
		set isPysURL to (currentURL contains pysKeyword)
		-- 白名单仅用于原流程的 ignore 分支
		set isWhitelistURL to isPysURL
		
		if pysUseChromeFlow and isPysURL then
			-- ##########################################################
			-- 【新增】pys 专用流程：Chrome 打开 → JS 提取 → write.py --direct-url
			-- ##########################################################
			my notify("检测到 pys 链接，走 Chrome 提取流程（跳过 Downie）。")
			set pysRes to my pysExtract(currentURL)
			set pysStatus to item 1 of pysRes
			set pysMedia to item 2 of pysRes
			set pysTitle to item 3 of pysRes
			set pysDetail to item 4 of pysRes
			
			if pysStatus is "OK" then
				my notify("[pys] 提取成功（" & pysDetail & "）：" & pysMedia)
				set wCmd to pythonBin & " " & quoted form of writePyPath & ¬
					" --direct-url " & quoted form of pysMedia & ¬
					" --name " & quoted form of pysTitle & ¬
					" --key " & quoted form of currentURL
				set wOut to do shell script wCmd
				my writeLog("write.py --direct-url 输出: " & wOut)
				set pysFailStreak to 0
				
			else if pysStatus is "JS_DISABLED" then
				set stopReason to "Chrome 未开启「显示 > 开发者 > 允许 Apple 事件中的 JavaScript」，pys 流程无法执行，自动化已停止。"
				set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
				exit repeat
				
			else if pysStatus is "CONFIG_ERROR" then
				set stopReason to "pys 流程配置/环境错误：" & pysDetail
				set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
				exit repeat
				
			else
				set pysFailStreak to pysFailStreak + 1
				if pysFailStreak ≥ pysMaxFailStreak then
					-- 当前这条不拉黑（mapping 中保留空值，下次启动会重试）
					set stopReason to "pys 链接已连续 " & pysFailStreak & " 条提取失败（疑似网站改版/拦截/网络异常），为避免误拉黑，自动化已停止。最后详情：" & pysDetail
					set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
					exit repeat
				end if
				my forceNotify("[pys] 未能提取播放地址（" & pysDetail & "），拉黑当前 URL（连续失败 " & pysFailStreak & "/" & pysMaxFailStreak & "）。", notifyTitle)
				set bCmd to pythonBin & " " & quoted form of writePyPath & ¬
					" --blacklist-key " & quoted form of currentURL & ¬
					" --name " & quoted form of pysTitle & ¬
					" --reason " & quoted form of ("pys 提取失败: " & pysDetail)
				set bOut to do shell script bCmd
				my writeLog("write.py --blacklist-key 输出: " & bOut)
			end if
			
			delay pysRoundDelay
			my notify("本轮处理完毕（pys 流程），进入下一轮。")
			
		else
			-- ##########################################################
			-- 原 Downie 流程（保持不变）
			-- ##########################################################
			
			-- ==========================================
			-- 2. 激活 Downie 4
			-- ==========================================
			my notify("激活 Downie 4…")
			tell application "/Applications/Downie 4.app"
				activate
			end tell
			
			tell application "System Events"
				tell process "Downie 4"
					set frontmost to true
				end tell
			end tell
			delay 0.5
			
			-- ==========================================
			-- 3. 执行截图点击流程 (screenshot.py)
			-- ==========================================
			set Opposite to "false"
			
			-- 截图 1: downie_add.png
			my notify("开始寻找并点击 downie_add.png…")
			set cmdResult to my shot("downie_add.png true " & Opposite)
			if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
				set stopReason to "长时间未找到 downie_add.png，自动化已停止。"
				set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
				exit repeat
			end if
			delay 0.5
			
			-- ==========================================
			-- 3.2 同时扫描 addselect, 404, again, more, ignore
			-- ==========================================
			set skipNormalFlow to false
			set ignoreCount to 0
			set maxIgnoreCount to 2
			set shouldExitMain to false
			set scanImages to "downie_addselect.png,downie_404.png,downie_again.png,downie_more.png,downie_ignore.png"
			
			repeat
				my notify("开始扫描状态：addselect / 404 / again / more / ignore…")
				set cmdResult to my shot(quoted form of scanImages & " false " & Opposite & " false 0 0 1 " & statusScanTimeout)
				
				if cmdResult contains "FOUND_IMAGE:downie_ignore.png" then
					-- -------- ignore 分支 --------
					if isWhitelistURL then
						my notify("检测到 ignore，但 URL 属白名单，跳过点击，进入 more 流程。")
						exit repeat
					end if
					
					set ignoreCount to ignoreCount + 1
					
					if ignoreCount ≥ maxIgnoreCount then
						my notify("ignore 已达 " & maxIgnoreCount & " 次，点击 ignore 并拉黑当前 URL。")
						
						set clickResult to my shot("downie_ignore.png true " & Opposite)
						if clickResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
							set stopReason to "downie_ignore.png 点击超时，自动化已停止。"
							set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
							set shouldExitMain to true
							exit repeat
						end if
						delay 0.5
						
						do shell script "/opt/homebrew/bin/cliclick m:187,504"
						delay 0.5
						
						my blacklistCurrent(blacklistPyPath)
						set skipNormalFlow to true
						exit repeat
					else
						my notify("检测到 ignore（第 " & ignoreCount & " 次），点击 ignore 后重新添加。")
						
						set clickResult to my shot("downie_ignore.png true " & Opposite)
						if clickResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
							set stopReason to "downie_ignore.png 点击超时，自动化已停止。"
							set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
							set shouldExitMain to true
							exit repeat
						end if
						delay 0.5
						
						my notify("重新点击 downie_add.png…")
						set clickResult to my shot("downie_add.png true " & Opposite)
						if clickResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
							set stopReason to "重新添加时未找到 downie_add.png，自动化已停止。"
							set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
							set shouldExitMain to true
							exit repeat
						end if
						delay 0.5
					end if
				else
					exit repeat
				end if
			end repeat
			
			if shouldExitMain then exit repeat
			
			-- ==========================================
			-- 分支处理：TIMEOUT / 404 / again / more / addselect
			-- ==========================================
			if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
				set stopReason to "状态扫描超时（" & statusScanTimeout & " 秒），未检测到任何目标图片，自动化已停止。"
				set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
				exit repeat
				
			else if cmdResult contains "FOUND_IMAGE:downie_404.png" then
				my notify("检测到 downie_404.png，进入 verify / addm3u8 流程。")
				set r404 to my handle404(blacklistPyPath, verifyWaitTimeout, m3u8AfterVerifyTimeout, maxVerifyClicks)
				if r404 is "STOP" then
					set stopReason to "downie_addm3u8.png 已消失，无法点击，自动化已停止。"
					set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
					exit repeat
				else if r404 is "BLACKLISTED" then
					set skipNormalFlow to true
				else
					my notify("addm3u8 流程完成，进入 more 流程。")
				end if
				
			else if cmdResult contains "FOUND_IMAGE:downie_again.png" then
				my notify("检测到 downie_again.png，点击后进入 more 流程。")
				set clickAgainResult to my shot("downie_again.png true " & Opposite)
				if clickAgainResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
					set stopReason to "downie_again.png 点击超时，自动化已停止。"
					set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
					exit repeat
				end if
				delay 0.5
				
			else if cmdResult contains "FOUND_IMAGE:downie_more.png" then
				my notify("检测到 downie_more.png，直接进入后续流程。")
				
			else if cmdResult contains "FOUND_IMAGE:downie_addselect.png" then
				my notify("检测到 downie_addselect.png，开始选择流程（检测 douban）…")
				delay 0.5
				
				set doubanFound to true
				set doubanResult to my shot("downie_douban.png false " & Opposite & " false 0 0 1 3")
				if doubanResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
					set doubanFound to false
					my notify("未检测到 douban，将跳过 Down Arrow。")
				else
					my notify("检测到 douban，执行完整选择流程。")
				end if
				
				my notify("开始寻找并点击 downie_select.png…")
				set cmdResult to my shot("downie_select.png true " & Opposite)
				if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
					set stopReason to "未找到 downie_select.png，自动化已停止。"
					set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
					exit repeat
				end if
				delay 0.5
				
				my notify("开始寻找并点击 downie_none.png…")
				set cmdResult to my shot("downie_none.png true " & Opposite)
				if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
					set stopReason to "未找到 downie_none.png，自动化已停止。"
					set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
					exit repeat
				end if
				delay 0.5
				
				tell application "System Events"
					key code 48 -- Tab
					delay 0.5
					if doubanFound then
						key code 125 -- Down Arrow
						delay 0.5
					end if
					key code 49 -- Space
					delay 0.5
				end tell
				
				my notify("开始寻找并点击 downie_addselect.png（确认）…")
				set cmdResult to my shot("downie_addselect.png true " & Opposite)
				if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
					set stopReason to "确认时未找到 downie_addselect.png，自动化已停止。"
					set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
					exit repeat
				end if
				delay 1
				
			else
				my notify("未命中特殊分支（如 ignore 白名单跳过），按 skipNormalFlow 继续。")
			end if
			
			-- ==========================================
			-- more.png 及以后的流程
			-- ==========================================
			if not skipNormalFlow then
				set clickValue to "true"
				
				my notify("开始寻找并点击 downie_more.png…")
				set cmdResult to my shot("downie_more.png " & clickValue & " " & Opposite)
				if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
					set stopReason to "未找到 downie_more.png，自动化已停止。"
					set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
					exit repeat
				end if
				delay 0.5
				
				my notify("开始寻找并点击 downie_savemeta.png…")
				set cmdResult to my shot("downie_savemeta.png " & clickValue & " " & Opposite)
				if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
					set stopReason to "未找到 downie_savemeta.png，自动化已停止。"
					set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
					exit repeat
				end if
				delay 0.5
				
				my notify("开始寻找并点击 downie_savejson.png…")
				set cmdResult to my shot("downie_savejson.png " & clickValue & " " & Opposite)
				if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
					set stopReason to "未找到 downie_savejson.png，自动化已停止。"
					set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
					exit repeat
				end if
				delay 0.5
				
				-- ==========================================
				-- 4. 执行 write.py
				-- ==========================================
				my notify("执行 write.py…")
				set wOut to do shell script pythonBin & " " & quoted form of writePyPath
				my writeLog("write.py 输出: " & wOut)
				delay 0.5
				
				-- ==========================================
				-- 5. 关闭操作 —— 统计点击次数（上下限双向判定）
				-- ==========================================
				set closeClickCount to 0
				
				my notify("开始寻找并点击 downie_close.png（等待下载结束）…")
				set cmdResult to my shot("downie_close.png " & clickValue & " " & Opposite)
				if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
					my notify("首次即未检测到 downie_close.png（0 次点击），疑似下载未启动。")
				else
					set closeClickCount to 1
					delay 1
					
					repeat
						set cmdResult to my shot("downie_close.png " & clickValue & " " & Opposite & " false 0 0 1 1")
						if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
							my notify("close 按钮已消失，本次共点击 " & closeClickCount & " 次。")
							exit repeat
						end if
						set closeClickCount to closeClickCount + 1
						if closeClickCount ≥ maxCloseAttempts then
							my notify("close 点击已达硬上限 " & maxCloseAttempts & "，强制退出清理循环。")
							exit repeat
						end if
						delay 0.5
					end repeat
				end if
				
				set closeAbnormal to false
				set abnormalReason to ""
				
				if closeClickCount > maxCloseClicks then
					set closeAbnormal to true
					set abnormalReason to "关闭按钮点击 " & closeClickCount & " 次，超过上限 " & maxCloseClicks & " 次（疑似卡死/异常残留）"
				else if closeClickCount < minCloseClicks then
					set closeAbnormal to true
					set abnormalReason to "关闭按钮仅点击 " & closeClickCount & " 次，少于正常的 " & minCloseClicks & " 次（疑似下载未启动）"
				end if
				
				if closeAbnormal then
					my writeLog(abnormalReason & "，执行 write.py --blacklist-last。")
					try
						set revertResult to do shell script pythonBin & " " & quoted form of writePyPath & " --blacklist-last"
						my writeLog("write.py --blacklist-last 输出: " & revertResult)
						my forceNotify(abnormalReason & "，该链接已移入 blacklist。", notifyTitle)
					on error revErr
						my forceNotify("write.py --blacklist-last 执行失败: " & revErr, "自动化异常")
					end try
				else
					my notify("close 点击 " & closeClickCount & " 次，正常（" & minCloseClicks & " ~ " & maxCloseClicks & "）。")
				end if
			end if
			
			-- ==========================================
			-- 6. 本轮 URL 处理完毕，进入下一轮前清理 pianku
			-- ==========================================
			if not (my cleanupPianku()) then
				set stopReason to "downie_pianku.png 多次尝试后仍未消失，自动化已停止。"
				set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
				exit repeat
			end if
			
			my notify("本轮处理完毕，进入下一轮。")
		end if
		
	on error errMsg number errNum
		set stopReason to "发生异常（" & errNum & "），自动化已停止: " & errMsg
		set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
		exit repeat
	end try
end repeat

-- ==========================================
-- 【新增】把 JS 返回的多行文本拆成固定 4 项 {status, url, title, detail}
-- ==========================================
on parseLines(r)
	set outList to {"", "", "", ""}
	set ps to paragraphs of r
	repeat with i from 1 to 4
		if (count of ps) ≥ i then set item i of outList to ((item i of ps) as text)
	end repeat
	return outList
end parseLines

	end try

-- ==========================================
-- 【新增】pys 提取：Chrome 独立窗口打开页面，轮询注入 pys_extract.js
--   返回 {status, mediaURL, pageTitle, detail}
--   status: "OK" / "FAILED" / "JS_DISABLED" / "CONFIG_ERROR"
-- ==========================================
on pysExtract(pageURL)
	set jsCode to ""
	try
		set jsCode to read (POSIX file pysJsPath) as «class utf8»
	on error rErr
		return {"CONFIG_ERROR", "", "", "无法读取 " & pysJsPath & "：" & rErr}
	end try
	
	set lastTitle to ""
	set lastDetail to "未知"
	
	repeat with attempt from 1 to pysMaxAttempts
		my notify("[pys] Chrome 打开页面（第 " & attempt & "/" & pysMaxAttempts & " 次）…")
		set theWin to missing value
		try
			tell application "Google Chrome"
				set theWin to make new window
				set URL of active tab of theWin to pageURL
			end tell
		on error oErr
			my closeChromeWindow(theWin)
			return {"CONFIG_ERROR", "", "", "Chrome 打开页面失败：" & oErr}
		end try
		
		set t0 to current date
		set gotURL to ""
		set gotSource to ""
		set fallbackURL to ""
		set fallbackSource to ""
		
		repeat
			delay pysPollInterval
			set elapsed to (current date) - t0
			set r to ""
			try
				tell application "Google Chrome"
					set r to execute (active tab of theWin) javascript jsCode
				end tell
			on error jsErr
				if (jsErr contains "JavaScript") and ((jsErr contains "Apple") or (jsErr contains "允许")) then
					my closeChromeWindow(theWin)
					return {"JS_DISABLED", "", "", jsErr}
				end if
				set lastDetail to "执行 JS 出错：" & jsErr
				set r to ""
			end try
			if r is missing value then set r to ""
			
			set parts to my parseLines(r as text)
			set pysSt to item 1 of parts
			if (item 3 of parts) is not "" then set lastTitle to item 3 of parts
			if (item 4 of parts) is not "" then set lastDetail to item 4 of parts
			
			if pysSt is "OK" then
				set gotURL to item 2 of parts
				set gotSource to item 4 of parts
				exit repeat
			else if pysSt is "FALLBACK" then
				set fallbackURL to item 2 of parts
				set fallbackSource to item 4 of parts
				if elapsed ≥ pysFallbackGrace then
					set gotURL to fallbackURL
					set gotSource to fallbackSource
					exit repeat
				end if
			end if
			
			if elapsed ≥ pysExtractTimeout then
				if fallbackURL is not "" then
					set gotURL to fallbackURL
					set gotSource to fallbackSource
				end if
				exit repeat
			end if
		end repeat
		
		my closeChromeWindow(theWin)
		
		if gotURL is not "" then
			my writeLog("[pys] 提取结果: " & gotURL & " | 来源: " & gotSource & " | 标题: " & lastTitle)
			return {"OK", gotURL, lastTitle, gotSource}
		end if
		my notify("[pys] 第 " & attempt & " 次未提取到地址（" & lastDetail & "）。")
		delay 1
	end repeat
	
	return {"FAILED", "", lastTitle, "超时 " & pysExtractTimeout & " 秒 × " & pysMaxAttempts & " 次；" & lastDetail}
end pysExtract

-- ==========================================
-- 404 后流程
--   返回 "M3U8_OK"     : addm3u8 已点击，继续 more 流程
--        "BLACKLISTED" : 超时未找到 verify/addm3u8，已关闭界面并拉黑
--        "STOP"        : addm3u8 找到后又消失、无法点击
-- ==========================================
on handle404(bPyPath, waitTimeout, afterVerifyTimeout, maxVerifyClicks)
	set verifyClicks to 0
	set curTimeout to waitTimeout
	
	repeat
		if verifyClicks < maxVerifyClicks then
			set targets to "downie_verify.png,downie_addm3u8.png"
			my notify("开始寻找 verify 或 addm3u8（最多 " & curTimeout & " 秒）…")
		else
			set targets to "downie_addm3u8.png"
			my notify("开始寻找 addm3u8（最多 " & curTimeout & " 秒）…")
		end if
		
		set r to my shot(quoted form of targets & " false false false 0 0 1 " & curTimeout)
		
		if r contains "TIMEOUT" then exit repeat
		
		if r contains "FOUND_IMAGE:downie_verify.png" then
			my notify("检测到 downie_verify.png，点击之…")
			set c to my shot("downie_verify.png true false false 0 0 1 5")
			if c contains "TIMEOUT" then
				my notify("downie_verify.png 已消失，未能点击，继续寻找 addm3u8。")
			else
				my notify("已点击 downie_verify.png，继续寻找 addm3u8。")
			end if
			set verifyClicks to verifyClicks + 1
			set curTimeout to afterVerifyTimeout
			delay 1
		else
			if my handleM3u8() then
				return "M3U8_OK"
			else
				return "STOP"
			end if
		end if
	end repeat
	
	my forceNotify("超时未找到 verify / addm3u8，关闭界面并拉黑当前 URL。", notifyTitle)
	if not (my cleanupPianku()) then
		my notify("pianku 未能完全关闭，仍继续执行拉黑（本轮末尾会再次清理）。")
	end if
	
	do shell script "/opt/homebrew/bin/cliclick m:187,504"
	delay 0.5
	
	my blacklistCurrent(bPyPath)
	return "BLACKLISTED"
end handle404

-- ==========================================
-- addm3u8 处理
--   返回 true：已点击；false：addm3u8 已消失无法点击
-- ==========================================
on handleM3u8()
	my notify("检测到 downie_addm3u8.png，等待 " & m3u8SettleDelay & " 秒后检测 downie_index.png…")
	delay m3u8SettleDelay
	
	my notify("开始寻找 downie_index.png 并配对 addm3u8…")
	set pairResult to ""
	try
		set pairResult to my shot("--pair downie_index.png downie_addm3u8.png " & m3u8OffsetX & " " & m3u8OffsetY & " " & m3u8TolX & " " & m3u8TolY & " true " & m3u8IndexTimeout)
	on error pErr
		my writeLog("配对模式执行失败，回退直接点击: " & pErr)
		set pairResult to "PAIR_ERROR"
	end try
	my writeLog("配对结果: " & pairResult)
	
	if pairResult contains "PAIR_CLICKED" then
		my notify("已点击最上方 index 对应的 downie_addm3u8.png。")
	else
		if pairResult contains "PAIR_NOT_FOUND" then
			my notify("有 index 但未配对上 addm3u8，回退为直接点击 addm3u8…")
		else
			my notify("未检测到 index，直接点击 downie_addm3u8.png…")
		end if
		set m3u8Result to my shot("downie_addm3u8.png true false false 0 0 1 " & m3u8ClickTimeout)
		if m3u8Result contains "TIMEOUT" then
			return false
		end if
		my notify("已直接点击 downie_addm3u8.png。")
	end if
	delay 1
	return true
end handleM3u8

-- ==========================================
-- 清理 pianku：点击 pianku -> 点击 shutdown -> 确认 pianku 消失
-- ==========================================
on cleanupPianku()
	set maxRounds to 3
	repeat with r from 1 to maxRounds
		my notify("寻找 downie_pianku.png（清理第 " & r & " 次）…")
		set piankuResult to my shot("downie_pianku.png true false false 0 0 1 2")
		if piankuResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
			if r = 1 then
				my notify("未检测到 downie_pianku.png，无需清理。")
			else
				my notify("downie_pianku.png 已不存在。")
			end if
			return true
		end if
		my notify("已点击 pianku，开始寻找 downie_shutdown.png…")
		delay 1
		
		set shutdownResult to my shot("downie_shutdown.png true false false 0 0 1 5")
		if shutdownResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
			my notify("未检测到 downie_shutdown.png。")
		else
			my notify("已点击 downie_shutdown.png，等待 pianku 消失…")
		end if
		delay 1
		
		set goneResult to my shot("downie_pianku.png false true false 0 0 1 10")
		if goneResult contains "VANISHED" then
			my notify("downie_pianku.png 已消失。")
			return true
		end if
		my notify("downie_pianku.png 仍存在，准备重试（" & r & "/" & maxRounds & "）。")
	end repeat
	return false
end cleanupPianku

-- ==========================================
-- 在 Terminal 中运行同步脚本，并等待其执行完毕
-- ==========================================
on runSyncScript(scriptPath, flagPath)
	try
		do shell script "rm -f " & quoted form of flagPath
	end try
	
	set innerCmd to quoted form of scriptPath & "; echo $? > " & quoted form of flagPath
	set shCmd to "bash -lc " & quoted form of innerCmd
	
	my notify("在 Terminal 中执行 sync_to_server.sh，等待完成…")
	tell application "Terminal"
		activate
		do script shCmd
	end tell
	
	set maxWait to 1800
	set waited to 0
	set finished to false
	repeat
		try
			do shell script "test -s " & quoted form of flagPath
			set finished to true
			exit repeat
		on error
			delay 2
			set waited to waited + 2
			if waited ≥ maxWait then
				exit repeat
			end if
		end try
	end repeat
	
	if not finished then
		my writeLog("等待 sync_to_server.sh 超时（" & maxWait & " 秒）。")
		return false
	end if
	
	set exitCode to do shell script "cat " & quoted form of flagPath & " | tr -d '[:space:]'"
	do shell script "rm -f " & quoted form of flagPath
	my writeLog("sync_to_server.sh 退出码: " & exitCode)
	
	return (exitCode is "0")
end runSyncScript

-- ==========================================
-- 判断本机是否拥有指定 IP（支持多网卡）
-- ==========================================
on hasLocalIP(targetIP)
	set matched to ""
	try
		set matched to do shell script ¬
			"ifconfig | awk '/inet /{print $2}' | grep -Fx " & quoted form of targetIP & " | head -n 1 || true"
	on error
		set matched to ""
	end try
	return (matched is targetIP)
end hasLocalIP

set stopReason to ""
set stopTitle to "自动化已停止"

my writeLog("==================== 自动化启动 ====================")
my notify("自动化启动，日志文件: " & logFilePath)

repeat
	try
		-- ==========================================
		-- 0. 检查是否存在手动停止的触发文件
		-- ==========================================
		set stopFileExists to false
		try
			do shell script "test -e " & quoted form of stopFilePath
			set stopFileExists to true
		end try
		if stopFileExists then
			try
				do shell script "rm -f " & quoted form of stopFilePath
			end try
			set stopReason to "检测到桌面的 stop_scpt.txt，脚本已安全停止。"
			set stopTitle to "自动化已手动停止"
			exit repeat
		end if
		delay 0.5
		
		set roundNo to roundNo + 1
		
		-- ==========================================
		-- 1. 执行 read.py（带阶段参数）
		-- ==========================================
		repeat
			set readCmd to pythonBin & " " & quoted form of readPyPath & " " & readArgs
			my notify("执行 read.py（阶段 " & currentPhase & "）…")
			set readResult to do shell script readCmd
			
			if readResult contains "所有视频链接都已处理完毕" then
				if currentPhase = 1 then
					my notify("阶段 1 完成。")
					
					if my hasLocalIP(skipSyncIP) then
						my forceNotify("本机 IP 为 " & skipSyncIP & "，跳过同步脚本。", notifyTitle)
						set syncOK to true
					else
						my forceNotify("第一阶段处理完毕，开始同步到服务器…", notifyTitle)
						set syncOK to my runSyncScript(syncShPath, syncFlagPath)
					end if
					
					if not syncOK then
						set stopReason to "同步脚本执行失败或超时，自动化已停止。"
						set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
						set allDone to true
						exit repeat
					end if
					
					my forceNotify("同步成功，进入第二阶段（更多渠道）。", notifyTitle)
					set currentPhase to 2
					set readArgs to phase2Args
					delay 1
				else
					set stopReason to "所有链接已处理完毕，自动化结束。"
					set stopTitle to "自动化完成"
					set allDone to true
					exit repeat
				end if
			else
				exit repeat
			end if
		end repeat
		
		if allDone then exit repeat
		delay 0.5
		
		-- ==========================================
		-- 抓取 read.py 写入剪贴板的当前 URL
		-- ==========================================
		set currentURL to ""
		try
			set currentURL to (the clipboard as text)
		on error
			set currentURL to ""
		end try
		my notify("当前 URL: " & currentURL)
		
		-- 白名单仅用于 ignore 分支（404 分支的白名单逻辑已按需求废除）
		set isWhitelistURL to (currentURL contains "https://www.pys")
		
		-- ==========================================
		-- 2. 激活 Downie 4
		-- ==========================================
		my notify("激活 Downie 4…")
		tell application "/Applications/Downie 4.app"
			activate
		end tell
		
		tell application "System Events"
			tell process "Downie 4"
				set frontmost to true
			end tell
		end tell
		delay 0.5
		
		-- ==========================================
		-- 3. 执行截图点击流程 (screenshot.py)
		-- ==========================================
		set Opposite to "false"
		
		-- 截图 1: downie_add.png
		my notify("开始寻找并点击 downie_add.png…")
		set cmdResult to my shot("downie_add.png true " & Opposite)
		if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
			set stopReason to "长时间未找到 downie_add.png，自动化已停止。"
			set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
			exit repeat
		end if
		delay 0.5
		
		-- ==========================================
		-- 3.2 同时扫描 addselect, 404, again, more, ignore（addm3u8 已移出）
		-- ==========================================
		set skipNormalFlow to false
		set ignoreCount to 0
		set maxIgnoreCount to 2
		set shouldExitMain to false
		set scanImages to "downie_addselect.png,downie_404.png,downie_again.png,downie_more.png,downie_ignore.png"
		
		repeat
			my notify("开始扫描状态：addselect / 404 / again / more / ignore…")
			set cmdResult to my shot(quoted form of scanImages & " false " & Opposite & " false 0 0 1 " & statusScanTimeout)
			
			if cmdResult contains "FOUND_IMAGE:downie_ignore.png" then
				-- -------- ignore 分支 --------
				if isWhitelistURL then
					my notify("检测到 ignore，但 URL 属白名单，跳过点击，进入 more 流程。")
					exit repeat
				end if
				
				set ignoreCount to ignoreCount + 1
				
				if ignoreCount ≥ maxIgnoreCount then
					my notify("ignore 已达 " & maxIgnoreCount & " 次，点击 ignore 并拉黑当前 URL。")
					
					set clickResult to my shot("downie_ignore.png true " & Opposite)
					if clickResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
						set stopReason to "downie_ignore.png 点击超时，自动化已停止。"
						set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
						set shouldExitMain to true
						exit repeat
					end if
					delay 0.5
					
					do shell script "/opt/homebrew/bin/cliclick m:187,504"
					delay 0.5
					
					my blacklistCurrent(blacklistPyPath)
					set skipNormalFlow to true
					exit repeat
				else
					my notify("检测到 ignore（第 " & ignoreCount & " 次），点击 ignore 后重新添加。")
					
					set clickResult to my shot("downie_ignore.png true " & Opposite)
					if clickResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
						set stopReason to "downie_ignore.png 点击超时，自动化已停止。"
						set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
						set shouldExitMain to true
						exit repeat
					end if
					delay 0.5
					
					my notify("重新点击 downie_add.png…")
					set clickResult to my shot("downie_add.png true " & Opposite)
					if clickResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
						set stopReason to "重新添加时未找到 downie_add.png，自动化已停止。"
						set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
						set shouldExitMain to true
						exit repeat
					end if
					delay 0.5
				end if
			else
				exit repeat
			end if
		end repeat
		
		if shouldExitMain then exit repeat
		
		-- ==========================================
		-- 分支处理：TIMEOUT / 404 / again / more / addselect
		-- ==========================================
		if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
			set stopReason to "状态扫描超时（" & statusScanTimeout & " 秒），未检测到任何目标图片，自动化已停止。"
			set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
			exit repeat
			
		else if cmdResult contains "FOUND_IMAGE:downie_404.png" then
			-- -------- 【重写】404 分支：verify / addm3u8 / 超时拉黑 --------
			my notify("检测到 downie_404.png，进入 verify / addm3u8 流程。")
			set r404 to my handle404(blacklistPyPath, verifyWaitTimeout, m3u8AfterVerifyTimeout, maxVerifyClicks)
			if r404 is "STOP" then
				set stopReason to "downie_addm3u8.png 已消失，无法点击，自动化已停止。"
				set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
				exit repeat
			else if r404 is "BLACKLISTED" then
				set skipNormalFlow to true
			else
				my notify("addm3u8 流程完成，进入 more 流程。")
			end if
			
		else if cmdResult contains "FOUND_IMAGE:downie_again.png" then
			-- -------- again 分支 --------
			my notify("检测到 downie_again.png，点击后进入 more 流程。")
			set clickAgainResult to my shot("downie_again.png true " & Opposite)
			if clickAgainResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
				set stopReason to "downie_again.png 点击超时，自动化已停止。"
				set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
				exit repeat
			end if
			delay 0.5
			
		else if cmdResult contains "FOUND_IMAGE:downie_more.png" then
			-- -------- more 分支 --------
			my notify("检测到 downie_more.png，直接进入后续流程。")
			
		else if cmdResult contains "FOUND_IMAGE:downie_addselect.png" then
			-- -------- addselect 分支 --------
			my notify("检测到 downie_addselect.png，开始选择流程（检测 douban）…")
			delay 0.5
			
			set doubanFound to true
			set doubanResult to my shot("downie_douban.png false " & Opposite & " false 0 0 1 3")
			if doubanResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
				set doubanFound to false
				my notify("未检测到 douban，将跳过 Down Arrow。")
			else
				my notify("检测到 douban，执行完整选择流程。")
			end if
			
			my notify("开始寻找并点击 downie_select.png…")
			set cmdResult to my shot("downie_select.png true " & Opposite)
			if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
				set stopReason to "未找到 downie_select.png，自动化已停止。"
				set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
				exit repeat
			end if
			delay 0.5
			
			my notify("开始寻找并点击 downie_none.png…")
			set cmdResult to my shot("downie_none.png true " & Opposite)
			if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
				set stopReason to "未找到 downie_none.png，自动化已停止。"
				set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
				exit repeat
			end if
			delay 0.5
			
			tell application "System Events"
				key code 48 -- Tab
				delay 0.5
				if doubanFound then
					key code 125 -- Down Arrow
					delay 0.5
				end if
				key code 49 -- Space
				delay 0.5
			end tell
			
			my notify("开始寻找并点击 downie_addselect.png（确认）…")
			set cmdResult to my shot("downie_addselect.png true " & Opposite)
			if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
				set stopReason to "确认时未找到 downie_addselect.png，自动化已停止。"
				set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
				exit repeat
			end if
			delay 1
			
		else
			my notify("未命中特殊分支（如 ignore 白名单跳过），按 skipNormalFlow 继续。")
		end if
		
		-- ==========================================
		-- more.png 及以后的流程
		-- ==========================================
		if not skipNormalFlow then
			set clickValue to "true"
			
			my notify("开始寻找并点击 downie_more.png…")
			set cmdResult to my shot("downie_more.png " & clickValue & " " & Opposite)
			if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
				set stopReason to "未找到 downie_more.png，自动化已停止。"
				set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
				exit repeat
			end if
			delay 0.5
			
			my notify("开始寻找并点击 downie_savemeta.png…")
			set cmdResult to my shot("downie_savemeta.png " & clickValue & " " & Opposite)
			if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
				set stopReason to "未找到 downie_savemeta.png，自动化已停止。"
				set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
				exit repeat
			end if
			delay 0.5
			
			my notify("开始寻找并点击 downie_savejson.png…")
			set cmdResult to my shot("downie_savejson.png " & clickValue & " " & Opposite)
			if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
				set stopReason to "未找到 downie_savejson.png，自动化已停止。"
				set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
				exit repeat
			end if
			delay 0.5
			
			-- ==========================================
			-- 4. 执行 write.py
			-- ==========================================
			my notify("执行 write.py…")
			do shell script pythonBin & " " & quoted form of writePyPath
			delay 0.5
			
			-- ==========================================
			-- 5. 关闭操作 —— 统计点击次数（上下限双向判定）
			-- ==========================================
			set closeClickCount to 0
			
			my notify("开始寻找并点击 downie_close.png（等待下载结束）…")
			set cmdResult to my shot("downie_close.png " & clickValue & " " & Opposite)
			if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
				my notify("首次即未检测到 downie_close.png（0 次点击），疑似下载未启动。")
			else
				set closeClickCount to 1
				delay 1
				
				repeat
					set cmdResult to my shot("downie_close.png " & clickValue & " " & Opposite & " false 0 0 1 1")
					if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
						my notify("close 按钮已消失，本次共点击 " & closeClickCount & " 次。")
						exit repeat
					end if
					set closeClickCount to closeClickCount + 1
					if closeClickCount ≥ maxCloseAttempts then
						my notify("close 点击已达硬上限 " & maxCloseAttempts & "，强制退出清理循环。")
						exit repeat
					end if
					delay 0.5
				end repeat
			end if
			
			set closeAbnormal to false
			set abnormalReason to ""
			
			if closeClickCount > maxCloseClicks then
				set closeAbnormal to true
				set abnormalReason to "关闭按钮点击 " & closeClickCount & " 次，超过上限 " & maxCloseClicks & " 次（疑似卡死/异常残留）"
			else if closeClickCount < minCloseClicks then
				set closeAbnormal to true
				set abnormalReason to "关闭按钮仅点击 " & closeClickCount & " 次，少于正常的 " & minCloseClicks & " 次（疑似下载未启动）"
			end if
			
			if closeAbnormal then
				my writeLog(abnormalReason & "，执行 write.py --blacklist-last。")
				try
					set revertResult to do shell script pythonBin & " " & quoted form of writePyPath & " --blacklist-last"
					my writeLog("write.py --blacklist-last 输出: " & revertResult)
					my forceNotify(abnormalReason & "，该链接已移入 blacklist。", notifyTitle)
				on error revErr
					my forceNotify("write.py --blacklist-last 执行失败: " & revErr, "自动化异常")
				end try
			else
				my notify("close 点击 " & closeClickCount & " 次，正常（" & minCloseClicks & " ~ " & maxCloseClicks & "）。")
			end if
		end if
		
		-- ==========================================
		-- 6. 本轮 URL 处理完毕，进入下一轮前清理 pianku
		-- ==========================================
		if not (my cleanupPianku()) then
			set stopReason to "downie_pianku.png 多次尝试后仍未消失，自动化已停止。"
			set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
			exit repeat
		end if
		
		my notify("本轮处理完毕，进入下一轮。")
		
	on error errMsg number errNum
		set stopReason to "发生异常（" & errNum & "），自动化已停止: " & errMsg
		set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
		exit repeat
	end try
end repeat

-- ==========================================
-- 统一的停止提示（无论 enableStepNotify 与否都会弹出）
-- ==========================================
if stopReason is "" then set stopReason to "自动化已结束（未记录具体原因）。"
my forceNotify(stopReason, stopTitle)
my writeLog("==================== 自动化结束 ====================")


-- ##########################################################
--                        Handlers
-- ##########################################################

-- ==========================================
-- 调用 screenshot.py（argStr 为 screenshot.py 之后的全部参数）
-- ==========================================
on shot(argStr)
	return do shell script pythonBin & " " & quoted form of pythonScriptPath & " " & argStr
end shot

-- ==========================================
-- 写日志（带时间戳）
-- ==========================================
on writeLog(msg)
	set fullMsg to "[第 " & roundNo & " 轮] " & msg
	log fullMsg
	try
		do shell script "printf '%s %s\\n' \"$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')\" " & quoted form of fullMsg & " >> " & quoted form of logFilePath
	end try
end writeLog

-- ==========================================
-- 步骤通知（受 enableStepNotify 控制）+ 写日志
-- ==========================================
on notify(msg)
	my writeLog(msg)
	if enableStepNotify then
		try
			display notification msg with title notifyTitle subtitle ("第 " & roundNo & " 轮")
		end try
	end if
end notify

-- ==========================================
-- 强制通知（重要事件，始终弹出）+ 写日志
-- ==========================================
on forceNotify(msg, theTitle)
	my writeLog("【" & theTitle & "】" & msg)
	try
		display notification msg with title theTitle subtitle ("第 " & roundNo & " 轮")
	end try
end forceNotify

-- ==========================================
-- 调用 404_move.py 拉黑当前 URL
-- ==========================================
on blacklistCurrent(bPyPath)
	my notify("执行 404_move.py，拉黑当前 URL…")
	try
		set bResult to do shell script pythonBin & " " & quoted form of bPyPath
		my writeLog("404_move.py 输出: " & bResult)
		my notify("当前 URL 已拉黑。")
	on error bErr
		my forceNotify("404_move.py 执行失败: " & bErr, "自动化异常")
	end try
end blacklistCurrent

-- ==========================================
-- 【新增】404 后流程
--   返回 "M3U8_OK"     : addm3u8 已点击，继续 more 流程
--        "BLACKLISTED" : 超时未找到 verify/addm3u8，已关闭界面并拉黑
--        "STOP"        : addm3u8 找到后又消失、无法点击（与原逻辑一致，停止）
-- ==========================================
on handle404(bPyPath, waitTimeout, afterVerifyTimeout, maxVerifyClicks)
	set verifyClicks to 0
	set curTimeout to waitTimeout
	
	repeat
		if verifyClicks < maxVerifyClicks then
			set targets to "downie_verify.png,downie_addm3u8.png"
			my notify("开始寻找 verify 或 addm3u8（最多 " & curTimeout & " 秒）…")
		else
			set targets to "downie_addm3u8.png"
			my notify("开始寻找 addm3u8（最多 " & curTimeout & " 秒）…")
		end if
		
		set r to my shot(quoted form of targets & " false false false 0 0 1 " & curTimeout)
		
		if r contains "TIMEOUT" then exit repeat
		
		if r contains "FOUND_IMAGE:downie_verify.png" then
			my notify("检测到 downie_verify.png，点击之…")
			set c to my shot("downie_verify.png true false false 0 0 1 5")
			if c contains "TIMEOUT" then
				my notify("downie_verify.png 已消失，未能点击，继续寻找 addm3u8。")
			else
				my notify("已点击 downie_verify.png，继续寻找 addm3u8。")
			end if
			-- 无论是否点到都计数，保证循环一定能结束
			set verifyClicks to verifyClicks + 1
			set curTimeout to afterVerifyTimeout
			delay 1
		else
			-- 多图模式输出 FOUND_IMAGE:downie_addm3u8.png；单图模式不输出 FOUND_IMAGE，非 TIMEOUT 即找到
			if my handleM3u8() then
				return "M3U8_OK"
			else
				return "STOP"
			end if
		end if
	end repeat
	
	-- ---------- 超时：关闭界面（pianku -> shutdown）并拉黑 ----------
	my forceNotify("超时未找到 verify / addm3u8，关闭界面并拉黑当前 URL。", notifyTitle)
	if not (my cleanupPianku()) then
		my notify("pianku 未能完全关闭，仍继续执行拉黑（本轮末尾会再次清理）。")
	end if
	
	do shell script "/opt/homebrew/bin/cliclick m:187,504"
	delay 0.5
	
	my blacklistCurrent(bPyPath)
	return "BLACKLISTED"
end handle404

-- ==========================================
-- addm3u8 处理（与原 addm3u8 分支逻辑一致）
--   返回 true：已点击；false：addm3u8 已消失无法点击
-- ==========================================
on handleM3u8()
	my notify("检测到 downie_addm3u8.png，等待 " & m3u8SettleDelay & " 秒后检测 downie_index.png…")
	delay m3u8SettleDelay
	
	my notify("开始寻找 downie_index.png 并配对 addm3u8…")
	set pairResult to ""
	try
		set pairResult to my shot("--pair downie_index.png downie_addm3u8.png " & m3u8OffsetX & " " & m3u8OffsetY & " " & m3u8TolX & " " & m3u8TolY & " true " & m3u8IndexTimeout)
	on error pErr
		-- 如模板缺失（退出码 3），回退为直接点击，而不是让整个脚本崩溃
		my writeLog("配对模式执行失败，回退直接点击: " & pErr)
		set pairResult to "PAIR_ERROR"
	end try
	my writeLog("配对结果: " & pairResult)
	
	if pairResult contains "PAIR_CLICKED" then
		my notify("已点击最上方 index 对应的 downie_addm3u8.png。")
	else
		if pairResult contains "PAIR_NOT_FOUND" then
			my notify("有 index 但未配对上 addm3u8，回退为直接点击 addm3u8…")
		else
			my notify("未检测到 index，直接点击 downie_addm3u8.png…")
		end if
		set m3u8Result to my shot("downie_addm3u8.png true false false 0 0 1 " & m3u8ClickTimeout)
		if m3u8Result contains "TIMEOUT" then
			return false
		end if
		my notify("已直接点击 downie_addm3u8.png。")
	end if
	delay 1
	return true
end handleM3u8

-- ==========================================
-- 清理 pianku：点击 pianku -> 点击 shutdown -> 确认 pianku 消失
--   返回 true：可进入下一轮；false：多次重试仍未消失
-- ==========================================
on cleanupPianku()
	set maxRounds to 3
	repeat with r from 1 to maxRounds
		my notify("寻找 downie_pianku.png（清理第 " & r & " 次）…")
		set piankuResult to my shot("downie_pianku.png true false false 0 0 1 2")
		if piankuResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
			if r = 1 then
				my notify("未检测到 downie_pianku.png，无需清理。")
			else
				my notify("downie_pianku.png 已不存在。")
			end if
			return true
		end if
		my notify("已点击 pianku，开始寻找 downie_shutdown.png…")
		delay 1
		
		set shutdownResult to my shot("downie_shutdown.png true false false 0 0 1 5")
		if shutdownResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
			my notify("未检测到 downie_shutdown.png。")
		else
			my notify("已点击 downie_shutdown.png，等待 pianku 消失…")
		end if
		delay 1
		
		set goneResult to my shot("downie_pianku.png false true false 0 0 1 10")
		if goneResult contains "VANISHED" then
			my notify("downie_pianku.png 已消失。")
			return true
		end if
		my notify("downie_pianku.png 仍存在，准备重试（" & r & "/" & maxRounds & "）。")
	end repeat
	return false
end cleanupPianku

-- ==========================================
-- 在 Terminal 中运行同步脚本，并等待其执行完毕
-- ==========================================
on runSyncScript(scriptPath, flagPath)
	try
		do shell script "rm -f " & quoted form of flagPath
	end try
	
	set innerCmd to quoted form of scriptPath & "; echo $? > " & quoted form of flagPath
	set shCmd to "bash -lc " & quoted form of innerCmd
	
	my notify("在 Terminal 中执行 sync_to_server.sh，等待完成…")
	tell application "Terminal"
		activate
		do script shCmd
	end tell
	
	set maxWait to 1800
	set waited to 0
	set finished to false
	repeat
		try
			do shell script "test -s " & quoted form of flagPath
			set finished to true
			exit repeat
		on error
			delay 2
			set waited to waited + 2
			if waited ≥ maxWait then
				exit repeat
			end if
		end try
	end repeat
	
	if not finished then
		my writeLog("等待 sync_to_server.sh 超时（" & maxWait & " 秒）。")
		return false
	end if
	
	set exitCode to do shell script "cat " & quoted form of flagPath & " | tr -d '[:space:]'"
	do shell script "rm -f " & quoted form of flagPath
	my writeLog("sync_to_server.sh 退出码: " & exitCode)
	
	return (exitCode is "0")
end runSyncScript

-- ==========================================
-- 判断本机是否拥有指定 IP（支持多网卡）
-- ==========================================
on hasLocalIP(targetIP)
	set matched to ""
	try
		set matched to do shell script ¬
			"ifconfig | awk '/inet /{print $2}' | grep -Fx " & quoted form of targetIP & " | head -n 1 || true"
	on error
		set matched to ""
	end try
	return (matched is targetIP)
end hasLocalIP

import os
import json
import glob
import sys
import re
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import messagebox
from send2trash import send2trash

DOWNLOADS_DIR = '/Users/yanzhang/Downloads/'
MAPPING_FILE = '/Users/yanzhang/Coding/LocalServer/Resources/OVideo/url_mapping.json'
BLACKLIST_FILE = '/Users/yanzhang/Coding/LocalServer/Resources/OVideo/blacklist_url.json'
OVIDEOS_FILE = '/Users/yanzhang/Coding/LocalServer/Resources/OVideo/OVideos.json'

# 【新增】记录"上一次写入"的状态文件，供 --blacklist-last 回滚使用
STATE_FILE = '/tmp/downie_last_write.json'

# 定义需要加入黑名单的关键字列表
BLACKLIST_KEYWORDS = ['TC', 'TS', '抢先', 'HC']

# 定义需要从文件名中过滤掉的字符串列表（严格包含空格，后续有新增直接在这里添加即可）
FILTER_STRINGS = ['- 正在播放 ', ' - 片库 - 片库网']


def show_warning(msg):
    """弹窗警告"""
    root = tk.Tk()
    root.withdraw()
    root.attributes('-topmost', True)
    messagebox.showwarning("警告", msg)
    root.destroy()


# ==========================================================
# 【新增】状态文件读写
# ==========================================================
def save_state(state):
    try:
        with open(STATE_FILE, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            json.dump(state, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        print(f"📝 已记录本次写入状态: {state.get('action')}")
    except OSError as e:
        print(f"⚠️  状态文件写入失败（不影响主流程）：{e}")


def clear_state():
    try:
        if os.path.exists(STATE_FILE):
            os.remove(STATE_FILE)
    except OSError:
        pass


# ==========================================================
# 公共工具
# ==========================================================
def fix_trailing_comma(lines):
    """删除某行后，修复 JSON 末尾多余的逗号"""
    for j in range(len(lines) - 1, -1, -1):
        if '}' in lines[j]:
            for k in range(j - 1, -1, -1):
                if lines[k].strip():
                    stripped_k = lines[k].rstrip('\n\r ')
                    if stripped_k.endswith(','):
                        lines[k] = stripped_k[:-1] + '\n'
                    break
            break
    return lines


def add_to_blacklist(mapping_url, name, real_url):
    """写入 blacklist_url.json"""
    blacklist_data = {}
    if os.path.exists(BLACKLIST_FILE):
        try:
            with open(BLACKLIST_FILE, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                blacklist_data = json.load(f)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            pass

    # 修复：url 放前面，name 放后面，与 url_mapping.json 的写入顺序保持一致
    blacklist_data[mapping_url] = [real_url, name]

    with open(BLACKLIST_FILE, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(blacklist_data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=4)
    print("✅ blacklist_url.json 写入成功！")


def check_info_has_blacklist_keyword(target_url, keywords):
    """
    修复版：在 OVideos.json 中查找 target_url 是否存在于 playlist 的 episodes 中
    """
    if not os.path.exists(OVIDEOS_FILE):
        print(f"⚠️  OVideos.json 文件不存在，跳过二次判断")
        return False, False

    try:
        with open(OVIDEOS_FILE, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            ovideos_data = json.load(f)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        return False, False

    # 遍历所有分类（Movie, Drama, 及未来可能新增的其他分类）
    for category, items in ovideos_data.items():
        if not isinstance(items, list):
            continue

        for item in items:
            if not isinstance(item, dict):
                continue

            # --- 修复核心逻辑：检查 playlist ---
            playlist = item.get('playlist', [])
            found_in_episodes = False

            for source in playlist:
                episodes = source.get('episodes', {})
                # 修复：episodes 可能是字典（key=url形式）或列表（直接url形式）
                if isinstance(episodes, dict):
                    if target_url in episodes.values():
                        found_in_episodes = True
                        break
                elif isinstance(episodes, list):
                    if target_url in episodes:
                        found_in_episodes = True
                        break

            if found_in_episodes:
                info_value = item.get('info', '') or ''
                info_has_keyword = any(kw in info_value for kw in keywords)

                print(f"🔍 在 OVideos.json 中匹配到播放链接：{target_url}")
                print(f"   所属项目: {item.get('name')}")
                print(f"   该项目 info = \"{info_value}\"，是否含黑名单关键字：{info_has_keyword}")

                return True, info_has_keyword

    print(f"🔍 OVideos.json 中未匹配到 URL：{target_url}")
    return False, False


def write_normal_mapping(lines, empty_line_idx, url, json_name_no_ext):
    """正常写入 url_mapping.json 的公共逻辑（抽取出来便于两处调用）"""
    line = lines[empty_line_idx]
    idx = line.rfind('""')

    new_value = json.dumps([url, json_name_no_ext], ensure_ascii=False)
    new_line = line[:idx] + new_value + line[idx + 2:]
    lines[empty_line_idx] = new_line

    print(f"已在第 {empty_line_idx + 1} 行写入 URL 和 文件名")
    print(f"原内容: {line.rstrip()}")
    print(f"新内容: {new_line.rstrip()}")

    with open(MAPPING_FILE, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.writelines(lines)
    print("✅ url_mapping.json 写入成功！")


# ==========================================================
# 【新增】回滚模式：把上一次写进 url_mapping 的记录改判为 blacklist
# 由 AppleScript 在 close 点击次数超阈值时调用：
#     python3 write.py --blacklist-last
# ==========================================================
def blacklist_last():
    if not os.path.exists(STATE_FILE):
        print("ℹ️  未找到上一次写入的状态文件，无需处理。")
        return 0

    try:
        with open(STATE_FILE, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            state = json.load(f)
    except (json.JSONDecodeError, OSError) as e:
        print(f"⚠️  状态文件读取失败：{e}")
        clear_state()
        return 0

    # 无论结果如何，这条状态只消费一次
    clear_state()

    action = state.get('action')
    if action != 'normal':
        print(f"ℹ️  上一条记录 action = {action}，本来就没写进 url_mapping，无需回滚。")
        return 0

    mapping_url = state.get('mapping_url') or ''
    name = state.get('name') or ''
    real_url = state.get('url') or ''

    if not mapping_url:
        print("⚠️  状态文件中没有 mapping_url，无法回滚。")
        return 0

    if not os.path.exists(MAPPING_FILE):
        print(f"⚠️  映射文件不存在：{MAPPING_FILE}")
        return 0

    with open(MAPPING_FILE, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        lines = f.readlines()

    key_token = '"%s"' % mapping_url
    target_idx = -1
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if line.lstrip().startswith(key_token):
            target_idx = i
            break
    if target_idx == -1:
        # 兜底：全行包含匹配
        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
            if key_token in line and ':' in line:
                target_idx = i
                break

    if target_idx == -1:
        print(f"⚠️  在 url_mapping.json 中未找到 key：{mapping_url}，跳过回滚。")
        return 0

    print(f"⚠️  关闭下载耗时异常，判定链接有问题，回滚第 {target_idx + 1} 行：")
    print(f"    {lines[target_idx].rstrip()}")

    del lines[target_idx]
    fix_trailing_comma(lines)

    with open(MAPPING_FILE, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.writelines(lines)
    print(f"✅ 已从 url_mapping.json 删除整行，提取的 URL: {mapping_url}")

    add_to_blacklist(mapping_url, name, real_url)
    print("✅ 回滚完成，该链接已转入 blacklist_url.json")
    return 0


def main():
    # 【新增】每次正常运行先清掉上一条状态，避免误回滚历史记录
    clear_state()

    # 1. 查找 Downloads 目录下的 json 文件
    all_json_files = glob.glob(os.path.join(DOWNLOADS_DIR, '*.json'))

    # 过滤掉 kalshi_ 开头的文件
    json_files = [f for f in all_json_files if not os.path.basename(f).startswith('kalshi_')]

    if len(json_files) == 0:
        show_warning("Downloads 目录下没有找到有效的 json 文件（已排除 kalshi_ 相关文件）！")
        sys.exit(1)

    if len(json_files) > 1:
        files_list = "\n".join(os.path.basename(f) for f in json_files)
        show_warning(f"Downloads 目录下发现 {len(json_files)} 个有效 json 文件，程序终止：\n\n{files_list}")
        sys.exit(1)

    json_file = json_files[0]
    json_filename = os.path.basename(json_file)
    json_name_no_ext = os.path.splitext(json_filename)[0]  # 获取不带后缀的文件名

    # 过滤文件名中的特定字符串
    for f_str in FILTER_STRINGS:
        json_name_no_ext = json_name_no_ext.replace(f_str, "")

    print(f"找到 json 文件: {json_file}")
    print(f"过滤后的文件名: {json_name_no_ext}")

    # 2. 读取 json 并提取 url
    try:
        with open(json_file, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            data = json.load(f)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
        show_warning(f"json 文件解析失败：{e}")
        sys.exit(1)

    url = data.get('url')
    if not url:
        show_warning(f"json 文件中没有找到 url 字段：{json_file}")
        sys.exit(1)

    print(f"提取到的 URL: {url}")

    # 3. 读取 url_mapping.json
    if not os.path.exists(MAPPING_FILE):
        show_warning(f"映射文件不存在：{MAPPING_FILE}")
        sys.exit(1)

    with open(MAPPING_FILE, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        lines = f.readlines()

    # 4. 查找 value 为空的行
    empty_line_idx = -1
    extracted_mapping_url = ""

    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        stripped = line.rstrip('\n').rstrip().rstrip(',').rstrip()
        if stripped.endswith('""'):
            empty_line_idx = i
            match = re.search(r'"([^"]+)"\s*:\s*""', line)
            if match:
                extracted_mapping_url = match.group(1)
            break

    if empty_line_idx == -1:
        show_warning("url_mapping.json 中没有找到值为空的行！")
        sys.exit(1)

    # --- 判断是否需要加入黑名单 ---
    is_blacklist_item = any(keyword in json_filename for keyword in BLACKLIST_KEYWORDS)

    # url_contains_blacklist_char = "//p.bvvvvv" in url or "%" in url
    url_contains_blacklist_char = "%" in url

    should_blacklist = False  # 统一控制是否走黑名单逻辑的开关

    if url_contains_blacklist_char:
        print("⚠️ 检测到 URL 包含黑名单特征 (%)，将直接加入黑名单...")
        should_blacklist = True
    elif is_blacklist_item:
        matched_keywords = [k for k in BLACKLIST_KEYWORDS if k in json_filename]
        print(f"检测到文件名包含黑名单关键字 ({matched_keywords})，准备执行二次判断...")

        is_matched, info_has_keyword = check_info_has_blacklist_keyword(
            extracted_mapping_url, BLACKLIST_KEYWORDS
        )

        if is_matched and info_has_keyword:
            print("✅ OVideos.json 中该项目 info 字段也含黑名单关键字，跳过 blacklist，走正常写入逻辑")
            should_blacklist = False
        else:
            print("⚠️ 未满足跳过条件，按原黑名单逻辑处理...")
            should_blacklist = True

    # --- 根据 should_blacklist 决定最终执行的逻辑 ---
    if should_blacklist:
        if not extracted_mapping_url:
            show_warning("无法从 url_mapping.json 的空行中提取出 URL 键！")
            sys.exit(1)

        # 从 lines 中删除该空行
        del lines[empty_line_idx]

        # 修复 JSON 格式：处理末尾多余逗号
        fix_trailing_comma(lines)

        # 写回 url_mapping.json
        with open(MAPPING_FILE, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            f.writelines(lines)
        print(f"✅ 已从 url_mapping.json 删除整行，提取的 URL: {extracted_mapping_url}")

        # 写入 blacklist_url.json
        add_to_blacklist(extracted_mapping_url, json_name_no_ext, url)

        # 【新增】记录状态：已进黑名单，后续无需回滚
        save_state({
            "action": "blacklist",
            "mapping_url": extracted_mapping_url,
            "name": json_name_no_ext,
            "url": url
        })

    else:
        # 不包含黑名单关键字，且 URL 正常，走原有正常写入逻辑
        write_normal_mapping(lines, empty_line_idx, url, json_name_no_ext)

        # 【新增】记录状态：写进了 mapping，可能被 --blacklist-last 回滚
        save_state({
            "action": "normal",
            "mapping_url": extracted_mapping_url,
            "name": json_name_no_ext,
            "url": url
        })

    # 6. 删除 Downloads 目录下的源 json 文件
    try:
        send2trash(json_file)
        print(f"🗑️  已删除源文件: {json_file}")
    except OSError as e:
        show_warning(f"源 json 文件删除失败：{e}")
        sys.exit(1)

    print("✅ 全部任务完成！")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] in ('--blacklist-last', '--revert-last'):
        sys.exit(blacklist_last())
    main()

set stopFilePath to POSIX path of (path to desktop) & "stop_scpt.txt"

-- ==========================================

-- 当本机 IP 为该地址时，跳过同步脚本（视为已成功）

-- ==========================================

--   pysUseChromeFlow = true  : pys 链接走 Chrome 新流程

-- ==========================================

set pysRoundDelay to 1 -- 每条 pys 链接处理完后的间隔（秒），避免请求过快

					my notify("阶段 1 完成。")
					
					if my hasLocalIP(skipSyncIP) then
						my forceNotify("本机 IP 为 " & skipSyncIP & "，跳过同步脚本。", notifyTitle)
						set syncOK to true
					else
						my forceNotify("第一阶段处理完毕，开始同步到服务器…", notifyTitle)
						set syncOK to my runSyncScript(syncShPath, syncFlagPath)
					end if
					
					if not syncOK then
						set stopReason to "同步脚本执行失败或超时，自动化已停止。"
						set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
						set allDone to true
						exit repeat
					end if
					
					my forceNotify("同步成功，进入第二阶段（更多渠道）。", notifyTitle)
					set currentPhase to 2
					set readArgs to phase2Args
					delay 1
				else
					set stopReason to "所有链接已处理完毕，自动化结束。"
					set stopTitle to "自动化完成"
					set allDone to true
					exit repeat
				end if
			else
				exit repeat
			end if
		end repeat
		
		if allDone then exit repeat
		delay 0.5
		
		-- ==========================================
		-- 【修复】优先从 read.py 输出的 CURRENT_URL: 行获取当前 URL，剪贴板仅作兜底
		-- ==========================================
		set currentURL to ""
		repeat with p in (paragraphs of readResult)
			set pText to (p as text)
			if (pText starts with "CURRENT_URL:") and ((length of pText) > 12) then
				set currentURL to text 13 thru -1 of pText
			end if
		end repeat
		if currentURL is "" then
			try
				set currentURL to (the clipboard as text)
			on error
				set currentURL to ""
			end try
		end if
		if currentURL is "" then
			set stopReason to "read.py 未返回当前 URL（输出异常），自动化已停止。"
			set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
			exit repeat
		end if
		my notify("当前 URL: " & currentURL)
		
		set isPysURL to (currentURL contains pysKeyword)
		-- 白名单仅用于原流程的 ignore 分支
		set isWhitelistURL to isPysURL
		
		if pysUseChromeFlow and isPysURL then
			-- ##########################################################
			-- 【新增】pys 专用流程：Chrome 打开 → JS 提取 → write.py --direct-url
			-- ##########################################################
			my notify("检测到 pys 链接，走 Chrome 提取流程（跳过 Downie）。")
			set pysRes to my pysExtract(currentURL)
			set pysStatus to item 1 of pysRes
			set pysMedia to item 2 of pysRes
			set pysTitle to item 3 of pysRes
			set pysDetail to item 4 of pysRes
			
			if pysStatus is "OK" then
				my notify("[pys] 提取成功（" & pysDetail & "）：" & pysMedia)
				set wCmd to pythonBin & " " & quoted form of writePyPath & ¬
					" --direct-url " & quoted form of pysMedia & ¬
					" --name " & quoted form of pysTitle & ¬
					" --key " & quoted form of currentURL
				set wOut to do shell script wCmd
				my writeLog("write.py --direct-url 输出: " & wOut)
				set pysFailStreak to 0
				
			else if pysStatus is "JS_DISABLED" then
				set stopReason to "Chrome 未开启「显示 > 开发者 > 允许 Apple 事件中的 JavaScript」，pys 流程无法执行，自动化已停止。"
				set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
				exit repeat
				
			else if pysStatus is "CONFIG_ERROR" then
				set stopReason to "pys 流程配置/环境错误：" & pysDetail
				set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
				exit repeat
				
			else
				set pysFailStreak to pysFailStreak + 1
				if pysFailStreak ≥ pysMaxFailStreak then
					-- 当前这条不拉黑（mapping 中保留空值，下次启动会重试）
					set stopReason to "pys 链接已连续 " & pysFailStreak & " 条提取失败（疑似网站改版/拦截/网络异常），为避免误拉黑，自动化已停止。最后详情：" & pysDetail
					set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
					exit repeat
				end if
				my forceNotify("[pys] 未能提取播放地址（" & pysDetail & "），拉黑当前 URL（连续失败 " & pysFailStreak & "/" & pysMaxFailStreak & "）。", notifyTitle)
				set bCmd to pythonBin & " " & quoted form of writePyPath & ¬
					" --blacklist-key " & quoted form of currentURL & ¬
					" --name " & quoted form of pysTitle & ¬
					" --reason " & quoted form of ("pys 提取失败: " & pysDetail)
				set bOut to do shell script bCmd
				my writeLog("write.py --blacklist-key 输出: " & bOut)
			end if
			
			delay pysRoundDelay
			my notify("本轮处理完毕（pys 流程），进入下一轮。")
			
		else
			-- ##########################################################
			-- 原 Downie 流程（保持不变）
			-- ##########################################################
			
			-- ==========================================
			-- 2. 激活 Downie 4
			-- ==========================================
			my notify("激活 Downie 4…")
			tell application "/Applications/Downie 4.app"
				activate
			end tell
			
			tell application "System Events"
				tell process "Downie 4"
					set frontmost to true
				end tell
			end tell
			delay 0.5
			
			-- ==========================================
			-- 3. 执行截图点击流程 (screenshot.py)
			-- ==========================================
			set Opposite to "false"
			
			-- 截图 1: downie_add.png
			my notify("开始寻找并点击 downie_add.png…")
			set cmdResult to my shot("downie_add.png true " & Opposite)
			if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
				set stopReason to "长时间未找到 downie_add.png，自动化已停止。"
				set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
				exit repeat
			end if
			delay 0.5
			
			-- ==========================================
			-- 3.2 同时扫描 addselect, 404, again, more, ignore
			-- ==========================================
			set skipNormalFlow to false
			set ignoreCount to 0
			set maxIgnoreCount to 2
			set shouldExitMain to false
			set scanImages to "downie_addselect.png,downie_404.png,downie_again.png,downie_more.png,downie_ignore.png"
			
			repeat
				my notify("开始扫描状态：addselect / 404 / again / more / ignore…")
				set cmdResult to my shot(quoted form of scanImages & " false " & Opposite & " false 0 0 1 " & statusScanTimeout)
				
				if cmdResult contains "FOUND_IMAGE:downie_ignore.png" then
					-- -------- ignore 分支 --------
					if isWhitelistURL then
						my notify("检测到 ignore，但 URL 属白名单，跳过点击，进入 more 流程。")
						exit repeat
					end if
					
					set ignoreCount to ignoreCount + 1
					
					if ignoreCount ≥ maxIgnoreCount then
						my notify("ignore 已达 " & maxIgnoreCount & " 次，点击 ignore 并拉黑当前 URL。")
						
						set clickResult to my shot("downie_ignore.png true " & Opposite)
						if clickResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
							set stopReason to "downie_ignore.png 点击超时，自动化已停止。"
							set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
							set shouldExitMain to true
							exit repeat
						end if
						delay 0.5
						
						do shell script "/opt/homebrew/bin/cliclick m:187,504"
						delay 0.5
						
						my blacklistCurrent(blacklistPyPath)
						set skipNormalFlow to true
						exit repeat
					else
						my notify("检测到 ignore（第 " & ignoreCount & " 次），点击 ignore 后重新添加。")
						
						set clickResult to my shot("downie_ignore.png true " & Opposite)
						if clickResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
							set stopReason to "downie_ignore.png 点击超时，自动化已停止。"
							set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
							set shouldExitMain to true
							exit repeat
						end if
						delay 0.5
						
						my notify("重新点击 downie_add.png…")
						set clickResult to my shot("downie_add.png true " & Opposite)
						if clickResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
							set stopReason to "重新添加时未找到 downie_add.png，自动化已停止。"
							set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
							set shouldExitMain to true
							exit repeat
						end if
						delay 0.5
					end if
				else
					exit repeat
				end if
			end repeat
			
			if shouldExitMain then exit repeat
			
			-- ==========================================
			-- 分支处理：TIMEOUT / 404 / again / more / addselect
			-- ==========================================
			if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
				set stopReason to "状态扫描超时（" & statusScanTimeout & " 秒），未检测到任何目标图片，自动化已停止。"
				set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
				exit repeat
				
			else if cmdResult contains "FOUND_IMAGE:downie_404.png" then
				my notify("检测到 downie_404.png，进入 verify / addm3u8 流程。")
				set r404 to my handle404(blacklistPyPath, verifyWaitTimeout, m3u8AfterVerifyTimeout, maxVerifyClicks)
				if r404 is "STOP" then
					set stopReason to "downie_addm3u8.png 已消失，无法点击，自动化已停止。"
					set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
					exit repeat
				else if r404 is "BLACKLISTED" then
					set skipNormalFlow to true
				else
					my notify("addm3u8 流程完成，进入 more 流程。")
				end if
				
			else if cmdResult contains "FOUND_IMAGE:downie_again.png" then
				my notify("检测到 downie_again.png，点击后进入 more 流程。")
				set clickAgainResult to my shot("downie_again.png true " & Opposite)
				if clickAgainResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
					set stopReason to "downie_again.png 点击超时，自动化已停止。"
					set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
					exit repeat
				end if
				delay 0.5
				
			else if cmdResult contains "FOUND_IMAGE:downie_more.png" then
				my notify("检测到 downie_more.png，直接进入后续流程。")
				
			else if cmdResult contains "FOUND_IMAGE:downie_addselect.png" then
				my notify("检测到 downie_addselect.png，开始选择流程（检测 douban）…")
				delay 0.5
				
				set doubanFound to true
				set doubanResult to my shot("downie_douban.png false " & Opposite & " false 0 0 1 3")
				if doubanResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
					set doubanFound to false
					my notify("未检测到 douban，将跳过 Down Arrow。")
				else
					my notify("检测到 douban，执行完整选择流程。")
				end if
				
				my notify("开始寻找并点击 downie_select.png…")
				set cmdResult to my shot("downie_select.png true " & Opposite)
				if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
					set stopReason to "未找到 downie_select.png，自动化已停止。"
					set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
					exit repeat
				end if
				delay 0.5
				
				my notify("开始寻找并点击 downie_none.png…")
				set cmdResult to my shot("downie_none.png true " & Opposite)
				if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
					set stopReason to "未找到 downie_none.png，自动化已停止。"
					set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
					exit repeat
				end if
				delay 0.5
				
				tell application "System Events"
					key code 48 -- Tab
					delay 0.5
					if doubanFound then
						key code 125 -- Down Arrow
						delay 0.5
					end if
					key code 49 -- Space
					delay 0.5
				end tell
				
				my notify("开始寻找并点击 downie_addselect.png（确认）…")
				set cmdResult to my shot("downie_addselect.png true " & Opposite)
				if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
					set stopReason to "确认时未找到 downie_addselect.png，自动化已停止。"
					set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
					exit repeat
				end if
				delay 1
				
			else
				my notify("未命中特殊分支（如 ignore 白名单跳过），按 skipNormalFlow 继续。")
			end if
			
			-- ==========================================
			-- more.png 及以后的流程
			-- ==========================================
			if not skipNormalFlow then
				set clickValue to "true"
				
				my notify("开始寻找并点击 downie_more.png…")
				set cmdResult to my shot("downie_more.png " & clickValue & " " & Opposite)
				if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
					set stopReason to "未找到 downie_more.png，自动化已停止。"
					set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
					exit repeat
				end if
				delay 0.5
				
				my notify("开始寻找并点击 downie_savemeta.png…")
				set cmdResult to my shot("downie_savemeta.png " & clickValue & " " & Opposite)
				if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
					set stopReason to "未找到 downie_savemeta.png，自动化已停止。"
					set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
					exit repeat
				end if
				delay 0.5
				
				my notify("开始寻找并点击 downie_savejson.png…")
				set cmdResult to my shot("downie_savejson.png " & clickValue & " " & Opposite)
				if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
					set stopReason to "未找到 downie_savejson.png，自动化已停止。"
					set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
					exit repeat
				end if
				delay 0.5
				
				-- ==========================================
				-- 4. 执行 write.py
				-- ==========================================
				my notify("执行 write.py…")
				set wOut to do shell script pythonBin & " " & quoted form of writePyPath
				my writeLog("write.py 输出: " & wOut)
				delay 0.5
				
				-- ==========================================
				-- 5. 关闭操作 —— 统计点击次数（上下限双向判定）
				-- ==========================================
				set closeClickCount to 0
				
				my notify("开始寻找并点击 downie_close.png（等待下载结束）…")
				set cmdResult to my shot("downie_close.png " & clickValue & " " & Opposite)
				if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
					my notify("首次即未检测到 downie_close.png（0 次点击），疑似下载未启动。")
				else
					set closeClickCount to 1
					delay 1
					
					repeat
						set cmdResult to my shot("downie_close.png " & clickValue & " " & Opposite & " false 0 0 1 1")
						if cmdResult contains "TIMEOUT" then
							my notify("close 按钮已消失，本次共点击 " & closeClickCount & " 次。")
							exit repeat
						end if
						set closeClickCount to closeClickCount + 1
						if closeClickCount ≥ maxCloseAttempts then
							my notify("close 点击已达硬上限 " & maxCloseAttempts & "，强制退出清理循环。")
							exit repeat
						end if
						delay 0.5
					end repeat
				end if
				
				set closeAbnormal to false
				set abnormalReason to ""
				
				if closeClickCount > maxCloseClicks then
					set closeAbnormal to true
					set abnormalReason to "关闭按钮点击 " & closeClickCount & " 次，超过上限 " & maxCloseClicks & " 次（疑似卡死/异常残留）"
				else if closeClickCount < minCloseClicks then
					set closeAbnormal to true
					set abnormalReason to "关闭按钮仅点击 " & closeClickCount & " 次，少于正常的 " & minCloseClicks & " 次（疑似下载未启动）"
				end if
				
				if closeAbnormal then
					my writeLog(abnormalReason & "，执行 write.py --blacklist-last。")
					try
						set revertResult to do shell script pythonBin & " " & quoted form of writePyPath & " --blacklist-last"
						my writeLog("write.py --blacklist-last 输出: " & revertResult)
						my forceNotify(abnormalReason & "，该链接已移入 blacklist。", notifyTitle)
					on error revErr
						my forceNotify("write.py --blacklist-last 执行失败: " & revErr, "自动化异常")
					end try
				else
					my notify("close 点击 " & closeClickCount & " 次，正常（" & minCloseClicks & " ~ " & maxCloseClicks & "）。")
				end if
			end if
			
			-- ==========================================
			-- 6. 本轮 URL 处理完毕，进入下一轮前清理 pianku
			-- ==========================================
			if not (my cleanupPianku()) then
				set stopReason to "downie_pianku.png 多次尝试后仍未消失，自动化已停止。"
				set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
				exit repeat
			end if
			
			my notify("本轮处理完毕，进入下一轮。")
		end if
		
	on error errMsg number errNum
		set stopReason to "发生异常（" & errNum & "），自动化已停止: " & errMsg
		set stopTitle to "自动化异常"
		exit repeat
	end try
end repeat
